// Materials for the IFOLOGY-style look:
//  - "ink": matte black with a crisp cream crescent along the lit silhouette edge
//  - toon cloth: two-band cel shading plus a softer cream edge highlight
//  - outline: inverted hull with constant screen-space width (thin black contour)
import * as THREE from 'three';

// Shared uniforms. The active shot writes these each frame (one scene renders per frame).
export const LOOK = {
  uRimColor: { value: new THREE.Color('#f6e7c6') },
  uRimView: { value: new THREE.Vector3(-0.55, 0.8, 0.0).normalize() }, // rim light direction in view space
  uKeyDir: { value: new THREE.Vector3(0.6, 0.55, 0.45).normalize() },
  uRimAmbient: { value: 0.0 },
  uDesat: { value: 0 },
  uTint: { value: new THREE.Color('#ffffff') }, // multiplies rim (purple during power-up)
};

const gradients: Record<string, THREE.DataTexture> = {};
export function toonGradient(levels: number[]): THREE.DataTexture {
  const key = levels.join(',');
  if (gradients[key]) return gradients[key];
  const data = new Uint8Array(levels.length * 4);
  levels.forEach((v, i) => data.set([v, v, v, 255], i * 4));
  const tex = new THREE.DataTexture(data, levels.length, 1, THREE.RGBAFormat);
  tex.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  tex.generateMipmaps = false;
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  gradients[key] = tex;
  return tex;
}

type RimOpts = { rim?: number; width?: number; soft?: number; levels?: number[]; emissive?: string; spec?: number };

function patch(mat: THREE.Material, o: { rim: number; width: number; soft: number; spec: number }) {
  mat.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
    shader.uniforms.uRimColor = LOOK.uRimColor;
    shader.uniforms.uRimView = LOOK.uRimView;
    shader.uniforms.uRimAmbient = LOOK.uRimAmbient;
    shader.uniforms.uDesat = LOOK.uDesat;
    shader.uniforms.uTint = LOOK.uTint;
    shader.uniforms.uRim = { value: o.rim };
    shader.uniforms.uRimW = { value: o.width };
    shader.uniforms.uSoft = { value: o.soft };
    shader.uniforms.uSpec = { value: o.spec };
    shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
      .replace(
        '#include <common>',
        `#include <common>
uniform vec3 uRimColor; uniform vec3 uRimView; uniform float uRimAmbient; uniform float uDesat; uniform vec3 uTint;
uniform float uRim; uniform float uRimW; uniform float uSoft; uniform float uSpec;`,
      )
      .replace(
        '#include <dithering_fragment>',
        `{
  vec3 Nv = normalize(normal);
  vec3 Vv = normalize(vViewPosition);
  float fr = 1.0 - clamp(dot(Nv, Vv), 0.0, 1.0);
  float band = smoothstep(uRimW, uRimW + uSoft, fr);
  float side = mix(uRimAmbient, 1.0, smoothstep(0.02, 0.22, dot(Nv, uRimView)));
  vec3 rc = uRimColor * uTint;
  gl_FragColor.rgb = mix(gl_FragColor.rgb, rc, clamp(band * side * uRim, 0.0, 1.0));
  vec3 H = normalize(uRimView + Vv);
  gl_FragColor.rgb += vec3(1.0, 0.98, 0.94) * smoothstep(0.985, 0.992, max(dot(Nv, H), 0.0)) * uSpec;
  float g = dot(gl_FragColor.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
  gl_FragColor.rgb = mix(gl_FragColor.rgb, vec3(g) * vec3(0.93, 0.97, 1.06), uDesat);
}
#include <dithering_fragment>`,
      );
  };
  mat.customProgramCacheKey = () => `rim2-${o.rim}-${o.width}-${o.soft}-${o.spec}`;
}

const cache = new Map<string, THREE.Material>();

/** Cel-shaded material with the cream edge band. Cached by parameters. */
export function toon(color: string, opts: RimOpts = {}): THREE.MeshToonMaterial {
  const o = { rim: opts.rim ?? 0.55, width: opts.width ?? 0.7, soft: opts.soft ?? 0.06, spec: opts.spec ?? 0 };
  const levels = opts.levels ?? [120, 255];
  const key = `t|${color}|${o.rim}|${o.width}|${o.soft}|${o.spec}|${levels}|${opts.emissive ?? ''}`;
  let m = cache.get(key) as THREE.MeshToonMaterial | undefined;
  if (!m) {
    m = new THREE.MeshToonMaterial({ color, gradientMap: toonGradient(levels) });
    if (opts.emissive) {
      m.emissive = new THREE.Color(opts.emissive);
      m.emissiveIntensity = 1;
    }
    patch(m, o);
    cache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
}

/** The character "skin": matte black with a crisp cream crescent on the lit edge. */
export function inkMaterial(): THREE.MeshToonMaterial {
  return toon('#020203', { rim: 1.0, width: 0.6, soft: 0.025, levels: [255, 255] });
}

/** Cloth: two-band cel shading, cream edge highlight. */
export function clothMaterial(color: string): THREE.MeshToonMaterial {
  return toon(color, { rim: 0.62, width: 0.68, soft: 0.05, levels: [90, 255] });
}

/** Environment surfaces: three soft bands, a faint edge highlight. */
export function envMaterial(color: string, emissive?: string): THREE.MeshToonMaterial {
  return toon(color, { rim: 0.18, width: 0.8, soft: 0.1, levels: [110, 190, 255], emissive });
}

/** Unlit flat colour (faces, windows, signage, glows). */
export function flat(color: string, opacity = 1): THREE.MeshBasicMaterial {
  const key = `f|${color}|${opacity}`;
  let m = cache.get(key) as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial | undefined;
  if (!m) {
    m = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: opacity < 1, opacity, toneMapped: false, depthWrite: opacity >= 1 });
    cache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
}

/** Inverted-hull outline, ~2.5 px wide at 1080p regardless of distance. */
let outline: THREE.ShaderMaterial | null = null;
export function outlineMaterial(): THREE.ShaderMaterial {
  if (outline) return outline;
  outline = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    side: THREE.BackSide,
    uniforms: { uColor: { value: new THREE.Color('#07070a') }, uT: { value: 0.0014 } },
    vertexShader: `uniform float uT;
      void main(){
        vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
        vec3 n = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
        mv.xyz += n * uT * max(0.6, -mv.z);
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
      }`,
    fragmentShader: `uniform vec3 uColor; void main(){ gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor, 1.0); }`,
  });
  return outline;
}

// Pose library, gait cycles and facial expressions for the stickman rig.
// Angles in degrees. Arms: [fwd raise, out raise, twist, elbow]; legs: [fwd raise, out raise, knee].
import type { Face, Gait, Pose, Vec3 } from '../types';

type FullPose = Required<Omit<Pose, 'handL' | 'handR' | 'reachL' | 'reachR'>> & Pick<Pose, 'handL' | 'handR' | 'reachL' | 'reachR'>;

  armL: [4, 8, 0, 8],
  armR: [4, 8, 0, 8],
  legL: [0, 3, 0],

export const FACE_BASE: Required<Omit<Face, 'pupils' | 'tears' | 'sweat' | 'blush' | 'lidTilt'>> & Face = {
  eyes: 1, look: [0, 0], brow: 0, browY: 0, mouth: 0.15, open: 0, width: 1, lid: 0, size: 1,
};

const lerp = (a: number, b: number, k: number) => a + (b - a) * k;
const lerpArr = <T extends number[]>(a: T, b: T, k: number): T => a.map((v, i) => lerp(v, b[i], k)) as T;

export function full(p: Pose | undefined): FullPose {
  return { ...BASE, ...(p || {}) } as FullPose;
}

export function resolvePose(p: string | Pose | undefined): FullPose {
  if (!p) return full(POSES.stand);
  if (typeof p === 'string') {
    if (!POSES[p]) console.warn('unknown pose', p);
    return full(POSES[p] || POSES.stand);
  }
  return full(p);
}

export function resolveFace(f: string | Face | undefined): typeof FACE_BASE {
  if (!f) return { ...FACE_BASE };
  if (typeof f === 'string') {
    if (!FACES[f]) console.warn('unknown face', f);
    return { ...FACE_BASE, ...(FACES[f] || {}) };
  }
  return { ...FACE_BASE, ...f };
}

export function blendPose(a: FullPose, b: FullPose, k: number): FullPose {
  return {
    hipY: lerp(a.hipY, b.hipY, k),
    body: lerpArr(a.body, b.body, k),
    spine: lerpArr(a.spine, b.spine, k),
    head: lerpArr(a.head, b.head, k),
    armL: lerpArr(a.armL, b.armL, k),
    armR: lerpArr(a.armR, b.armR, k),
    legL: lerpArr(a.legL, b.legL, k),
    legR: lerpArr(a.legR, b.legR, k),
    handL: k < 0.5 ? a.handL : b.handL,
    handR: k < 0.5 ? a.handR : b.handR,
  };
}

export function blendFace(a: typeof FACE_BASE, b: typeof FACE_BASE, k: number): typeof FACE_BASE {
  const pick = <K extends keyof Face>(key: K) => (k < 0.5 ? a[key] : b[key]);
  return {
    eyes: lerp(a.eyes, b.eyes, k),
    look: lerpArr(a.look as [number, number], b.look as [number, number], k),
    brow: lerp(a.brow, b.brow, k),
    browY: lerp(a.browY, b.browY, k),
    mouth: lerp(a.mouth, b.mouth, k),
    open: lerp(a.open, b.open, k),
    width: lerp(a.width, b.width, k),
    lid: lerp(a.lid ?? 0, b.lid ?? 0, k),
    lidTilt: k < 0.5 ? a.lidTilt : b.lidTilt,
    size: lerp(a.size ?? 1, b.size ?? 1, k),
    pupils: pick('pupils'),
    tears: pick('tears'),
    sweat: pick('sweat'),
    blush: pick('blush'),
  };
}

export const ease = (x: number) => (x <= 0 ? 0 : x >= 1 ? 1 : x * x * (3 - 2 * x));

/** Evaluate a keyframed track: value at t, eased transitions of `blend` seconds starting at each key. */
export function track<T>(
  keys: { t: number; v: T; blend?: number }[],
  t: number,
  mix: (a: T, b: T, k: number) => T,
  defBlend = 0.35,
): T {
  // keys must be in time order (the loop stops at the first future key); merged tracks may not be
  if (keys.some((k, i) => i > 0 && k.t < keys[i - 1].t)) keys = [keys[0], ...keys.slice(1).sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t)];
  let cur = keys[0].v;
  for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {
    const k = keys[i];
    if (t < k.t) break;
    const b = k.blend ?? defBlend;
    const w = b <= 0 ? 1 : ease((t - k.t) / b);
    cur = w >= 1 ? k.v : mix(cur, k.v, w);
  }
  return cur;
}

const S = (x: number) => Math.sin(x);

/** Gait cycle overlay. phase in cycles; returns the pose plus vertical bob. */
export function gaitPose(g: Gait, phase: number): FullPose {
  const a = phase * Math.PI * 2;
  const s = S(a), c = Math.cos(a);
  switch (g) {
    case 'run':
    case 'jog': {
      const amp = g === 'run' ? 1 : 0.65;
      return full({
        hipY: Math.abs(c) * 0.06 * amp - 0.03,
        spine: [12 * amp + 2, 0, s * 8],
        head: [-6 * amp, 0, 0],
        legL: [s * 45 * amp + 10, 4, 25 + Math.max(0, -s) * 75 * amp + Math.max(0, c) * 10],
        legR: [-s * 45 * amp + 10, 4, 25 + Math.max(0, s) * 75 * amp + Math.max(0, -c) * 10],
        armL: [-s * 50 * amp + 10, 12, 0, 90],
        armR: [s * 50 * amp + 10, 12, 0, 90],
        handL: 'fist',
        handR: 'fist',
      });
    }
    case 'sprint':
      return full({
        hipY: Math.abs(c) * 0.08 - 0.06,
        spine: [32, 0, s * 6],
        head: [-26, 0, 0],
        legL: [s * 60 + 14, 4, 30 + Math.max(0, -s) * 95],
        legR: [-s * 60 + 14, 4, 30 + Math.max(0, s) * 95],
        armL: [-35, 18, 0, 20], // arms swept back
        armR: [-35, 18, 0, 20],
      });
    case 'sneak':
      return full({
        hipY: -0.18 + Math.abs(c) * 0.02,
        spine: [24, 0, 0],
        head: [-14, s * 10, 0],
        legL: [s * 22 + 20, 6, 40 + Math.max(0, -s) * 30],
        legR: [-s * 22 + 20, 6, 40 + Math.max(0, s) * 30],
        armL: [40, 14, 0, 90],
        armR: [40, 14, 0, 90],
      });
    case 'dash':
      // powerful athletic sprint: big strides, heel kicks to the hips, pumping arms
      return full({
        hipY: -0.05 + Math.abs(c) * 0.07,
        spine: [22, 0, s * 7],
        head: [-16, 0, 0],
        legL: [s * 60 + 16, 4, 22 + Math.max(0, -s) * 108 + Math.max(0, c) * 14],
        legR: [-s * 60 + 16, 4, 22 + Math.max(0, s) * 108 + Math.max(0, -c) * 14],
        armL: [-s * 68 + 12, 14, 0, 96],
        armR: [s * 68 + 12, 14, 0, 96],
        handL: 'fist',
        handR: 'fist',
      });
    case 'glide':
      // riding something (skateboard, ice): no stride, knees soft, arms out for balance
      return full({
        hipY: -0.06 + S(a * 0.5) * 0.01,
        spine: [10, 0, 8],
        head: [-4, -10, 0],
        legL: [12, 10, 22],
        legR: [-6, 6, 14],
        armL: [10, 55, 0, 25],
        armR: [6, 40, 0, 30],
      });
    case 'float':
      return full({
        hipY: 0.25 + S(a * 0.5) * 0.05,
        spine: [4, 0, 0],
        legL: [10, 4, 30],
        legR: [4, 4, 20],
        armL: [10, 25, 0, 20],
        armR: [10, 25, 0, 20],
      });
    case 'shamble':
      // zombie drag: short heavy steps, arms held out in front, head lolling, body rocking
      return full({
        hipY: -0.02 - Math.abs(s) * 0.012,
        spine: [10, s * 5, s * 9],
        head: [12, s * 6, 14 + s * 6],
        legL: [s * 16 + 4, 5, 14 + Math.max(0, -s) * 18],
        legR: [-s * 16 + 4, 5, 14 + Math.max(0, s) * 18],
        armL: [82 + s * 6, 6, 0, 12],
        armR: [78 - s * 6, 6, 0, 16],
        handL: 'open',
        handR: 'open',
      });
    case 'walk':
    default:
      return full({
        hipY: -Math.abs(s) * 0.025 + 0.012,
        spine: [3, 0, s * 4],
        head: [0, 0, 0],
        legL: [s * 24, 3, 6 + Math.max(0, -s) * 28 + Math.max(0, c) * 8],
        legR: [-s * 24, 3, 6 + Math.max(0, s) * 28 + Math.max(0, -c) * 8],
        armL: [-s * 22 + 2, 8, 0, 14 + Math.max(0, -s) * 12],
        armR: [s * 22 + 2, 8, 0, 14 + Math.max(0, s) * 12],
      });
  }
}

export const GAIT_SPEED: Record<Gait, number> = { walk: 1.35, jog: 2.6, run: 4.2, sprint: 9, dash: 9, sneak: 0.7, float: 1.2, glide: 4, carried: 4, shamble: 0.55 };
export const GAIT_STRIDE: Record<Gait, number> = { walk: 1.3, jog: 1.9, run: 2.6, sprint: 3.6, dash: 3.4, sneak: 0.8, float: 4, glide: 6, carried: 1, shamble: 0.9 };

/** Small always-on life: breathing and weight shift. */
export function idleOffset(p: FullPose, t: number, seed: number, amount = 1): FullPose {
  const b = S(t * 1.9 + seed) * amount, w = S(t * 0.55 + seed * 3) * amount;
  return {
    ...p,
    spine: [p.spine[0] + b * 1.2, p.spine[1] + w * 1.2, p.spine[2]],
    head: [p.head[0] - b * 1.4, p.head[1] + S(t * 0.37 + seed) * 2.5 * amount, p.head[2] + w * 1.5],
    armL: [p.armL[0] + b * 1.5, p.armL[1] + b * 1.2, p.armL[2], p.armL[3] + b * 2],
    armR: [p.armR[0] - b * 1.5, p.armR[1] + b * 1.2, p.armR[2], p.armR[3] + b * 2],
  };
}

/** Talking: head nods and small hand gestures. */
export function talkOffset(p: FullPose, t: number, seed: number): FullPose {
  const n = S(t * 7 + seed) * 0.5 + S(t * 3.1 + seed * 2) * 0.5;
  return {
    ...p,
    head: [p.head[0] + n * 4, p.head[1] + S(t * 1.7 + seed) * 5, p.head[2] + S(t * 2.3) * 2],
    armR: [p.armR[0] + Math.max(0, S(t * 2.2 + seed)) * 18, p.armR[1] + 4, p.armR[2], p.armR[3] + Math.max(0, S(t * 2.2 + seed)) * 30],
  };
}

export function deg(v: number) {
  return (v * Math.PI) / 180;
}

export function v3(a: Vec3 | undefined, d: Vec3 = [0, 0, 0]): Vec3 {
  return a ? a : d;
}

// The long-form composition: reads public/episodes/<slug>/episode.json + timing.json and lays
// every shot on the timeline; plays mix.wav (voice + music + SFX) when it exists.
//   npx remotion render Episode out.mp4 --props='{"slug":"pilot"}'
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, type CalculateMetadataFunction, Sequence, staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from 'remotion';
import { Grade } from '../overlays/Grade';
import type { Episode as EpisodeSpec, Shot3D, Timing } from '../types';
import type { ShotCtx } from './scene';
import { castOf } from './resolve';
import { ShotView } from './ShotView';
import { validate } from './validate';

export type EpisodeProps = { slug: string; episode?: EpisodeSpec; timing?: Timing; hasMix?: boolean; lenient?: boolean; review?: boolean };

export const calculateEpisodeMetadata: CalculateMetadataFunction<EpisodeProps> = async ({ props }) => {
  const base = `episodes/${props.slug}`;
  const episode: EpisodeSpec = await fetch(staticFile(`${base}/episode.json`)).then(r => r.json());
  const timing: Timing = await fetch(staticFile(`${base}/timing.json`)).then(r => {
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`no timing.json — run: node tools/episode.mjs draft ${props.slug}`);
    return r.json();
  });
  const hasMix = await fetch(staticFile(`${base}/mix.wav`), { method: 'HEAD' }).then(r => r.ok).catch(() => false);
  const problems = validate(episode);
  if (problems.length) {
    const msg = `episode "${props.slug}" has ${problems.length} problem(s):\n- ` + problems.join('\n- ');
    if (props.lenient) console.warn(msg);
    else throw new Error(msg);
  }
  if (timing.shots.length !== episode.shots.length) throw new Error(`timing.json has ${timing.shots.length} shots but episode.json has ${episode.shots.length} — re-run draft/align`);
  const fps = episode.fps || 30;
  return { durationInFrames: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(timing.total * fps)), fps, props: { ...props, episode, timing, hasMix } };
};

export const Episode: React.FC<EpisodeProps> = ({ slug, episode, timing, hasMix, review }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
  if (!episode || !timing) return null;
  const cast = castOf(episode);
  const f = (s: number) => Math.round(s * fps);
  // continuity context: the previous shot, when both are 3D (the renderer decides flow vs cut)
  const prevCtx = (i: number): ShotCtx | undefined => {
    const p = episode.shots[i - 1], c = episode.shots[i];
    if (!p || p.kind === 'card' || c.kind === 'card') return undefined;
    const pt = timing.shots[i - 1];
    return { shot: p as Shot3D, dur: Math.max(1, f(pt.start + pt.dur) - f(pt.start)) / fps, start: pt.start, words: pt.words };
  };
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#000' }}>
      {episode.shots.map((shot, i) => {
        const tm = timing.shots[i];
        if (!tm) return null;
        // the first shot also covers the narration lead-in (frames before its start), keeping its own time base,
        // so the video never opens on empty frames
        const s0 = f(tm.start), from = i === 0 ? 0 : s0;
        const len = Math.max(1, f(tm.start + tm.dur) - from), dur = Math.max(1, f(tm.start + tm.dur) - s0) / fps;
        return (
          <Sequence key={i} from={from} durationInFrames={len} name={`${i} ${shot.kind === 'card' ? 'card:' + shot.card : (shot as { set: string }).set}`}>
            <ShotView shot={shot} t={(frame - s0) / fps} dur={dur} cast={cast} frame={frame} words={tm.words} start={tm.start}
              prev={prevCtx(i)} nextCut={episode.shots[i + 1]?.cut} review={review ? `#${i} ${shot.id || ''}` : undefined} />
          </Sequence>
        );
      })}
      <Grade vignette={0.55} grain={0.03} />
      {hasMix && !review && <Audio src={staticFile(`episodes/${slug}/mix.wav`)} />}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// QA compositions: their calculateMetadata runs the scene audit / engine self-tests and returns the
// results as props, which tools/qa.cjs reads (no frames are rendered).
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, type CalculateMetadataFunction, staticFile } from 'remotion';
import type { Episode, Timing } from '../types';
import { auditEpisode, formatReport, type AuditReport } from './audit';
import { runSelfTests, type TestResult } from './selftest';

export type AuditProps = { slug: string; report?: AuditReport; text?: string };
export type SelfTestProps = { results?: TestResult[] };

export const AuditView: React.FC<AuditProps> = () => <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#111' }} />;
export const SelfTestView: React.FC<SelfTestProps> = () => <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#111' }} />;

export const calcAudit: CalculateMetadataFunction<AuditProps> = async ({ props }) => {
  const base = `episodes/${props.slug}`;
  const ep: Episode = await fetch(staticFile(`${base}/episode.json`)).then(r => r.json());
  const timing: Timing = await fetch(staticFile(`${base}/timing.json`)).then(r => r.json());
  const report = auditEpisode(ep, timing);
  return { durationInFrames: 1, props: { ...props, report, text: formatReport(report, props.slug) } };
};

export const calcSelfTest: CalculateMetadataFunction<SelfTestProps> = async ({ props }) => ({ durationInFrames: 1, props: { ...props, results: runSelfTests() } });

// Review-mode overlay (never in final renders): name tags over every character, expected-position
// markers for effects (where each swapper must end up), and a banner with shot id, time and the
// flow/cut decision. Makes overlaps ("two tags on one spot") and missing characters obvious.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { project } from '../engine/cam';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { SceneState } from './scene';

const COLORS = ['#ffd23f', '#5ce1ff', '#ff6b9a', '#9dff6b', '#ffa94d', '#c9a6ff', '#ffffff'];
const W = 1920, H = 1080;

export const ReviewOverlay: React.FC<{ scene: SceneState; label: string; t: number; dur: number }> = ({ scene, label, t, dur }) => {
  const { cam, states, swap, flow } = scene;
  const tags = states.map((s, i) => {
    const head = project(s.anchors.headTop.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.08, 0)), cam, W, H);
    const feet = project(s.anchors.feet, cam, W, H);
    return { name: (s.cast.name || s.spec.id).toUpperCase(), head, feet, color: COLORS[i % COLORS.length], ghost: !!s.spec.ghost };
  });
  const markers: { x: number; y: number; text: string; color: string }[] = [];
  if (swap && !swap.keepPaths) {
    // after the swap, ids[0] must stand where ids[1] stood, and vice versa
    const [a, b] = swap.pre;
    const pa = project(new THREE.Vector3(...(a.pos as [number, number, number])), cam, W, H);
    const pb = project(new THREE.Vector3(...(b.pos as [number, number, number])), cam, W, H);
    const after = t >= swap.t;
    if (pb.visible) markers.push({ x: pb.x, y: pb.y, text: `${after ? '✓ expect' : 'after swap'} ${swap.ids[0].toUpperCase()}`, color: '#ffd23f' });
    if (pa.visible) markers.push({ x: pa.x, y: pa.y, text: `${after ? '✓ expect' : 'after swap'} ${swap.ids[1].toUpperCase()}`, color: '#5ce1ff' });
  }
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none', fontFamily: 'Consolas, monospace' }}>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 0, right: 0, padding: '10px 16px', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.72)', color: '#fff', fontSize: 26, display: 'flex', gap: 28 }}>
        <span style={{ color: '#ffd23f', fontWeight: 700 }}>{label}</span>
        <span>t {t.toFixed(2)} / {dur.toFixed(2)} s</span>
        {swap && <span style={{ color: '#c9a6ff' }}>swap @ {swap.t.toFixed(2)} s {swap.keepPaths ? '(paths)' : ''}</span>}
        {flow && <span style={{ color: flow.on ? '#9dff6b' : '#aaa' }}>{flow.on ? `FLOW in (${flow.camBlend.toFixed(2)} s)` : `CUT in`} · {flow.reason}</span>}
      </div>
      {markers.map((m, i) => (
        <div key={'m' + i} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: m.x - 46, top: m.y - 18, width: 92, height: 36, border: `4px dashed ${m.color}`, borderRadius: '50%' }}>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 38, left: -60, width: 212, textAlign: 'center', color: m.color, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700, textShadow: '0 2px 3px #000' }}>{m.text}</div>
        </div>
      ))}
      {tags.map((g, i) =>
        g.head.visible ? (
          <React.Fragment key={'t' + i}>
            <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: g.head.x, top: g.head.y - 44, transform: 'translateX(-50%)', background: g.color, color: '#000', padding: '3px 10px', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 800, opacity: g.ghost ? 0.5 : 1, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
              {g.name}
            </div>
            {g.feet.visible && <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: g.feet.x - 7, top: g.feet.y - 7, width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: 7, background: g.color, border: '2px solid #000' }} />}
          </React.Fragment>
        ) : null,
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// Renders one episode shot (3D scene or 2D card) at shot-local time t.
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { evalActor } from '../engine/actor';
import { project, pxPerMetre } from '../engine/cam';
import { rand, Shockwave, Sparks } from '../engine/fx';
import { LOOK } from '../engine/materials';
import { setRim, Stage } from '../engine/Stage';
import { Stickman } from '../engine/Stickman';
import { CARDS } from '../cards';
import { Lighting, PALETTES } from '../sets/look';
import { WorldProp } from '../sets/props';
import { Flash, SpeedLines } from '../overlays/Energy';
import type { CardShot, CastMember, Shot, Shot3D, Vec3 } from '../types';
import { OverlayLayer } from './overlays';
import { cue, type Words } from './cue';
import { evalShot, seedOf, type ShotCtx } from './scene';
import { ReviewOverlay } from './ReviewOverlay';

const W = 1920, H = 1080;
const GRADES: Record<string, string> = {
  none: 'none',
  warm: 'saturate(1.08) sepia(0.12) brightness(1.02)',
  cool: 'saturate(0.92) hue-rotate(-8deg) brightness(0.98)',
  desat: 'saturate(0.35) brightness(1.02)',
  mono: 'grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)',
  dream: 'saturate(1.15) brightness(1.08) blur(0.6px)',
  night: 'saturate(0.85) brightness(0.9) hue-rotate(10deg)',
  danger: 'saturate(1.2) sepia(0.25) hue-rotate(-25deg) contrast(1.08)',
  flashback: 'sepia(0.45) saturate(0.8) contrast(0.95) brightness(1.05)',
};

const moteGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 6, 4);

/** Floating motes for time-freeze and atmosphere (static in the air when frozen). */
const Motes: React.FC<{ t: number; center: THREE.Vector3; kind: string; frozen?: boolean }> = ({ t, center, kind, frozen }) => {
  const r = rand(kind.length * 31 + 7);
  const n = kind === 'snow' ? 90 : kind === 'rain' ? 140 : 60;
  const col = kind === 'embers' ? '#ffb15c' : kind === 'sparks' ? '#d2b2ff' : kind === 'rain' ? '#bcd3f0' : '#fbf6ec';
  const out: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const x = center.x + (r() - 0.5) * 9, z = center.z + (r() - 0.5) * 7;
    const fall = kind === 'rain' ? 9 : kind === 'snow' ? 0.6 : kind === 'embers' || kind === 'sparks' ? -0.5 : 0.08;
    const y0 = r() * 4;
    const tt = frozen ? 0 : t;
    const y = (((y0 - fall * tt) % 4) + 4) % 4;
    const wob = frozen ? 0 : Math.sin(tt * 1.3 + i) * 0.05;
    const s = kind === 'rain' ? [0.006, 0.16, 0.006] : [1, 1, 1].map(() => (kind === 'dust' ? 0.012 : 0.02) * (0.5 + r()));
    out.push(
      <mesh key={i} geometry={moteGeo} position={[x + wob, y, z]} scale={s as [number, number, number]}>
        <meshBasicMaterial color={col} transparent opacity={kind === 'dust' ? 0.55 : 0.85} toneMapped={false} depthWrite={false} />
      </mesh>,
    );
  }
  return <group>{out}</group>;
};

const Scene3D: React.FC<{ ctx: ShotCtx; t: number; cast: Record<string, CastMember>; prev?: ShotCtx; review?: string }> = ({ ctx, t, cast, prev, review }) => {
  const { shot, dur, words } = ctx;
  const sc = evalShot(ctx, t, cast, prev);
  const { def, palKey, states, cam, swap: sw, frozen, props } = sc;
  const pal = PALETTES[palKey] || PALETTES.afternoon;
  LOOK.uDesat.value = frozen ? 0.55 : 0;
  setRim();
  const S = def.component;
  const look = cam.look.toArray() as Vec3;
  const grade = GRADES[shot.fx?.grade || 'none'];
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: grade }}>
      <Stage cam={cam}>
        <Lighting p={pal} center={def.shadowCenter || look} shadowBox={def.shadowBox ?? 14} sky={!def.interior} desat={frozen ? 0.55 : 0} />
        <S t={frozen ? 0 : t} center={look} variant={shot.variant ?? 0} time={palKey} />
        {props.map((p, i) => <WorldProp key={i} spec={p} t={frozen ? 0 : t} />)}
        {states.map((s, i) => (
          <React.Fragment key={i}>
            <Stickman s={s} faceGlow={s.spec.glow} />
            {s.spec.glow && <Sparks t={t} center={s.anchors.chest} color={s.spec.glow} n={20} />}
          </React.Fragment>
        ))}
        {(shot.fx?.particles || frozen) && <Motes t={t} center={cam.look} kind={shot.fx?.particles || 'dust'} frozen={frozen} />}
        {sw && t >= sw.t && t < sw.t + 0.6 && sw.pre.map((a, i) => (
          <React.Fragment key={'sw' + i}>
            <Stickman s={evalActor(a, cast[a.id] || cast.hero, sw.t - 0.01, seedOf(a.id), undefined, ctx.start + sw.t - 0.01)} ghostOpacity={0.5 * (1 - (t - sw.t) / 0.6)} ghostColor="#b07cff" ghostOrder={40 + i * 2} shadowBlob={false} />
            <Shockwave t={t - sw.t} origin={a.pos as Vec3} maxR={1.6} dur={0.35} color="#c9a6ff" air={false} />
            <Sparks t={t - sw.t} center={new THREE.Vector3(...(a.pos as Vec3)).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0))} n={18} color="#d2b2ff" intensity={1 - (t - sw.t) / 0.6} />
          </React.Fragment>
        ))}
      </Stage>
      {shot.fx?.speedLines && <SpeedLines t={t} opacity={0.55} />}
      {sw && <Flash t={t} at={sw.t} dur={0.14} color="#c9a6ff" peak={0.45} />}
      <OverlayLayer overlays={(shot.overlays || []).map(o => {
        // overlay times take word cues: `at`, `until` (shot time) and a stopwatch's `switchAt` (time since it appeared)
        const x = o as { at?: number | string; until?: number | string; switchAt?: number | string };
        const at = cue(x.at, words, 0);
        // a body menu's row cues / noteAt are shot times too: make them relative to the panel
        const m = o.type === 'menu' ? { rows: o.rows.map(r => (r.at !== undefined ? { ...r, at: cue(r.at, words, 0) - at } : r)), ...(o.noteAt !== undefined ? { noteAt: cue(o.noteAt, words, 0) - at } : {}) } : {};
        return { ...o, at, ...m, ...(x.until !== undefined ? { until: cue(x.until, words, 0) } : {}), ...(typeof x.switchAt === 'string' ? { switchAt: cue(x.switchAt, words, 0) - at } : {}) } as typeof o;
      })} t={t} dur={dur} project={(id: string) => {
        const s = sc.byId[id];
        return s ? { ...project(s.anchors.headTop, cam, W, H), scale: pxPerMetre(s.anchors.head, cam, H) } : null;
      }} />
      {review && <ReviewOverlay scene={sc} label={review} t={t} dur={dur} />}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// any "@word" string inside a card spec becomes that word's time (seconds into the shot)
const cueSpec = (v: unknown, words: Words | undefined): unknown =>
  typeof v === 'string' && /^@[\w']/.test(v) ? cue(v, words, 0)
    : Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(x => cueSpec(x, words))
    : v && typeof v === 'object' ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).map(([k, x]) => [k, cueSpec(x, words)])) : v;

const CardScene: React.FC<{ shot: CardShot; t: number; dur: number; words?: Words }> = ({ shot, t, dur, words }) => {
  const def = CARDS[shot.card];
  if (!def) return <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#16203a', color: '#f0b44c', fontSize: 64, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }}>card “{shot.card}” missing</AbsoluteFill>;
  const { kind: _k, vo: _v, who: _w, hold: _h, card: _c, overlays, sfx: _s, cut: _cut, id: _id, ...spec } = shot;
  const C = def.component;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <C t={t} dur={dur} spec={cueSpec(spec, words) as typeof spec} W={W} H={H} />
      <OverlayLayer overlays={overlays || []} t={t} dur={dur} project={() => null} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// Two-sided transitions: the outgoing shot plays the first half in its last frames (nextCut),
// the incoming shot the second half in its first frames (cut). Pure 2D, on the finished frame.
const TR = { whip: 0.17, zoom: 0.2, smash: 0.28 };
let trSeq = 0;
function transition(cut: string | undefined, nextCut: string | undefined, t: number, dur: number) {
  const id = `tr${++trSeq % 1000}`;
  let x = 0, sc = 1, bx = 0, by = 0, rot = 0;
  const outK = (w: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - (dur - w)) / w));
  const inK = (w: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - t / w));
  if (nextCut === 'whip') { const k = outK(TR.whip) ** 2; x -= k * 12; bx += k * 110; sc *= 1 + k * 0.3; }
  if (cut === 'whip') { const k = inK(TR.whip) ** 2; x += k * 12; bx += k * 110; sc *= 1 + k * 0.3; }
  if (nextCut === 'zoom') { const k = outK(TR.zoom) ** 2; sc *= 1 + k * 1.1; bx += k * 14; by += k * 14; }
  if (cut === 'zoom') { const k = inK(TR.zoom) ** 2; sc *= 1 + k * 0.7; bx += k * 14; by += k * 14; }
  if (cut === 'smash') {
    // punch-in that settles + a decaying shake
    const k = inK(TR.smash);
    sc *= 1 + 0.07 * k;
    x += Math.sin(t * 95) * 1.4 * k;
    rot += Math.sin(t * 71 + 1) * 1.2 * k;
  }
  return { id, transform: x || sc !== 1 || rot ? `translateX(${x}%) scale(${sc}) rotate(${rot}deg)` : undefined, blurX: bx, blurY: by };
}

export const ShotView: React.FC<{
  shot: Shot; t: number; dur: number; cast: Record<string, CastMember>; frame: number; words?: Words; start?: number; prev?: ShotCtx; review?: string; nextCut?: string;
}> = ({ shot, t, dur, cast, words, start = 0, prev, review, nextCut }) => {
  const body = shot.kind === 'card'
    ? <CardScene shot={shot as CardShot} t={t} dur={dur} words={words} />
    : <Scene3D ctx={{ shot: shot as Shot3D, dur, start, words }} t={t} cast={cast} prev={prev} review={review} />;
  const cut = shot.cut;
  const tr = transition(cut, nextCut, t, dur);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {tr.blurX > 0.5 && (
        <svg width={0} height={0} style={{ position: 'absolute' }}>
          <filter id={tr.id} x="-10%" y="0" width="120%" height="100%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation={`${tr.blurX} ${tr.blurY}`} /></filter>
        </svg>
      )}
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ transform: tr.transform, filter: tr.blurX > 0.5 ? `url(#${tr.id})` : undefined }}>{body}</AbsoluteFill>
      {cut === 'flash' && <Flash t={t} at={0} dur={0.18} peak={0.7} />}
      {cut === 'smash' && <Flash t={t} at={0} dur={0.1} peak={0.85} />}
      {cut === 'dip' && t < 0.3 && <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#000', opacity: 1 - t / 0.3 }} />}
      {review && shot.kind === 'card' && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 0, right: 0, padding: '10px 16px', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.72)', color: '#ffd23f', fontSize: 26, fontFamily: 'Consolas, monospace' }}>
          {review} · t {t.toFixed(2)} / {dur.toFixed(2)} s · card:{(shot as CardShot).card}
        </div>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
@@@@ END
@@@@ FILE src/episode/audit.ts | text-crlf | 28225 | fe0f40fea875a5d37ae781c0dde95be60c06293936b757547c14b6d7a6456e6e
// Pre-render scene audit: walks every frame of every 3D shot through evalShot (the same code the
// renderer uses) and checks numbers, not pictures. Run: node tools/qa.cjs audit <slug>
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { at, type ActorState } from '../engine/actor';
import { project, type CamState } from '../engine/cam';
import { POSES } from '../engine/rig';
import type { CastMember, Episode, Pose, Shot3D, Timing } from '../types';
import { castOf } from './resolve';
import { cue } from './cue';
import { beatsOf, evalShot, flowInfo, framingDelta, type ShotCtx } from './scene';
import type { CameraSpec, Vec3 } from '../types';
import { clipsOf, propSolids, setSolids } from './collide';
import { SETS } from '../sets';

export type Finding = { sev: 'error' | 'warn'; shot: number; id?: string; t?: number; check: string; msg: string };
export type AuditEvent = { shot: number; id?: string; t: number; kind: 'swap' | 'jump' | 'flow' | 'cut' | 'clip'; what: string };
export type AuditReport = { findings: Finding[]; events: AuditEvent[]; flows: { shot: number; on: boolean; reason: string; shift?: number; angle?: number; scale?: number }[]; frames: number };

const W = 1920, H = 1080;
// running/sprinting has a flight phase where both feet are off the ground
const AIRBORNE = (s: ActorState) => s.pose.hipY > 0.08 || Math.abs(s.pose.body[0]) > 20 || (s.moving && s.speed > 2.5) || s.spec.gait === 'float' || (s.spec.path || []).some(p => p.gait === 'float');
const JOINTS = ['spine', 'head', 'armL', 'armR', 'legL', 'legR'] as const;

function poseDelta(a: ActorState, b: ActorState) {
  let m = 0;
  for (const j of JOINTS) {
    const pa = a.pose[j] as number[], pb = b.pose[j] as number[];
    for (let k = 0; k < Math.min(pa.length, pb.length); k++) m = Math.max(m, Math.abs(pa[k] - pb[k]));
  }
  return m;
}

const inFrame = (p: { x: number; y: number; visible: boolean }, m = 0.02) => p.visible && p.x > W * m && p.x < W * (1 - m) && p.y > H * m && p.y < H * (1 - m);

function cueStrings(shot: Shot3D) {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const add = (v: unknown) => { if (typeof v === 'string' && v.startsWith('@')) out.push(v); };
  add(shot.fx?.swap?.t);
  (shot.actors || []).forEach(a => (a.path || []).forEach(w => add(w.t)));
  (shot.overlays || []).forEach(o => { const x = o as { at?: unknown; until?: unknown; switchAt?: unknown }; add(x.at); add(x.until); add(x.switchAt); });
  (shot.sfx || []).forEach(c => add(c.t));
  (shot.actors || []).forEach(a => { (a.poses || []).forEach(k => add(k.t)); (a.faces || []).forEach(k => add(k.t)); });
  (shot.camera?.moveAt || []).forEach(add);
  (shot.camera?.path || []).forEach(k => add(k.t));
  (shot.props || []).forEach(p => { add((p as { ignite?: unknown }).ignite); (p.path || []).forEach(k => add(k.t)); });
  (shot.props || []).forEach(p => { const f = (p as { follow?: unknown }).follow; if (Array.isArray(f)) f.forEach(k => add((k as { t?: unknown }).t)); });
  return out;
}

export function auditEpisode(ep: Episode, timing: Timing): AuditReport {
  const fps = timing.fps || 30;
  const cast: Record<string, CastMember> = castOf(ep);
  const findings: Finding[] = [];
  const events: AuditEvent[] = [];
  const flows: AuditReport['flows'] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const add = (f: Finding, key?: string) => {
    const k = key ?? `${f.shot}|${f.check}|${f.msg}`;
    if (seen.has(k)) return;
    seen.add(k);
    findings.push(f);
  };
  let frames = 0;
  const ctxOf = (i: number): ShotCtx => {
    const tm = timing.shots[i];
    const dur = Math.max(1, Math.round((tm.start + tm.dur) * fps) - Math.round(tm.start * fps)) / fps;
    return { shot: ep.shots[i] as Shot3D, dur, start: tm.start, words: tm.words };
  };

  const checkCues = (cues: string[], words: [string, number][], i: number, sid?: string) => {
    for (const c of cues) {
      const m = /^@([\p{L}\p{N}']+)(?:#(\d+))?/iu.exec(c);
      const hits = m ? words.filter(([w]) => w === m[1].toLowerCase()).length : 0;
      if (!m || hits < (m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 1)) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, check: 'cue', msg: `word cue "${c}" not found in this shot's narration` });
    }
  };
  const deepCues = (v: unknown, out: string[] = []): string[] => {
    if (typeof v === 'string' && /^@[\w']/.test(v)) out.push(v);
    else if (Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach(x => deepCues(x, out));
    else if (v && typeof v === 'object') Object.values(v).forEach(x => deepCues(x, out));
    return out;
  };

  // every frame must belong to a shot (the first shot covers any lead-in before it)
  timing.shots.forEach((tm, i) => {
    const prevEnd = i > 0 ? Math.round((timing.shots[i - 1].start + timing.shots[i - 1].dur) * fps) : 0;
    const gap = Math.round(tm.start * fps) - prevEnd;
    if (i > 0 && gap > 0) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: ep.shots[i]?.id, check: 'timing', msg: `${gap} empty frame(s) before this shot (shot ${i - 1} ends at frame ${prevEnd}) — the video shows black there` });
  });

  ep.shots.forEach((shot, i) => {
    if (shot.kind === 'card') {
      checkCues(deepCues(shot), timing.shots[i]?.words || [], i, shot.id);
      return;
    }
    const s3 = shot as Shot3D;
    const ctx = ctxOf(i);
    const sid = s3.id;
    const prevShot = ep.shots[i - 1];
    const prev = prevShot && prevShot.kind !== 'card' ? ctxOf(i - 1) : undefined;
    const words = ctx.words || [];

    // --- word cues must resolve -----------------------------------------------------------
    checkCues(cueStrings(s3), words, i, sid);

    // --- flow / cut decision at the shot boundary ------------------------------------------
    if (prev) {
      const fl = flowInfo(prev, ctx, cast);
      flows.push({ shot: i, on: fl.on, reason: fl.reason, shift: fl.screenShift, angle: fl.angle, scale: fl.scale });
      events.push({ shot: i, id: sid, t: 0, kind: fl.on ? 'flow' : 'cut', what: fl.reason });
      if (!fl.on && prev.shot.set === s3.set && (prev.shot.time || '') === (s3.time || '') && s3.cut === 'cut') {
        const a = evalShot(prev, prev.dur, cast), b = evalShot(ctx, 0, cast);
        const d = framingDelta(a.cam, b.cam, [...a.states, ...b.states].map(s => s.anchors.head));
        if (d.shift < 0.14 && d.angle < 20) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, check: 'jumpcut', msg: `forced cut but the framing barely changes (subject moves ${(d.shift * 100).toFixed(1)}% of the width, ${d.angle.toFixed(0)}°) — remove cut:"cut" so it flows, or change the angle ≥30°` });
      }
      if (fl.on) {
        // continuity: a character that continues through a flowing move must not change place
        const a = evalShot(prev, prev.dur, cast), b = evalShot(ctx, 0, cast);
        for (const s of b.states) {
          const p = a.byId[s.spec.id];
          if (!p || s.spec.ghost) continue;
          const d = Math.hypot(p.pos[0] - s.pos[0], p.pos[2] - s.pos[2]);
          if (d > 0.3) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, t: 0, check: 'continuity', msg: `${s.spec.id} jumps ${d.toFixed(2)} m between shot ${i - 1} and ${i} during a continuous camera move — start them where the previous shot left them, or change the camera angle so it cuts` });
          const dr = Math.abs(((s.rot - p.rot + 540) % 360) - 180);
          if (dr > 35) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t: 0, check: 'continuity', msg: `${s.spec.id} turns ${dr.toFixed(0)}° across the continuous move (it will blend, but check it reads naturally)` });
        }
        // a flow blends one camera move across both shots: anything present in only one of them pops in or out mid-move
        const ids = (st: ActorState[]) => new Set(st.filter(s => !s.spec.ghost).map(s => s.spec.id));
        const ia = ids(a.states), ib = ids(b.states);
        const gone = [...ia].filter(x => !ib.has(x)), added = [...ib].filter(x => !ia.has(x));
        if (gone.length || added.length) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t: 0, check: 'continuity', msg: `flow from shot ${i - 1}, but the cast changes (${[...gone.map(x => `-${x}`), ...added.map(x => `+${x}`)].join(', ')}): they pop in/out during the continuous move — keep the same actors in both shots, or make it a real cut (new angle)` });
        const propKeys = (sh: Shot3D) => (sh.props || []).map(p => `${p.type}@${JSON.stringify(p.pos)}`);
        const pa = propKeys(prev.shot), pb = propKeys(s3);
        const pGone = pa.filter(x => !pb.includes(x)), pAdded = pb.filter(x => !pa.includes(x));
        if (pGone.length || pAdded.length) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t: 0, check: 'continuity', msg: `flow from shot ${i - 1}, but the props differ (${[...pGone.map(x => `-${x.split('@')[0]}`), ...pAdded.map(x => `+${x.split('@')[0]}`)].join(', ')}): they pop in/out during the continuous move — copy the same props into both shots` });
      }
    }

    // --- a partial inline pose after a seated/kneeling one: its missing fields fall back to standing -----
    for (const a of s3.actors || []) {
      const seq = [a.pose, ...(a.poses || []).map(k => k.pose)];
      const low = (p: unknown) => ((typeof p === 'string' ? POSES[p] : (p as Pose | undefined))?.hipY ?? 0) < -0.3;
      const partial = (p: unknown) => !!p && typeof p === 'object' && (p as Pose).hipY === undefined && !(p as Pose).legL && !(p as Pose).legR;
      const firstLow = seq.findIndex(low);
      if (firstLow >= 0 && seq.slice(firstLow + 1).some(partial))
        add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, check: 'pose', msg: `${a.id} sits/kneels, then gets a partial inline pose (no hipY/legs): the missing fields reset to standing, so they stand up — give the full seated pose plus the change` });
    }

    // --- effects should be tied to the narration, or a re-voice silently de-syncs them ---------
    if (s3.fx?.swap && typeof s3.fx.swap.t === 'number' && s3.vo)
      add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, check: 'cue', msg: `swap time is a fixed ${s3.fx.swap.t}s — use a word cue ("@blink+0.75") so it stays on the spoken word after re-voicing${s3.fx.swap.keepPaths ? '; cue the path waypoints too' : ''}` });

    // --- timing sanity -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    const sw0 = evalShot(ctx, 0, cast).swap;
    if (s3.fx?.swap) {
      if (!sw0) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, check: 'swap', msg: `swap ids ${s3.fx.swap.ids.join('/')} are not both in this shot` });
      else if (sw0.t < 0.45 || sw0.t > ctx.dur - 0.25) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, check: 'swap', msg: `swap at ${sw0.t.toFixed(2)} s is too close to the shot edge (shot is ${ctx.dur.toFixed(2)} s; the blink needs 0.45 s before and the result ≥0.25 s after)` });
    }

    // --- frame-by-frame -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    const n = Math.max(1, Math.round(ctx.dur * fps));
    let prevStates: Record<string, ActorState> | null = null;
    let prevCam: CamState | null = null;
    let prevBeat = 0;
    // the beat's own targets: a CLOSE sub-cut of a group shot frames only its first actor, on purpose
    const targetsOf = (spec: CameraSpec | undefined) => {
      const tg = spec?.target;
      return typeof tg === 'string' ? [tg] : Array.isArray(tg) && typeof tg[0] === 'string' ? (tg as string[]) : [];
    };
    // per actor: seconds spent moving while off-screen, before their last on-screen frame (exits are fine)
    const hidden: Record<string, { moving: number; lastSeen: number; from: number; to: number }[]> = {};
    // clip: body parts inside furniture / props (worst depth per actor+part over the shot, every 2nd frame)
    const furniture = setSolids(SETS[s3.set] ? s3.set : 'suburb', s3.variant ?? 0);
    const clipWorst = new Map<string, { id: string; part: string; depth: number; t: number; what: string; size: string; at: Vec3 }>();
    for (let f = 0; f < n; f++) {
      const t = f / fps;
      const sc = evalShot(ctx, t, cast, prev);
      frames++;
      const live = sc.states.filter(s => !s.spec.ghost);
      // swapper visible while blinking
      if (sc.swap && f === Math.round(Math.max(0, sc.swap.t - 0.3) * fps)) {
        const sw = sc.byId[sc.swap.ids[0]];
        if (sw && !inFrame(project(sw.anchors.head, sc.cam, W, H), 0.0))
          add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'framing', msg: `the swapper ${sc.swap.ids[0]} is off-screen during the blink (t=${t.toFixed(2)} s) — the viewer can't see who swaps; frame them, or accept if the shot is meant to reveal them` }, `${i}|swapperoff`);
      }
      // overlap: two bodies in the same space
      for (let a = 0; a < live.length; a++)
        for (let b = a + 1; b < live.length; b++) {
          const A = live[a], B = live[b];
          const d = Math.hypot(A.pos[0] - B.pos[0], A.pos[2] - B.pos[2]);
          const near = d < 0.42 * Math.min(A.scale, B.scale) + 0.05 && Math.abs(A.pos[1] - B.pos[1]) < 0.6;
          if (near && !(A.spec as { contact?: boolean }).contact && !(B.spec as { contact?: boolean }).contact)
            add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'overlap', msg: `${A.spec.id} and ${B.spec.id} occupy the same spot (${d.toFixed(2)} m apart) from t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|overlap|${A.spec.id}|${B.spec.id}`);
        }
      // swap contract
      if (sc.swap && t >= sc.swap.t + 0.02 && t < sc.swap.t + 0.1 && !sc.swap.keepPaths) {
        const [p0, p1] = sc.swap.pre;
        const s0 = sc.byId[sc.swap.ids[0]], s1 = sc.byId[sc.swap.ids[1]];
        const d0 = s0 ? Math.hypot(s0.pos[0] - (p1.pos as number[])[0], s0.pos[2] - (p1.pos as number[])[2]) : 99;
        const d1 = s1 ? Math.hypot(s1.pos[0] - (p0.pos as number[])[0], s1.pos[2] - (p0.pos as number[])[2]) : 99;
        if (d0 > 0.05 || d1 > 0.05) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'swap', msg: `swap did not trade places: ${sc.swap.ids[0]} is ${d0.toFixed(2)} m from ${sc.swap.ids[1]}'s old spot, ${sc.swap.ids[1]} is ${d1.toFixed(2)} m from ${sc.swap.ids[0]}'s` }, `${i}|swapcontract`);
      }
      if (sc.swap && f === Math.round(sc.swap.t * fps)) events.push({ shot: i, id: sid, t: sc.swap.t, kind: 'swap', what: `${sc.swap.ids[0]} ⇄ ${sc.swap.ids[1]}` });
      // camera behind a wall / outside the room (the engine pulls it in, but the framing is then tighter than written)
      if (sc.camOut > 0.05) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'camera', msg: `camera was ${sc.camOut.toFixed(2)} m outside the room walls at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s; it is pulled inside along its sight line, so the framing is tighter than specified — check it, or move the camera` }, `${i}|camout`);
      // camera inside a character
      for (const s of live) {
        if (sc.cam.pos.distanceTo(s.anchors.head) < 0.42 * s.scale) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'camera', msg: `camera is inside ${s.spec.id}'s head at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|camin|${s.spec.id}`);
      }
      // framing of camera targets
      for (const id of targetsOf(sc.beatSpec)) {
        const s = sc.byId[id];
        if (!s) continue;
        const head = project(s.anchors.head, sc.cam, W, H), feet = project(s.anchors.feet, sc.cam, W, H);
        if (!head.visible) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'framing', msg: `camera target ${id} is behind the camera at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|behind|${id}`);
        else if (!inFrame(head, 0.0)) add({ sev: 'error', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'framing', msg: `camera target ${id}'s head leaves the frame at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|headout|${id}`);
        const shotSize = sc.beatSpec?.shot || 'medium';
        // a close that doesn't show the face (bowed head, back or profile to the lens) reads as a black disc
        if (['close', 'xclose'].includes(shotSize) && head.visible && id === targetsOf(sc.beatSpec)[0]) {
          const face = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1).transformDirection(s.bones.head);
          if (face.dot(sc.cam.pos.clone().sub(s.anchors.head).normalize()) < 0.5) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'framing', msg: `${shotSize} on ${id} but the face is turned away from the lens at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s (sub-cut ${sc.beat}) (bowed head / back / profile): it reads as a black disc — change the angle, lift the head or widen the shot` }, `${i}|faceaway|${id}`);
        }
        // 9:16 safety: the subject's head must sit inside the centre column a vertical cut keeps (608 of 1920 px)
        const band = (H * 9) / 16 / 2;
        if (head.visible && inFrame(head, 0.0) && Math.abs(head.x - W / 2) > band) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'vertical', msg: `${id}'s head is outside the 9:16 centre column at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s (x=${head.x.toFixed(0)} px) — a vertical cut loses them` }, `${i}|vert|${id}`);
        if (['full', 'wide'].includes(shotSize) && head.visible && !inFrame(feet, 0.0)) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'framing', msg: `${shotSize} shot but ${id}'s feet are out of frame at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|feetout|${id}`);
        const px = Math.abs(feet.y - head.y) + 0.24 * (H / 2);
        if (shotSize === 'wide' && head.visible && feet.visible && Math.abs(feet.y - head.y) < 60) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'framing', msg: `${id} is tiny in frame (${Math.abs(feet.y - head.y).toFixed(0)} px tall)` }, `${i}|tiny|${id}`);
        void px;
      }
      // speakers should be on screen while they talk
      for (const s of live) {
        const talking = (s.spec.talk || []).some(([a, b]) => t >= a && t <= b);
        if (talking && !inFrame(project(s.anchors.head, sc.cam, W, H), 0.0)) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'framing', msg: `${s.spec.id} talks off-screen at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|talkoff|${s.spec.id}`);
      }
      // grounding
      for (const s of live) {
        const foot = Math.min(at(s.bones.footL).y, at(s.bones.footR).y) - 0.045 * s.scale;
        const ground = s.pos[1];
        if (foot < ground - 0.07) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'grounding', msg: `${s.spec.id}'s feet sink ${(ground - foot).toFixed(2)} m into the floor at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|sink|${s.spec.id}`);
        if (foot > ground + 0.22 && !AIRBORNE(s)) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'grounding', msg: `${s.spec.id} floats ${(foot - ground).toFixed(2)} m above the floor at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|float|${s.spec.id}`);
      }
      // frame-to-frame snaps (inside the shot)
      if (prevStates && prevCam && f > 1) {
        // position step relative to the framing distance, and turn rate of the view direction
        const dist = Math.max(0.5, prevCam.pos.distanceTo(prevCam.look));
        const jump = sc.cam.pos.distanceTo(prevCam.pos) / dist;
        const turn = (sc.cam.look.clone().sub(sc.cam.pos).normalize().angleTo(prevCam.look.clone().sub(prevCam.pos).normalize()) * 180) / Math.PI;
        const allowed = sc.beat !== prevBeat || s3.camera?.move === 'shake' || s3.camera?.move === 'crashIn' || (s3.fx?.shake ?? 0) > 0;
        if ((jump > 0.12 || turn > 4.5) && !allowed) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'snap', msg: `camera ${jump > 0.12 ? `jumps ${(jump * 100).toFixed(0)}% of its distance` : `turns ${turn.toFixed(1)}°`} in one frame at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|camsnap`);
        for (const s of live) {
          const p = prevStates[s.spec.id];
          if (!p) continue;
          const moved = Math.hypot(s.pos[0] - p.pos[0], s.pos[2] - p.pos[2]);
          const nearSwap = sc.swap && Math.abs(t - sc.swap.t) < 0.06;
          if (moved > 0.5 && !nearSwap) {
            add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'teleport', msg: `${s.spec.id} moves ${moved.toFixed(2)} m in one frame at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s (fine for a path jump, check it in the review frames)` }, `${i}|tele|${s.spec.id}|${f}`);
            events.push({ shot: i, id: sid, t, kind: 'jump', what: `${s.spec.id} moves ${moved.toFixed(1)} m` });
          }
          const pd = poseDelta(p, s);
          if (pd > 38 && !nearSwap) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t, check: 'snap', msg: `${s.spec.id}'s pose snaps ${pd.toFixed(0)}° in one frame at t=${t.toFixed(2)} s` }, `${i}|posesnap|${s.spec.id}`);
        }
      }
      for (const s of live) {
        const seen = inFrame(project(s.anchors.head, sc.cam, W, H), 0.0) || inFrame(project(s.anchors.hips, sc.cam, W, H), 0.0);
        const p = prevStates?.[s.spec.id];
        const moving = !!p && Math.hypot(s.pos[0] - p.pos[0], s.pos[2] - p.pos[2]) > 0.6 / fps;
        const h = (hidden[s.spec.id] ||= [{ moving: 0, lastSeen: -1, from: -1, to: -1 }])[0];
        if (seen) h.lastSeen = t;
        else if (moving) { h.moving += 1 / fps; if (h.from < 0) h.from = t; h.to = t; }
        if (seen && h.from >= 0 && h.moving > 1.0)
          add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t: h.from, check: 'framing', msg: `${s.spec.id} moves off-screen for ${h.moving.toFixed(1)} s (t=${h.from.toFixed(2)}–${h.to.toFixed(2)}) before appearing — the viewer misses the action; pan/track the camera (camera.to + moveAt) or start them in frame` }, `${i}|hiddenmove|${s.spec.id}`);
      }
      prevStates = {};
      for (const s of live) prevStates[s.spec.id] = s;
      prevCam = sc.cam;
      prevBeat = sc.beat;
      if (f % 2 === 0) {
        const solids = [...furniture, ...propSolids(sc.props, t)];
        for (const st of live)
          for (const c of clipsOf(st, solids)) {
            const k = `${st.spec.id}|${c.part}`, w = clipWorst.get(k);
            if (!w || c.depth > w.depth) clipWorst.set(k, { id: st.spec.id, part: c.part, depth: c.depth, t, what: c.solid.what, size: c.solid.size, at: c.solid.at });
          }
      }
    }
    // one finding per actor+part. Head/chest fill the frame, so 2 cm past contact is already visible (error);
    // a limb is an error from 6 cm; shallower ones are warnings to check in the review frames
    // (under 3 cm a limb clip doesn't show on screen, under 2 cm a head/chest one: not reported)
    const shown = [...clipWorst.values()].filter(w => w.depth >= (/^(head|chest)/.test(w.part) ? 0.02 : 0.03));
    shown.forEach(w => add({
      sev: w.depth > (/^(head|chest)/.test(w.part) ? 0.02 : 0.06) ? 'error' : 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, t: w.t, check: 'clip',
      msg: `${w.id}'s ${w.part} goes ${(w.depth * 100).toFixed(0)} cm into ${w.what} (${w.size} m at [${w.at.join(', ')}]) at t=${w.t.toFixed(2)} s — move the actor/prop, change the pose, or seat them properly`,
    }, `${i}|clip|${w.id}|${w.part}`));
    // one review event per actor (their deepest clip), so review.mjs renders the moment for the reviewer
    const perActor = new Map<string, (typeof shown)[number]>();
    shown.forEach(w => { const b2 = perActor.get(w.id); if (!b2 || w.depth > b2.depth) perActor.set(w.id, w); });
    perActor.forEach(w => events.push({ shot: i, id: sid, t: w.t, kind: 'clip', what: `${w.id}'s ${w.part} ${(w.depth * 100).toFixed(0)} cm into ${w.what}` }));
    // something should be visible in a shot that has characters
    const mid = evalShot(ctx, ctx.dur * 0.6, cast, prev);
    if (mid.states.length && !mid.states.some(s => inFrame(project(s.anchors.head, mid.cam, W, H), 0.0)))
      add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sid, check: 'framing', msg: 'no character is visible at mid-shot' });
  });
  // shorts the user cuts by hand from the 16:9: at least 4 per long episode, each 60–95 s of whole shots
  const ids = ep.shots.map(s => s.id);
  const long = timing.total > 240;
  // house rule (user, 2026-11-09): every long episode runs at least 10:00
  if (long && !timing.draft && timing.total < 600) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: 0, check: 'length', msg: `episode runs ${Math.floor(timing.total / 60)}:${String(Math.round(timing.total % 60)).padStart(2, '0')} — the house minimum is 10:00 (add narration: an extra problem, rule test or world-bigger scene)` });
  if (long && timing.draft && timing.total < 600) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: 0, check: 'length', msg: `draft estimate ${Math.floor(timing.total / 60)}:${String(Math.round(timing.total % 60)).padStart(2, '0')} — the house minimum is 10:00; write more before buying voice` });
  // retention hook (user rule, 2026-11-09, new episodes only): the first 10 s need fast cutting, an early sound and a punchy move.
  // That the power shows by 0:08 needs a reader: COLA "Primeiros 10 s".
  if (long && ep.hookCheck !== false) {
    let cuts = 0, sfxEarly = false, punch = false;
    ep.shots.forEach((sh, i) => {
      const tm = timing.shots[i];
      if (!tm || tm.start >= 10) return;
      if (i > 0) cuts++;
      if (sh.kind !== 'card') {
        const s3 = sh as Shot3D;
        beatsOf(ctxOf(i)).forEach(b => { if (b.t0 > 0 && tm.start + b.t0 < 10) cuts++; });
        const mv = s3.camera?.move;
        if (mv === 'crashIn' || mv === 'shake' || ['smash', 'whip', 'zoom'].includes(s3.cut || '') || s3.fx?.freeze !== undefined || s3.fx?.speedLines || (s3.fx?.shake ?? 0) > 0) punch = true;
      }
      for (const c of sh.sfx || []) if (tm.start + cue(c.t as number | string, tm.words, 0) <= 2) sfxEarly = true;
    });
    if (cuts < 6) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: 0, check: 'hook', msg: `only ${cuts} cut(s) in the first 10 s — the house hook wants ≥ 6 (1–1.5 s shots: coverage 'fast', camera.beats, or shorter shots)` });
    if (!sfxEarly) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: 0, check: 'hook', msg: 'no scripted sound effect in the first 2 s — open on a strong SFX (ring, whoosh, impact) under the first line' });
    if (!punch) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: 0, check: 'hook', msg: "no punchy move in the first 10 s — use a crashIn, a smash/whip cut, a freeze or speed lines on the power's first use" });
  }
  // 9:16 safety for important 2D overlays on 3D shots: corner HUDs fall outside the centre column a vertical cut keeps
  ep.shots.forEach((sh, i) => {
    if (sh.kind === 'card') return;
    for (const o of sh.overlays || []) {
      const x = o as { type: string; corner?: string; pos?: string; safe?: boolean };
      const out = (x.type === 'stopwatch' && x.corner !== 'tc' && x.corner !== 'bc') || x.type === 'label' || (x.type === 'stat' && x.pos !== 'center') || (x.type === 'news' && !x.safe);
      if (out) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: i, id: sh.id, check: 'vertical', msg: `${x.type} overlay sits outside the 9:16 centre column — a vertical cut loses it (stopwatch corner "tc"/"bc", news safe:true, stat pos "center", or a "word" overlay)` }, `${i}|vov|${x.type}`);
    }
  });
  if (long && (ep.clips?.length ?? 0) < 4) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: 0, check: 'clips', msg: `${ep.clips?.length ?? 0} short clip(s) marked — a long episode needs ≥ 4 self-contained ~90 s clips (episode.clips)` });
  for (const c of ep.clips || []) {
    const a = ids.indexOf(c.from), b = ids.indexOf(c.to);
    if (a < 0 || b < 0 || b < a) { add({ sev: 'error', shot: Math.max(0, a), check: 'clips', msg: `clip "${c.title}": shot ids ${c.from}…${c.to} not found or out of order` }); continue; }
    const t0 = timing.shots[a].start, t1 = timing.shots[b].start + timing.shots[b].dur, d = t1 - t0;
    const tc = (x: number) => `${Math.floor(x / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(x % 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    if (d < 60 || d > 95) add({ sev: 'warn', shot: a, id: c.from, check: 'clips', msg: `clip "${c.title}" (${tc(t0)}–${tc(t1)}) runs ${d.toFixed(0)} s — aim for 75–90 s (60–95 ok)` });
  }
  return { findings, events, flows, frames };
}

export function formatReport(r: AuditReport, slug: string) {
  const errs = r.findings.filter(f => f.sev === 'error'), warns = r.findings.filter(f => f.sev === 'warn');
  const lines = [`scene audit: ${slug} — ${r.frames} frames checked, ${errs.length} error(s), ${warns.length} warning(s), ${r.flows.filter(f => f.on).length} flowing moves`];
  for (const f of [...errs, ...warns]) lines.push(`${f.sev === 'error' ? 'ERROR' : 'warn '}  #${f.shot} ${f.id || ''}  [${f.check}]  ${f.msg}`);
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export { THREE };

// Camera solver: turns a high-level CameraSpec ("close on hero, 30° to his left, push in")
// into a CamState for time t, re-framing every frame so moving actors stay framed.
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { ActorState } from '../engine/actor';
import { camAt, noise1, shake, type CamKey, type CamState } from '../engine/cam';
import type { CameraSpec, Vec3 } from '../types';

// Visible frame height (m) per shot size, and default elevation (deg).
const SIZE: Record<string, { h: number; el: number; focus: 'head' | 'chest' | 'hips' | 'ground' }> = {
  insert: { h: 0.35, el: 12, focus: 'chest' },
  xclose: { h: 0.56, el: 2, focus: 'head' },
  close: { h: 0.8, el: 4, focus: 'head' },
  medium: { h: 1.35, el: 6, focus: 'chest' },
  full: { h: 2.4, el: 8, focus: 'hips' },
  wide: { h: 5.5, el: 12, focus: 'hips' },
  establishing: { h: 16, el: 18, focus: 'ground' },
};

const easeInOut = (x: number) => (x < 0.5 ? 2 * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 2) / 2);
const D2R = Math.PI / 180;

function anchorOf(a: ActorState, focus: string): THREE.Vector3 {
  switch (focus) {
    case 'head': return a.anchors.head.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.03, 0));
    case 'chest': return a.anchors.chest.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.12, 0));
    case 'hips': return a.anchors.hips.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.05, 0));
    case 'feet': return a.anchors.feet.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.2, 0));
    case 'handL': return a.anchors.handL.clone();
    case 'handR': return a.anchors.handR.clone();
    default: return a.anchors.feet.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.0, 0));
  }
}

export function solveCamera(
  spec: CameraSpec | undefined,
  t: number,
  dur: number,
  actors: Record<string, ActorState>,
  fallback: Vec3,
  rot0?: Record<string, number>, // actors' facing at shot start: the camera orients on these, so it never flips when a target turns
): CamState {
  const s: CameraSpec = spec || {};
  const k = dur > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / dur)) : 0;
  const ke = easeInOut(k);
  const amt = s.amount ?? 1;

  // explicit keyframes (times already cue-resolved by evalShot)
  if (s.path?.length) {
    const keys: CamKey[] = s.path.map(k => ({ t: k.t as number, pos: k.pos, look: k.look, fov: k.fov ?? s.fov ?? 32, roll: s.dutch ?? 0, ease: k.ease }));
    return finish(camAt(keys, t), s, t, amt);
  }
  // explicit placement (optionally animated to `to`)
  if (s.pos && s.look) {
    const [m0, m1] = (s.moveAt as [number, number] | undefined) ?? [0, dur]; // cues are resolved by evalShot
    const keys: CamKey[] = [{ t: m0, pos: s.pos, look: s.look, fov: s.fov ?? 32, roll: s.dutch ?? 0 }];
    if (s.to) keys.push({ t: Math.max(m0 + 0.1, m1), pos: s.to.pos, look: s.to.look, fov: s.fov ?? 32, roll: s.dutch ?? 0, ease: s.ease });
    return finish(camAt(keys, t), s, t, amt);
  }

  const size = SIZE[s.shot || 'medium'] || SIZE.medium;
  const fov = s.fov ?? (s.shot === 'establishing' ? 40 : s.shot === 'wide' ? 36 : 32);
  const ids = Array.isArray(s.target) ? s.target : typeof s.target === 'string' ? [s.target] : [];
  const list = ids.map(id => actors[id]).filter(Boolean);
  const first = list[0] || Object.values(actors)[0];

  // focus point and frame height
  let focus: THREE.Vector3;
  let h = size.h;
  if (Array.isArray(s.target) && s.target.length === 3 && typeof s.target[0] === 'number') {
    focus = new THREE.Vector3(...(s.target as unknown as Vec3));
  } else if (list.length > 1) {
    const pts = list.map(a => anchorOf(a, s.focus || size.focus));
    focus = pts.reduce((acc, p) => acc.add(p), new THREE.Vector3()).multiplyScalar(1 / pts.length);
    const spread = Math.max(...pts.map(p => p.distanceTo(focus))) * 2;
    h = Math.max(h, spread * 0.75 + 0.6);
  } else if (first) {
    focus = anchorOf(first, s.focus || size.focus);
  } else {
    focus = new THREE.Vector3(...fallback);
  }
  if (s.shot === 'establishing') focus.y = Math.max(focus.y, 1.5);

  // orientation: relative to the (first) target actor's facing, else world (+z side)
  const firstId = list[0] ? ids[0] : Object.keys(actors)[0];
  const baseYaw = first && !(Array.isArray(s.target) && typeof s.target[0] === 'number') ? rot0?.[firstId] ?? first.rot : 0;
  let yaw = baseYaw + (s.angle ?? 20);
  let el = s.height ?? size.el;
  let dist = s.dist ?? h / 2 / Math.tan((fov * D2R) / 2);
  const look = focus.clone();

  switch (s.move || 'drift') {
    // raised 2026-11-09 ("move the camera more"): the default drift is a visible arc, plus a push on medium
    // and tighter sizes only (a bigger push crops the feet of a full/wide shot). Written moves keep their size.
    case 'drift': yaw += 10 * ke * amt; dist *= 1 - (h < 2 ? 0.12 : 0.05) * ke * amt; break;
    case 'pushIn': dist *= 1 - 0.22 * ke * amt; break;
    case 'pullOut': dist *= 0.82 + 0.25 * ke * amt; break;
    case 'orbitL': yaw -= 28 * ke * amt; break;
    case 'orbitR': yaw += 28 * ke * amt; break;
    case 'craneUp': el += 14 * ke * amt; break;
    case 'craneDown': el -= 12 * ke * amt; break;
    case 'crashIn': dist *= 1 - 0.3 * amt * (1 - Math.pow(1 - Math.min(1, k * 5), 4)); break;
    default: break;
  }

  // over-the-shoulder: sit behind `over` actor's shoulder, looking at the focus
  if (s.over && actors[s.over]) {
    const o = actors[s.over];
    const fwd = focus.clone().sub(o.anchors.head).setY(0).normalize();
    const right = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(fwd, new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0)).normalize();
    const back = s.dist ?? 0.85; // further back = smaller shoulder in frame
    const pos = o.anchors.head.clone().addScaledVector(fwd, -back).addScaledVector(right, 0.38 * Math.sqrt(back / 0.85)).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.06 + 0.08 * (back - 0.85), 0));
    return finish({ pos, look: focus.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.04, 0)), fov: s.fov ?? 34, roll: s.dutch ?? 0 }, s, t, amt);
  }

  // never closer than ~2.4 head radii to a face, or the lens ends up inside the head
  if ((s.focus || size.focus) === 'head') dist = Math.max(dist, 0.62);
  const y = yaw * D2R, e = el * D2R;
  const pos = focus.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(y) * Math.cos(e), Math.sin(e), Math.cos(y) * Math.cos(e)).multiplyScalar(dist));
  if (s.move === 'truckL' || s.move === 'truckR') {
    const right = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(y), 0, -Math.sin(y)).multiplyScalar((s.move === 'truckR' ? 1 : -1) * 0.7 * ke * amt * Math.max(1, h / 1.5));
    pos.add(right);
    look.add(right);
  }
  return finish({ pos, look, fov, roll: s.dutch ?? 0 }, s, t, amt);
}

function finish(c: CamState, s: CameraSpec, t: number, amt: number): CamState {
  // keep the camera above the floor
  if (c.pos.y < 0.15) c.pos.y = 0.15;
  if (s.move === 'shake') return shake(c, t, 0.03 * amt, 16, 3);
  if (s.move === 'handheld') return shake(c, t, 0.012 * amt, 3.5, 7);
  // every shot breathes a little, like IFOLOGY's constantly moving camera
  const b = 0.007;
  return { ...c, pos: c.pos.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(noise1(t * 0.7, 1) * b, noise1(t * 0.6, 2) * b, 0)) };
}

// Clip audit: does any part of a character go INTO a solid object (set furniture or a scene prop)?
// Sets record their solid primitives through Batch (sets/roomkit.ts, SetDef.solids); free-standing props
// use the stand-ins in sets/solids.ts. Bodies are spheres (head, chest, hips, hands, forearms, elbows, thighs,
// knees, shins, ankles) and the audit measures how far each primitive cuts into each sphere, in metres — so a
// 4 cm desk top through a head counts. Light contact (a hand on a desk, thighs on a seat) stays under tolerance.
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { DIM, type ActorState } from '../engine/actor';
import { SETS } from '../sets';
import { Batch, collectSolids, type SolidPrim } from '../sets/roomkit';
import { solidBed, solidCar, solidChair, solidTable } from '../sets/solids';
import type { PropSpec, Vec3 } from '../types';

export type Solid = { shape: SolidPrim['shape']; m: THREE.Matrix4; inv: THREE.Matrix4; s: THREE.Vector3; min: THREE.Vector3; max: THREE.Vector3; what: string; size: string; at: Vec3 };

const UNIT: Record<Solid['shape'], [number, number, number]> = { box: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5], cyl: [1, 0.5, 1], sphere: [1, 1, 1] };

function toSolid(p: SolidPrim, what: string): Solid {
  const pos = new THREE.Vector3(), q = new THREE.Quaternion(), s = new THREE.Vector3();
  p.m.decompose(pos, q, s);
  const [ux, uy, uz] = UNIT[p.shape];
  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  for (const x of [-ux, ux]) for (const y of [-uy, uy]) for (const z of [-uz, uz]) box.expandByPoint(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z).applyMatrix4(p.m));
  const dims = [2 * ux * Math.abs(s.x), 2 * uy * Math.abs(s.y), 2 * uz * Math.abs(s.z)];
  return {
    shape: p.shape, m: p.m, inv: p.m.clone().invert(), s: new THREE.Vector3(Math.abs(s.x), Math.abs(s.y), Math.abs(s.z)), min: box.min, max: box.max,
    what, size: dims.map(v => v.toFixed(2)).join('×'), at: [+pos.x.toFixed(2), +pos.y.toFixed(2), +pos.z.toFixed(2)],
  };
}

/** Depth (m) of a world point inside a solid; ≤ 0 = outside. */
export function depthIn(sol: Solid, p: THREE.Vector3): number {
  if (p.x < sol.min.x || p.y < sol.min.y || p.z < sol.min.z || p.x > sol.max.x || p.y > sol.max.y || p.z > sol.max.z) return -1;
  const q = p.clone().applyMatrix4(sol.inv), s = sol.s;
  if (sol.shape === 'box') return Math.min((0.5 - Math.abs(q.x)) * s.x, (0.5 - Math.abs(q.y)) * s.y, (0.5 - Math.abs(q.z)) * s.z);
  if (sol.shape === 'cyl') return Math.min((1 - Math.hypot(q.x, q.z)) * Math.min(s.x, s.z), (0.5 - Math.abs(q.y)) * s.y);
  return (1 - q.length()) * Math.min(s.x, s.y, s.z);
}

/** How far a solid cuts into a sphere (centre c, radius r), in metres; ≤ 0 = no contact. A thin desk top
 *  through a head counts fully (that's what shows), unlike a point-depth test. */
export function sphereCut(sol: Solid, c: THREE.Vector3, r: number): number {
  if (c.x < sol.min.x - r || c.y < sol.min.y - r || c.z < sol.min.z - r || c.x > sol.max.x + r || c.y > sol.max.y + r || c.z > sol.max.z + r) return -1;
  const inside = depthIn(sol, c);
  if (inside > 0) return r + inside;
  const q = c.clone().applyMatrix4(sol.inv);
  if (sol.shape === 'box') q.set(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(q.x, -0.5, 0.5), THREE.MathUtils.clamp(q.y, -0.5, 0.5), THREE.MathUtils.clamp(q.z, -0.5, 0.5));
  else if (sol.shape === 'cyl') {
    const h = Math.hypot(q.x, q.z);
    if (h > 1) { q.x /= h; q.z /= h; }
    q.y = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(q.y, -0.5, 0.5);
  } else if (q.length() > 1) q.normalize();
  return r - c.distanceTo(q.applyMatrix4(sol.m));
}

const setCache = new Map<string, Solid[]>();
/** The set's furniture solids (cached per set + variant). Outdoor sets have none registered yet. */
export function setSolids(setKey: string, variant = 0): Solid[] {
  const key = `${setKey}|${variant}`;
  let out = setCache.get(key);
  if (!out) {
    const builds = SETS[setKey]?.solids?.(variant) || [];
    // floor coverings (rugs, tiles, mats: thin and at floor level) are walked on, not solid
    out = collectSolids(builds).map(p => toSolid(p, `${setKey} ${p.from}`)).filter(x => x.max.y > 0.05);
    setCache.set(key, out);
  }
  return out;
}

const N = (v: unknown, d: number) => (typeof v === 'number' ? v : d);

/** Solids of the shot's free-standing props at time t (furniture-like types only; hand props don't count). */
export function propSolids(props: PropSpec[], t: number): Solid[] {
  const b = new Batch(false);
  props.forEach((p, i) => {
    let pos: Vec3 = p.pos || [0, 0, 0];
    let r = p.rot;
    const pts = p.path;
    if (pts?.length) {
      if (t <= pts[0].t) pos = pts[0].pos;
      else if (t >= pts[pts.length - 1].t) pos = pts[pts.length - 1].pos;
      else for (let k = 0; k < pts.length - 1; k++) if (t >= pts[k].t && t < pts[k + 1].t) {
        const u = (t - pts[k].t) / (pts[k + 1].t - pts[k].t);
        pos = pts[k].pos.map((v, j) => v + (pts[k + 1].pos[j] - v) * u) as Vec3;
      }
    }
    const rr: Vec3 = typeof r === 'number' ? [0, (r * Math.PI) / 180, 0] : r ? (r.map(v => (v * Math.PI) / 180) as Vec3) : [0, 0, 0];
    b.from = `prop #${i} ${p.type}`;
    b.at(pos, rr, () => {
      switch (p.type) {
        case 'table': solidTable(b, [0, 0, 0], 0, N(p.w, 1.4), N(p.d, 0.8)); break;
        case 'roundTable': solidTable(b, [0, 0, 0], 0, N(p.w, 0.9), 0.9, 0.75, true); break;
        case 'desk': solidTable(b, [0, 0, 0], 0, 1.4, 0.7, 0.75); break;
        case 'chair': solidChair(b, [0, 0, 0]); break;
        case 'bed': solidBed(b, [0, 0, 0]); break;
        case 'car': solidCar(b, [0, 0, 0]); break;
        case 'box': case 'crate': b.box([0, N(p.h, 0.5) / 2, 0], [N(p.w, 0.5), N(p.h, 0.5), N(p.d, 0.5)], '#000'); break;
        case 'pillar': b.add('cyl', '#000', [0, N(p.h, 3) / 2, 0], [N(p.w, 0.3), N(p.h, 3), N(p.w, 0.3)]); break;
        case 'wall': b.box([0, N(p.h, 3) / 2, 0], [N(p.w, 4), N(p.h, 3), 0.15], '#000'); break;
        default: break;
      }
    }, p.scale ?? 1);
  });
  return b.solids.map(x => toSolid(x, x.from));
}

const pos = (m: THREE.Matrix4) => new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(m);

/** The body as spheres (centre, radius, and how much contact is fine: a hand resting on a desk, thighs on a seat). */
export function bodySpheres(a: ActorState): { part: string; p: THREE.Vector3; r: number; tol: number }[] {
  const B = a.bones, head = a.anchors.head, k = a.scale;
  const r = head.distanceTo(a.anchors.headTop) / 1.15;
  // radii from the rig (DIM.limbR = 3 cm sticks); tolerances let resting contact pass (hands on a desk, a seat)
  const L = DIM.limbR * k;
  const out = [
    { part: 'head', p: head.clone(), r, tol: 0.005 }, // the head fills the frame: 2 cm into a desk already shows
    { part: 'chest', p: a.anchors.chest.clone(), r: 0.1 * k, tol: 0.02 },
    { part: 'hips', p: a.anchors.hips.clone(), r: 0.05 * k, tol: 0.03 },
  ];
  for (const sd of ['L', 'R'] as const) {
    const hand = a.anchors[`hand${sd}`], elbow = pos(B[`forearm${sd}`]), hip = pos(B[`thigh${sd}`]), knee = pos(B[`shin${sd}`]), ankle = pos(B[`foot${sd}`]);
    out.push(
      { part: `hand ${sd}`, p: hand.clone(), r: 0.045 * k, tol: 0.025 },
      { part: `forearm ${sd}`, p: elbow.clone().lerp(hand, 0.5), r: L, tol: 0.02 },
      { part: `elbow ${sd}`, p: elbow, r: L, tol: 0.02 },
      { part: `thigh ${sd}`, p: hip.clone().lerp(knee, 0.5), r: L, tol: 0.02 },
      { part: `knee ${sd}`, p: knee, r: L, tol: 0.02 },
      { part: `shin ${sd}`, p: knee.clone().lerp(ankle, 0.5), r: L, tol: 0.02 },
      { part: `ankle ${sd}`, p: ankle, r: L, tol: 0.02 },
    );
  }
  return out;
}

export type Clip = { part: string; depth: number; solid: Solid };

/** The deepest clip of each body part into any of `solids` (only cuts beyond the part's tolerance). */
export function clipsOf(a: ActorState, solids: Solid[]): Clip[] {
  if (!solids.length) return [];
  const parts = bodySpheres(a);
  // broad phase: solids whose box meets the body's box
  const bb = new THREE.Box3();
  parts.forEach(x => bb.expandByPoint(x.p));
  bb.expandByScalar(0.2);
  const near = solids.filter(s => !(s.max.x < bb.min.x || s.min.x > bb.max.x || s.max.y < bb.min.y || s.min.y > bb.max.y || s.max.z < bb.min.z || s.min.z > bb.max.z));
  if (!near.length) return [];
  const best = new Map<string, Clip>();
  for (const x of parts) {
    // hips/legs whose centre is above a surface are resting on it (sitting, standing on a crate): not a clip.
    // Head, chest and hands get no such pass — a head sunk into a desk still has its centre above the top.
    const rests = /^(hips|thigh|knee|ankle)/.test(x.part);
    for (const s of near) {
      if (rests && x.p.y >= s.max.y - (x.part === 'hips' ? 0.04 : 0.01)) continue; // a seated pelvis sits ~3 cm into the seat line
      const d = sphereCut(s, x.p, x.r) - x.tol;
      if (d > 0 && (!best.has(x.part) || best.get(x.part)!.depth < d)) best.set(x.part, { part: x.part, depth: d, solid: s });
    }
  }
  return [...best.values()];
}

// Word cues: any effect time can be a number (seconds into the shot) or "@word", "@word#2",
// "@word+0.15" — resolved against the aligned narration so effects land on the spoken word.
export type Words = [string, number][] | undefined;

export function cue(spec: number | string | undefined, words: Words, fallback = 0): number {
  if (spec === undefined) return fallback;
  if (typeof spec === 'number') return spec;
  const m = /^@([\p{L}\p{N}']+)(?:#(\d+))?([+-][\d.]+)?$/iu.exec(spec.trim());
  if (!m) return fallback;
  const word = m[1].toLowerCase(), nth = m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 1, off = m[3] ? parseFloat(m[3]) : 0;
  const hits = (words || []).filter(([w]) => w === word);
  const hit = hits[nth - 1] || hits[hits.length - 1];
  return hit ? hit[1] + off : fallback;
}
