// Dispatches episode overlay specs (labels, titles, stats, bubbles…) onto overlay components.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { Flash } from '../overlays/Energy';
import { StatCallout } from '../overlays/Stat';
import { TitleOverlay } from '../overlays/TitleOverlay';
import { Label } from '../overlays/Label';
import { Stopwatch } from '../overlays/Stopwatch';
import { Bubble } from '../overlays/Bubble';
import { CrushMeter } from '../overlays/CrushMeter';
import { NewsBar } from '../overlays/NewsBar';
import { KeyWord } from '../overlays/KeyWord';
import { BodyMenu, type MenuRow } from '../overlays/BodyMenu';
import type { Overlay } from '../types';

export type Projector = (actorId: string) => { x: number; y: number; visible: boolean; scale: number } | null;

const fmt = (v: number, decimals = 0) => v.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: decimals, maximumFractionDigits: decimals });

export const OverlayLayer: React.FC<{ overlays: Overlay[]; t: number; dur: number; project: Projector }> = ({ overlays, t, dur, project }) => (
  <>
    {overlays.map((o, i) => {
      const at = (o as { at?: number }).at ?? 0;
      const until = (o as { until?: number }).until ?? dur;
      const lt = t - at;
      if (lt < 0 || t > until) return null;
      switch (o.type) {
        case 'stat': {
          const num = typeof o.value === 'number' ? o.value : null;
          return (
            <StatCallout key={i} t={lt}
              big={k => `${o.prefix ?? ''}${num !== null ? fmt(num * k, o.decimals ?? 0) : o.value}${o.unit && o.unit.length <= 2 ? o.unit : ''}`}
              small={o.label || (o.unit && o.unit.length > 2) ? () => [o.unit && o.unit.length > 2 ? o.unit : '', o.label || ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ').toUpperCase() : undefined}
              x={o.pos === 'center' ? 960 : o.pos === 'right' ? 1810 : 110} y={o.pos === 'center' ? 380 : 90}
              align={o.pos === 'center' ? 'center' : o.pos === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left'} />
          );
        }
        case 'flash':
          return <Flash key={i} t={t} at={at} color={o.color} />;
        case 'caption':
          return (
            <AbsoluteFill key={i} style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end', alignItems: 'center', paddingBottom: 90 }}>
              <div style={{ fontFamily: 'Arial', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 46, color: '#fff', textShadow: '0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)', opacity: Math.min(1, lt / 0.15) }}>{o.text}</div>
            </AbsoluteFill>
          );
        default:
          return <OverlayExt key={i} o={o} t={lt} project={project} />;
      }
    })}
  </>
);

// Title / label / stopwatch / bubble overlays live in src/overlays.
const OverlayExt: React.FC<{ o: Overlay; t: number; project: Projector }> = ({ o, t, project }) => {
  const dur = (o as { until?: number; at?: number }).until !== undefined ? (o as { until: number }).until - ((o as { at?: number }).at ?? 0) : undefined;
  switch (o.type) {
    case 'title':
      return <TitleOverlay t={t} big={o.big} small={o.small} dur={dur} compact={o.compact} />;
    case 'label':
      return <Label t={t} text={o.text} corner={o.corner} dur={dur} />;
    case 'stopwatch':
      return <Stopwatch t={t} from={o.from || '0.00 s'} to={o.to} switchAt={(o as { switchAt?: number }).switchAt} dur={dur} persist={(o as { persist?: boolean }).persist} tick={(o as { tick?: number }).tick} keep={(o as { keep?: boolean }).keep} corner={(o as { corner?: 'tl' | 'tr' | 'bl' | 'br' | 'tc' | 'bc' }).corner} />;
    case 'news':
      return <NewsBar t={t} headline={o.headline} ticker={o.ticker} tag={(o as { tag?: string }).tag} dur={dur} safe={o.safe} />;
    case 'menu':
      return <BodyMenu t={t} rows={o.rows as MenuRow[]} title={o.title} note={o.note} noteAt={o.noteAt as number | undefined} alarm={o.alarm} y={o.y} dur={dur} />;
    case 'word':
      return <KeyWord t={t} text={o.text} color={o.color} y={o.y} dur={dur} />;
    case 'bubble':
    case 'thought': {
      const p = project(o.actor);
      if (!p || !p.visible) return null;
      return <Bubble t={t} text={o.text} x={p.x} y={p.y} kind={o.type === 'thought' ? 'thought' : 'speech'} gap={Math.max(30, 0.12 * p.scale)} dur={dur} />;
    }
    case 'crush': {
      const p = project(o.actor);
      if (!p || !p.visible) return null;
      return <CrushMeter t={t} x={p.x} y={p.y} value={o.value} from={o.from} countDur={o.countDur} scale={p.scale} dur={dur} />;
    }
    default:
      return null;
  }
};

// Turns episode.json shapes into engine shapes: set marks → coordinates, cast merge.
import { CAST } from '../cast';
import { SETS } from '../sets';
import type { ActorInShot, CastMember, Episode, EpisodeActor, Place, Vec3 } from '../types';

/** "desk" → the mark; "desk+0.5,0,1" → mark plus offset; [x,y,z] passes through. */
export function place(p: Place | undefined, set: string, fallback: Vec3 = [0, 0, 0]): Vec3 {
  if (p === undefined) return fallback;
  if (Array.isArray(p)) return p;
  const [name, off] = p.split('+');
  const marks = SETS[set]?.marks || {};
  const base = marks[name.trim()];
  if (!base) {
    console.warn(`unknown mark "${name}" in set "${set}"`);
    return fallback;
  }
  if (!off) return base;
  const o = off.split(',').map(Number);
  return [base[0] + (o[0] || 0), base[1] + (o[1] || 0), base[2] + (o[2] || 0)];
}

export function resolveActor(a: EpisodeActor, set: string): ActorInShot {
  const look = a.look;
  return {
    ...a,
    pos: place(a.pos, set, SETS[set]?.marks.center || [0, 0, 0]),
    path: a.path?.map(w => ({ ...w, pos: place(w.pos, set) })),
    look: look === undefined || look === 'camera' ? look : typeof look === 'string' && !SETS[set]?.marks[look.split('+')[0]] ? look : place(look as Place, set),
  } as ActorInShot;
}

export function castOf(ep: Episode): Record<string, CastMember> {
  // per-character merge: an episode entry like { bestie: { name: 'Caio' } } renames without dropping the outfit
  const out: Record<string, CastMember> = { ...CAST };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ep.cast || {})) out[k] = { ...(CAST[k] || {}), ...v };
  return out;
}

// Single source of truth for "what is where" in an episode shot at time t: actors (marks, word
// cues, swap power, continuity blending), camera (solver, shake, flow across near-identical cuts)
// and props. The renderer (ShotView), the scene audit, the self-tests and the review overlay all
// call evalShot, so what gets checked is exactly what gets drawn.
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { blendStates, evalActor, type ActorState } from '../engine/actor';
import { impulse, project, pxPerMetre, shake, type CamState } from '../engine/cam';
import { ease } from '../engine/rig';
import { SETS, type SetDef } from '../sets';
import type { ActorInShot, CameraSpec, CastMember, PropSpec, Shot3D, Vec3 } from '../types';
import { solveCamera } from './camsolve';
import { cue, type Words } from './cue';
import { place, resolveActor } from './resolve';

const W = 1920, H = 1080;

export type ShotCtx = { shot: Shot3D; dur: number; start: number; words?: Words };
export type SwapInfo = { t: number; ids: [string, string]; keepPaths?: boolean; pre: [ActorInShot, ActorInShot] };
export type FlowInfo = { on: boolean; camBlend: number; actorBlend: number; reason: string; screenShift?: number; angle?: number; scale?: number };
export type SceneState = {
  setKey: string;
  def: SetDef;
  palKey: string;
  actors: ActorInShot[];
  states: ActorState[];
  byId: Record<string, ActorState>;
  cam: CamState;
  swap?: SwapInfo;
  frozen: boolean;
  props: PropSpec[];
  flow?: FlowInfo;
  camOut: number; // metres the camera was pulled back inside the room walls (0 = it was inside)
  beat: number; // index of the current sub-cut (0 = the framing as written)
  beatSpec?: CameraSpec; // the camera spec this beat actually used (after the tight-beat guard)
};

/** Stable per-character seed, so breathing/blinks don't jump when the same character is in the next shot. */
export function seedOf(id: string, dup = 0) {
  let h = 7;
  for (const c of id) h = (h * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) % 100003;
  return (h % 997) * 0.37 + dup * 5.1;
}

/** Resolve marks + word cues, then apply the swap power. Swapper = swap.ids[0]. */
export function resolveShotActors(shot: Shot3D, t: number, words: Words, setKey: string): { actors: ActorInShot[]; swap?: SwapInfo } {
  let actors = (shot.actors || []).filter(a => !a.hidden).map(a => resolveActor({
    ...a,
    poses: a.poses?.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t as number | string, words, 0) })),
    faces: a.faces?.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t as number | string, words, 0) })),
    path: a.path?.map(w => ({ ...w, t: cue(w.t as number | string, words, 0) })),
  }, setKey));
  const sw = shot.fx?.swap;
  if (!sw) return { actors };
  const st = cue(sw.t, words, 0.5);
  const i0 = actors.findIndex(a => a.id === sw.ids[0]);
  const i1 = actors.findIndex(a => a.id === sw.ids[1]);
  if (i0 < 0 || i1 < 0) return { actors };
  const pre: [ActorInShot, ActorInShot] = [actors[i0], actors[i1]];
  const blink = (eyes: number) => ({ eyes, brow: -0.35, mouth: 0.35 });
  actors = actors.map((a, i) => {
    if (i === i0) {
      const faces = [...(a.faces || []), { t: st - 0.42, face: blink(0.05), blend: 0.04 }, { t: st - 0.31, face: blink(1), blend: 0.04 },
        { t: st - 0.2, face: blink(0.05), blend: 0.04 }, { t: st - 0.09, face: blink(1), blend: 0.04 }];
      return t >= st && !sw.keepPaths ? { ...a, faces, pos: pre[1].pos, rot: pre[1].rot, path: undefined } : { ...a, faces };
    }
    if (i === i1 && t >= st && !sw.keepPaths) return { ...a, pos: pre[0].pos, rot: pre[0].rot, path: undefined };
    return a;
  });
  return { actors, swap: { t: st, ids: sw.ids, keepPaths: sw.keepPaths, pre } };
}

/** Interpolate cameras by orbiting around a moving look point (never cuts through the subject). */
export function orbitBlend(a: CamState, b: CamState, k: number): CamState {
  const look = a.look.clone().lerp(b.look, k);
  const oa = a.pos.clone().sub(a.look), ob = b.pos.clone().sub(b.look);
  const ra = Math.max(1e-3, oa.length()), rb = Math.max(1e-3, ob.length());
  const ya = Math.atan2(oa.x, oa.z), yb = Math.atan2(ob.x, ob.z);
  let dy = yb - ya;
  while (dy > Math.PI) dy -= 2 * Math.PI;
  while (dy < -Math.PI) dy += 2 * Math.PI;
  const pa = Math.asin(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(oa.y / ra, -1, 1)), pb = Math.asin(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(ob.y / rb, -1, 1));
  const r = ra * Math.pow(rb / ra, k), yaw = ya + dy * k, pitch = pa + (pb - pa) * k;
  const pos = look.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch), Math.sin(pitch), Math.cos(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch)).multiplyScalar(r));
  return { pos, look, fov: a.fov + (b.fov - a.fov) * k, roll: a.roll + (b.roll - a.roll) * k };
}

/** How different two framings look on screen: mean subject shift (fraction of width), view angle, scale ratio. */
export function framingDelta(a: CamState, b: CamState, points: THREE.Vector3[]) {
  const pts = points.length ? points : [a.look, b.look];
  let shift = 0, n = 0;
  for (const p of pts) {
    const pa = project(p, a, W, H), pb = project(p, b, W, H);
    if (!pa.visible && !pb.visible) continue;
    // a point only visible in one framing counts as fully different
    shift += pa.visible && pb.visible ? Math.min(1, Math.hypot(pa.x - pb.x, pa.y - pb.y) / W) : 1;
    n++;
  }
  const da = a.look.clone().sub(a.pos).normalize(), db = b.look.clone().sub(b.pos).normalize();
  const angle = (Math.acos(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(da.dot(db), -1, 1)) * 180) / Math.PI;
  const ref = pts[0];
  const scale = pxPerMetre(ref, b, H) / Math.max(1e-6, pxPerMetre(ref, a, H));
  return { shift: n ? shift / n : 1, angle, scale };
}

// ---- sub-cuts (coverage) -------------------------------------------------------------------
// One shot spec, several camera setups: each beat re-frames the same subject so a 4 s line reads as
// 2–3 cuts without writing more shots. Only automatic cameras.
//
// House cut & close rules (2026-11-09, "move the camera more": reels and long episodes):
//  1. The beat cycle never repeats a size or angle back to back:
//       k%4 = 0 (k ≥ 4)  back to the written size, the far side (−30°), pulling out / craning down
//       k%4 = 1  PUNCH   one size tighter, small angle change, pushing in
//       k%4 = 2  ANGLE   the written size, new angle (+38°), higher, orbiting
//       k%4 = 3  CLOSE   a face close (two sizes tighter, at most xclose), a touch low, slow push
//  2. Every beat moves (no static sub-shot), and a short beat covers the same move faster.
//  3. A strong bass hit lands on a PUNCH or a CLOSE (the next k with k%4 ∈ {1,3}); a reaction face
//     (shocked, scared, furious, …) on a camera target pulls a cut onto it and lands on a CLOSE.
export type Beat = { t0: number; t1: number; k: number };
const TIGHTER: Record<string, CameraSpec['shot']> = { establishing: 'wide', wide: 'full', full: 'medium', medium: 'close', close: 'xclose', xclose: 'xclose', insert: 'insert' };
const WIDER: Record<string, CameraSpec['shot']> = { xclose: 'close', close: 'medium', medium: 'full', full: 'wide', wide: 'establishing', establishing: 'establishing', insert: 'close' };
const beatCache = new WeakMap<Shot3D, Beat[]>();

export function beatsOf(ctx: ShotCtx): Beat[] {
  const { shot, dur, words } = ctx;
  const hit = beatCache.get(shot);
  if (hit && hit.length && Math.abs(hit[hit.length - 1].t1 - dur) < 1e-6) return hit;
  const c = shot.camera || {};
  // automatic cameras re-frame per beat; explicit ones (pos/path) punch in / orbit their own view (beatView)
  const expl = isExplicit(c);
  const auto = !(c.pos || c.path || c.over) || expl;
  let cuts: number[] = [];
  const covered = auto && shot.coverage && shot.coverage !== 'off';
  if (auto && c.beats?.length) cuts = c.beats.map(b => cue(b, words, -1)).filter(x => x > 0.3 && x < dur - 0.3);
  else if (covered) {
    // explicit cameras usually frame an action tableau: cut them less often, so the action still reads
    const [target, min] = shot.coverage === 'fast' ? (expl ? [2.2, 1.4] : [1.6, 1.1]) : (expl ? [3.0, 2.0] : [2.6, 1.8]);
    // cut just before a word starts, so the new framing lands on the word — preferably a sentence start
    // ("each sentence is a cut", 2026-11-09): a sentence start may come a little early (75% of target),
    // and a plain word start waits up to 0.6 s for a sentence start right after it
    const starts = (words || []).map(w => w[1] - 0.08);
    const sent = sentenceStarts(shot.vo, words);
    const cands = starts.length ? starts.map((x, i) => ({ x, s: sent.has(i) })).filter(c2 => c2.x > 0)
      : Array.from({ length: Math.floor(dur / 0.4) }, (_, i) => ({ x: i * 0.4, s: false }));
    let last = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < cands.length; i++) {
      const { x, s } = cands[i];
      if (dur - x < min || x <= last) continue;
      if (x - last >= (s ? target * 0.75 : target)) {
        const ahead = s ? undefined : cands.slice(i + 1).find(c2 => c2.s && c2.x - x <= 0.6 && dur - c2.x >= min);
        const at = ahead ? ahead.x : x;
        cuts.push(at); last = at;
      }
    }
  }
  // magnets (2026-11-09): heavy hits and reaction faces pull the cut onto their frame
  const hits = auto && shot.coverage !== 'off' ? [...hitsOf(shot, words, dur), ...(expl ? [] : reactionsOf(shot, words, dur))].sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t) : [];
  cuts = magnetize(cuts, hits, !!covered).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const out: Beat[] = [];
  let t0 = 0, k = 0;
  [...cuts, dur].forEach((t1, i) => {
    if (i > 0) {
      k++;
      const h = hits.find(x => Math.abs(x.t - t0) < 1e-6);
      if (h?.kind === 'strong') while (k % 4 !== 1 && k % 4 !== 3) k++; // punch or close on the boom
      if (h?.kind === 'face') while (k % 4 !== 3) k++; // close on the reaction
    }
    out.push({ t0, t1, k }); t0 = t1;
  });
  beatCache.set(shot, out);
  return out;
}

// ---- the bass magnet ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Low, heavy SFX declared on the shot (shot.sfx) steer the sub-cuts. strong: the cut lands on the hit (an
// existing cut within 0.6 s moves there, else a new cut is added, with a short shake — ShotView/evalShot).
// medium: only an existing cut within 0.4 s moves onto it. Light sounds (whooshes, ticks) never move the camera.
// Not every bass is a cut: hits closer than 0.9 s to the previous kept cut are skipped, so a burst of booms
// never strobes into near-identical framings (feedback: no camera snaps).
export const HIT_STRONG = new Set(['boom', 'farBoom', 'subdrop']);
export const HIT_MEDIUM = new Set(['thud', 'crack', 'splash', 'debris']);
// reaction faces: on a camera target they pull a cut and land on a CLOSE (rule 3), like a strong hit
const REACTIONS = new Set(['shocked', 'surprised', 'scared', 'furious', 'angry', 'cry', 'awe', 'embarrassed', 'confused', 'suspicious']);
type Hit = { t: number; kind: 'strong' | 'medium' | 'face'; strong: boolean };

// a hit nearer the shot's edge would leave a sub-shot too short to read
const inside = (dur: number) => (h: { t: number }) => h.t >= 0.7 && h.t <= dur - 0.7;

export function hitsOf(shot: Shot3D, words: Words, dur: number): Hit[] {
  return (shot.sfx || [])
    .filter(c => HIT_STRONG.has(c.name) || HIT_MEDIUM.has(c.name))
    .map(c => { const strong = HIT_STRONG.has(c.name); return { t: cue(c.t as number | string, words, -1), kind: strong ? 'strong' as const : 'medium' as const, strong }; })
    .filter(inside(dur))
    .sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
}

/** Reaction face keys (named faces in REACTIONS) of the camera's target actors (all actors when untargeted). */
function reactionsOf(shot: Shot3D, words: Words, dur: number): Hit[] {
  const tg = shot.camera?.target;
  const ids = typeof tg === 'string' ? [tg] : Array.isArray(tg) && typeof tg[0] === 'string' ? (tg as string[]) : null;
  const out: Hit[] = [];
  (shot.actors || []).forEach(a => {
    if (ids && !ids.includes(a.id)) return;
    (a.faces || []).forEach(f => { if (typeof f.face === 'string' && REACTIONS.has(f.face)) out.push({ t: cue(f.t as number | string, words, -1), kind: 'face', strong: true }); });
  });
  return out.filter(inside(dur));
}

function magnetize(cuts: number[], hits: Hit[], covered: boolean): number[] {
  if (!hits.length) return cuts;
  let out = [...cuts].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const pinned: number[] = [];
  for (const h of hits) {
    if (pinned.some(p => Math.abs(p - h.t) < 0.9)) continue;
    const reach = h.strong ? 0.6 : 0.4;
    let best = -1;
    out.forEach((x, i) => { if (!pinned.includes(x) && Math.abs(x - h.t) <= reach && (best < 0 || Math.abs(x - h.t) < Math.abs(out[best] - h.t))) best = i; });
    if (best >= 0) out[best] = h.t;
    else if (h.strong && (covered || out.length)) out.push(h.t); // a strong hit adds a cut on covered shots / shots with beats
    else continue;
    pinned.push(h.t);
    // keep the new framing on screen long enough to read: drop unpinned cuts crowding the hit
    out = out.filter(x => pinned.includes(x) || Math.abs(x - h.t) >= 0.7);
  }
  return [...new Set(out)].sort((a, b) => a - b);
}

/** Indices (into `words`) of words that start a sentence in the shot's vo, read from its punctuation.
 *  Only trusted when the vo tokenizes to the same word count as the alignment; else none (no preference). */
function sentenceStarts(vo: string | undefined, words: Words): Set<number> {
  const out = new Set<number>();
  if (!vo || !words?.length) return out;
  const toks = vo.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, ' ').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/[-–—]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(w => /[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(w));
  if (toks.length !== words.length) return out;
  out.add(0);
  toks.forEach((w, i) => { if (i + 1 < toks.length && /[.!?…:;]["'”»)]*$/.test(w)) out.add(i + 1); });
  return out;
}

/** An explicit camera (pos/look or path, not over-the-shoulder): its sub-cuts transform the solved view (beatView). */
export const isExplicit = (c: CameraSpec | undefined) => !!c && !!(c.pos || c.path) && !c.over;

/**
 * Sub-cut of an explicit camera, applied to the view solved on the shot's own clock (so moveAt / path
 * timing is untouched): odd beats punch in on the look point (a size change, ~1.55x; only from ≥ 3.2 m,
 * closer they orbit too), even beats orbit ~28° around it at the same distance (a real angle change, never
 * a few-pixel snap). u = 0..1 in the beat.
 */
export function beatView(cam: CamState, k: number, u: number): CamState {
  if (!k) return cam;
  // a camera already close to its subject (< 3.2 m) would punch into a giant head: orbit the other way instead
  const near = cam.pos.distanceTo(cam.look) < 3.2;
  // PUNCH ~1.55x, CLOSE ~2x, and both keep creeping in through the beat
  if (k % 2 && !near) return { ...cam, fov: cam.fov * ((k % 4 === 3 ? 0.5 : 0.64) - 0.05 * u) };
  const side = k % 2 ? -1 : k % 4 === 2 ? 1 : -1;
  const a = side * (28 + 9 * u) * (Math.PI / 180);
  const off = cam.pos.clone().sub(cam.look).applyAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), a);
  return { ...cam, pos: cam.look.clone().add(off), fov: cam.fov * (0.9 - 0.04 * u) };
}

/** Two sizes tighter, stopping at xclose: the CLOSE beat. Inserts stay as they are. */
const closeOf = (shot: CameraSpec['shot']): CameraSpec['shot'] => (shot === 'insert' ? 'insert' : TIGHTER[TIGHTER[shot || 'medium'] || 'close']);

/** The camera spec for beat k (the cut & close rules above beatsOf). */
export function beatCam(c: CameraSpec | undefined, k: number): CameraSpec | undefined {
  if (!k || !c || isExplicit(c)) return c;
  const base = c.angle ?? 20, sign = base >= 0 ? -1 : 1, size = c.shot || 'medium';
  switch (k % 4) {
    case 1: return { ...c, shot: TIGHTER[size], angle: base + sign * 10, move: 'pushIn', amount: 0.9, dist: c.dist && c.dist * 0.72 };
    case 2: return { ...c, angle: base + sign * 38, height: (c.height ?? 6) + 6, move: 'orbitR', amount: 0.8 };
    case 3: {
      // CLOSE on the first target's face (a group shot closes on its first actor)
      // in a group shot, stay on the written angle (its side is clear of the others) and stop at 'close':
      // swinging in toward a neighbour put the lens inside their head
      const tg = c.target, group = Array.isArray(tg) && typeof tg[0] === 'string' && tg.length > 1;
      const one = group ? (tg as string[])[0] : tg;
      const shot = group && closeOf(size) === 'xclose' ? 'close' : closeOf(size);
      return { ...c, target: one, shot, focus: 'head', angle: group ? base : base - sign * 16, height: (c.height ?? 4) - 3, move: 'pushIn', amount: 0.6, dist: c.dist && c.dist * 0.5 };
    }
    // pull-out / crane, not a truck: those keep the subject in the 9:16 centre column
    default: return { ...c, angle: base - sign * 30, move: k % 8 === 4 ? 'pullOut' : 'craneDown', amount: 0.8 };
  }
}

const rot0Cache = new WeakMap<Shot3D, Record<string, number>>();

/** Actors' facing at t=0 (cached per shot). Cameras orient on this so a swap/turn never flips the camera. */
function rotAtStart(ctx: ShotCtx, cast: Record<string, CastMember>, now: Record<string, ActorState>, t: number): Record<string, number> {
  let r = rot0Cache.get(ctx.shot);
  if (r) return r;
  if (t === 0) r = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(now).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.rot]));
  else {
    const setKey = SETS[ctx.shot.set] ? ctx.shot.set : 'suburb';
    const { actors } = resolveShotActors(ctx.shot, 0, ctx.words, setKey);
    r = {};
    actors.forEach(a => { if (!(a.id in r!)) r![a.id] = evalActor(a, cast[a.id] || cast.hero, 0, seedOf(a.id), undefined, ctx.start).rot; });
  }
  rot0Cache.set(ctx.shot, r);
  return r;
}

// ---- tight-beat guard ------------------------------------------------------------------------
// PUNCH and CLOSE beats only work when the face reads. Two failures seen on menu-corpo (2026-11-09):
// a neighbour's back/head between the lens and the target (a hug: the close filled the frame with a nape),
// and a head bowed over a desk (the close was a giant black disc). So each tight beat is checked once,
// on the scene at its midpoint: the target's face must point at the lens (≤ ~45°) and no other head may
// sit on the sight line or near the lens. Other angles and a lower camera are tried in turn; if none
// works the beat becomes an ANGLE beat at the written size. Decided once per beat (deterministic, no flicker).
const tightCache = new WeakMap<Shot3D, Map<number, CameraSpec | undefined>>();

function guardedBeatCam(ctx: ShotCtx, cast: Record<string, CastMember>, camSpec: CameraSpec | undefined, beat: Beat, fallback: Vec3): CameraSpec | undefined {
  const spec = beatCam(camSpec, beat.k);
  const closeSize = (c2: CameraSpec) => ['close', 'xclose'].includes(c2.shot || 'medium');
  // tight beats (PUNCH, CLOSE) and any other sub-cut that is still a close (a close shot's ANGLE beat)
  // (beat 0 is the framing as written: never overridden — the audit warns when a written close shows no face)
  if (!beat.k || !spec || !camSpec || isExplicit(camSpec) || !(beat.k % 2 || closeSize(spec))) return spec;
  const tight = beat.k % 2 === 1;
  let memo = tightCache.get(ctx.shot);
  if (!memo) tightCache.set(ctx.shot, (memo = new Map()));
  if (memo.has(beat.k)) return memo.get(beat.k);
  const span = beat.t1 - beat.t0;
  const setKey = SETS[ctx.shot.set] ? ctx.shot.set : 'suburb';
  // the scene at the start, middle and end of the beat: a face that turns away mid-beat fails too
  const sample = (u: number) => {
    const tt = beat.t0 + span * u;
    const { actors } = resolveShotActors(ctx.shot, tt, ctx.words, setKey);
    const st: Record<string, ActorState> = {};
    const dup: Record<string, number> = {};
    actors.forEach((a, i) => {
      const n = (dup[a.id] = (dup[a.id] ?? -1) + 1);
      st[st[a.id] ? `${a.id}#${i}` : a.id] = evalActor(a, cast[a.id] || cast.hero, tt, seedOf(a.id, n), undefined, ctx.start + tt);
    });
    return { u, st };
  };
  const samples = [0.1, 0.5, 0.9].map(sample);
  const rot0 = rotAtStart(ctx, cast, samples[1].st, beat.t0 + span / 2);
  const tg = spec.target;
  const tgId = typeof tg === 'string' ? tg : Array.isArray(tg) && typeof tg[0] === 'string' ? (tg as string[])[0] : Object.keys(samples[1].st)[0];
  let pick: CameraSpec | undefined = spec;
  if (samples.every(x => x.st[tgId])) {
    const faceOf = (a: ActorState) => new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1).transformDirection(a.bones.head);
    // ok = nothing on the sight line or at the lens; for a close size, also the face pointing at the lens
    const okAt = (s2: CameraSpec, { u, st }: { u: number; st: Record<string, ActorState> }) => {
      const who = st[tgId], head = who.anchors.head;
      const cam = solveCamera(s2, span * u, span, st, fallback, rot0);
      const toCam = cam.pos.clone().sub(head);
      const len = toCam.length();
      const dir = toCam.clone().normalize();
      if (closeSize(s2) && faceOf(who).dot(dir) < 0.7) return false; // face turned away / bowed (> ~45° off the lens)
      for (const [id, o] of Object.entries(st)) {
        if (id === tgId) continue;
        const oh = o.anchors.head;
        if (cam.pos.distanceTo(oh) < 0.6) return false;
        const along = oh.clone().sub(head).dot(dir);
        if (along > 0 && along < len && oh.clone().sub(head).addScaledVector(dir, -along).length() < 0.32 * o.scale) return false; // on the sight line
      }
      return true;
    };
    const ok = (s2: CameraSpec) => samples.every(x => okAt(s2, x));
    const around = (s2: CameraSpec, low: boolean) => [s2, ...[25, -25, 50, -50, 75, -75].map(d => ({ ...s2, angle: (s2.angle ?? 20) + d })),
      ...(low ? [0, 30, -30].map(d => ({ ...s2, angle: (s2.angle ?? 20) + d, height: (s2.height ?? 4) - 14 })) : [])];
    const widen = (s2: CameraSpec): CameraSpec => (closeSize(s2) ? { ...s2, shot: WIDER[s2.shot!], dist: s2.dist && s2.dist * 1.6 } : s2);
    // a bowed head (face > ~27° down: reading, slumped over a desk) never gives a face close from any angle
    // (a low camera ends up behind the desk edge): skip the tight tries
    const bowed = samples.some(x => faceOf(x.st[tgId]).y < -0.45);
    const angleBeat = tight ? beatCam(camSpec, 2)! : spec;
    // chain: tight framings from several angles → the ANGLE beat → one size wider from several angles
    const chain = [...(tight && !bowed ? around(spec, true) : []), ...around(angleBeat, false), ...around(widen(angleBeat), false)];
    pick = chain.find(ok) ?? beatCam(camSpec, 0);
  }
  memo.set(beat.k, pick);
  return pick;
}

const flowCache = new WeakMap<Shot3D, FlowInfo>();

/**
 * Decide whether the cut from `prev` into `cur` should play as one continuous camera move.
 * Same set + same lighting + the framings barely differ on screen = a "jump cut" → flow.
 * Real angle changes stay cuts. `cut: "flow"` forces flow; any other explicit cut type forces a cut.
 */
export function flowInfo(prev: ShotCtx, cur: ShotCtx, cast: Record<string, CastMember>): FlowInfo {
  const cached = flowCache.get(cur.shot);
  if (cached) return cached;
  let info: FlowInfo;
  const sameSet = prev.shot.set === cur.shot.set && (prev.shot.time || '') === (cur.shot.time || '');
  if (!sameSet) info = { on: false, camBlend: 0, actorBlend: 0, reason: 'different set/lighting' };
  else if (cur.shot.cut && cur.shot.cut !== 'flow') info = { on: false, camBlend: 0, actorBlend: 0, reason: `explicit ${cur.shot.cut}` };
  else {
    const a = evalShot(prev, prev.dur, cast);
    const b = evalShot(cur, 0, cast);
    // measure on characters present in both shots (the subject the eye tracks across the cut)
    const common = b.states.filter(s => a.byId[s.spec.id]);
    const pts = common.length ? [...common.map(s => a.byId[s.spec.id].anchors.head), ...common.map(s => s.anchors.head)] : [];
    const d = framingDelta(a.cam, b.cam, pts);
    const jump = d.shift < 0.14 && d.angle < 20 && d.scale > 0.78 && d.scale < 1.28;
    const force = cur.shot.cut === 'flow';
    const on = force || jump;
    info = {
      on,
      camBlend: on ? THREE.MathUtils.clamp(0.5 + d.shift * 3 + d.angle / 40 + Math.abs(Math.log(d.scale)) * 1.2, 0.5, force ? 1.6 : 1.1) : 0,
      actorBlend: on ? 0.45 : 0,
      reason: force ? 'cut: flow' : jump ? 'near-identical framing (jump cut) → continuous move' : 'different view → cut',
      screenShift: +d.shift.toFixed(3), angle: +d.angle.toFixed(1), scale: +d.scale.toFixed(2),
    };
  }
  flowCache.set(cur.shot, info);
  return info;
}

/** Pull a camera that ended up behind a wall / under the floor / above the ceiling back inside the
 *  room along its sight line (keeps the direction, tightens the framing). Returns how far it moved. */
function keepInRoom(cam: CamState, room: { min: Vec3; max: Vec3 }, m = 0.15): number {
  const L = cam.look, P = cam.pos;
  let s = 1;
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    const l = L.getComponent(k), p = P.getComponent(k), d = p - l;
    const lo = room.min[k] + m, hi = room.max[k] - m;
    if (p < lo && d < 0) s = Math.min(s, (lo - l) / d);
    if (p > hi && d > 0) s = Math.min(s, (hi - l) / d);
  }
  if (s >= 1) return 0;
  s = Math.max(0.05, s);
  const moved = P.distanceTo(L) * (1 - s);
  cam.pos = L.clone().add(P.clone().sub(L).multiplyScalar(s));
  return moved;
}

export function evalShot(ctx: ShotCtx, t: number, cast: Record<string, CastMember>, prev?: ShotCtx): SceneState {
  const { shot, dur, words } = ctx;
  const def = SETS[shot.set] || SETS.suburb;
  const setKey = SETS[shot.set] ? shot.set : 'suburb';
  const palKey = shot.time || def.palette;
  const clock = ctx.start + t;
  const { actors, swap } = resolveShotActors(shot, t, words, setKey);
  const dup: Record<string, number> = {};
  const seeds = actors.map(a => { const n = dup[a.id] = (dup[a.id] ?? -1) + 1; return seedOf(a.id, n); });
  // pass 1: bodies without head look-at, so the camera can frame them
  const first: Record<string, ActorState> = {};
  actors.forEach((a, i) => { const k = first[a.id] ? `${a.id}#${i}` : a.id; first[k] = evalActor(a, cast[a.id] || cast.hero, t, seeds[i], undefined, clock); });
  const fallback: Vec3 = def.marks.center || Object.values(def.marks)[0] || [0, 0, 0];
  const camSpec = shot.camera && (shot.camera.moveAt || shot.camera.path) ? {
    ...shot.camera,
    moveAt: shot.camera.moveAt?.map(x => cue(x, words, 0)) as [number, number] | undefined,
    path: shot.camera.path?.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t, words, 0) })),
  } : shot.camera;
  // sub-cuts: solve the camera for the current beat, on the beat's own clock
  const beats = beatsOf(ctx);
  const beat = beats.find(b => t < b.t1) || beats[beats.length - 1];
  const beatSpec = isExplicit(camSpec) ? camSpec : guardedBeatCam(ctx, cast, camSpec, beat, fallback);
  let cam = isExplicit(camSpec)
    ? beatView(solveCamera(camSpec, t, ctx.dur, first, fallback), beat.k, (t - beat.t0) / Math.max(1e-6, beat.t1 - beat.t0))
    : solveCamera(beatSpec, t - beat.t0, beat.t1 - beat.t0, first, fallback, rotAtStart(ctx, cast, first, t));
  const camOut = def.room ? keepInRoom(cam, def.room) : 0;
  if (shot.fx?.shake) cam = shake(cam, t, 0.03 * shot.fx.shake, 18, 4);
  // bass magnet: a strong hit that opens a beat kicks the camera (decays in ~0.25 s)
  if (beat.t0 > 0) { const h = hitsOf(shot, words, dur).find(x => x.kind === 'strong' && Math.abs(x.t - beat.t0) < 1e-6); if (h) cam = shake(cam, t, 0.05 * impulse(t, h.t, 0.22), 20, 9); }
  // continuity with the previous shot (same set, near-identical framing): one flowing move
  const flow = prev ? flowInfo(prev, ctx, cast) : undefined;
  let prevEnd: SceneState | undefined;
  if (flow?.on && (t < flow.camBlend || t < flow.actorBlend)) prevEnd = evalShot(prev!, prev!.dur, cast);
  if (flow?.on && prevEnd && t < flow.camBlend) cam = orbitBlend(prevEnd.cam, cam, ease(t / flow.camBlend));
  // pass 2: with look-at targets (other actors' heads, points, or the camera)
  let states = actors.map((a, i) =>
    evalActor(a, cast[a.id] || cast.hero, t, seeds[i], target =>
      target === 'camera' ? cam.pos : typeof target === 'string' ? first[target]?.anchors.head : new THREE.Vector3(...target), clock),
  );
  if (flow?.on && prevEnd && t < flow.actorBlend) {
    const k = ease(t / flow.actorBlend);
    states = states.map(s => (prevEnd!.byId[s.spec.id] ? blendStates(prevEnd!.byId[s.spec.id], s, k) : s));
  }
  const byId: Record<string, ActorState> = {};
  states.forEach(s => { if (!byId[s.spec.id]) byId[s.spec.id] = s; });
  const frozen = shot.fx?.freeze !== undefined && shot.fx.freeze !== false && t >= (typeof shot.fx.freeze === 'number' ? shot.fx.freeze : 0);
  const props = (shot.props || []).map(p => {
    let pos = place(p.pos, setKey);
    if (p.follow) {
      // ride along under an actor (e.g. a skateboard), optionally switching actor at given times
      const keys = typeof p.follow === 'string' ? [{ t: 0, id: p.follow }] : p.follow.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t as number | string, words, 0) }));
      const cur = [...keys].reverse().find(k => t >= k.t) || keys[0];
      const st = byId[cur.id];
      if (st) pos = [st.pos[0], st.pos[1] - 0.1, st.pos[2]];
    }
    const ignite = (p as { ignite?: number | string }).ignite;
    // prop paths take word cues too ("@stops-0.2"), so moving props stay on the narration after re-voicing
    const path = p.follow || !p.path ? undefined : p.path.map(k => ({ ...k, t: cue(k.t as number | string, words, 0) }));
    return { ...p, pos, path, ...(ignite !== undefined ? { ignite: cue(ignite, words, 0) } : {}) } as PropSpec;
  });
  return { setKey, def, palKey, actors, states, byId, cam, swap, frozen, props, flow, camOut, beat: beat.k, beatSpec };
}

// Engine self-tests: tiny canned scenes that check each effect keeps its promise. They run in the
// same code path as rendering (evalShot), so a broken effect fails here before any video uses it.
//   node tools/qa.cjs selftest      (also: npm test)
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { at, evalActor, withReach } from '../engine/actor';
import { CAST } from '../cast';
import { resolvePose } from '../engine/rig';
import { SETS } from '../sets';
import { rng } from '../sets/kit';
import type { Episode, Shot3D, Timing } from '../types';
import { auditEpisode } from './audit';
import { evalShot, flowInfo, type ShotCtx } from './scene';

export type TestResult = { name: string; pass: boolean; detail: string };

const cast = CAST;
const M = SETS.void.marks;
const dist = (a: number[], b: number[]) => Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[2] - b[2]);
const ctx = (shot: Shot3D, dur = 3, start = 0): ShotCtx => ({ shot, dur, start });

function test(name: string, fn: () => string | true): TestResult {
  try {
    const r = fn();
    return r === true ? { name, pass: true, detail: 'ok' } : { name, pass: false, detail: r };
  } catch (e) {
    return { name, pass: false, detail: 'threw: ' + String((e as Error).message || e) };
  }
}

export function runSelfTests(): TestResult[] {
  const out: TestResult[] = [];

  out.push(test('swap trades both positions', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'left' }, { id: 'bestie', pos: 'right' }], fx: { swap: { t: 1, ids: ['hero', 'bestie'] } } };
    const before = evalShot(ctx(shot), 0.9, cast), after = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1.05, cast);
    if (dist(before.byId.hero.pos, M.left) > 0.01) return 'hero moved before the swap';
    if (dist(after.byId.hero.pos, M.right) > 0.01) return `hero is ${dist(after.byId.hero.pos, M.right).toFixed(2)} m from bestie's old spot after the swap`;
    if (dist(after.byId.bestie.pos, M.left) > 0.01) return `bestie is ${dist(after.byId.bestie.pos, M.left).toFixed(2)} m from hero's old spot after the swap`;
    return true;
  }));

  out.push(test('swap: ids[0] is the swapper (blinks) regardless of actor order', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'bestie', pos: 'right' }, { id: 'hero', pos: 'left' }], fx: { swap: { t: 1.5, ids: ['hero', 'bestie'] } } };
    const s = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1.5 - 0.38, cast);
    if (s.byId.hero.face.eyes > 0.3) return `hero's eyes are ${s.byId.hero.face.eyes.toFixed(2)} open during the blink`;
    if (s.byId.bestie.face.eyes < 0.5) return 'bestie blinked instead of hero';
    const after = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1.6, cast);
    if (dist(after.byId.hero.pos, M.right) > 0.01 || dist(after.byId.bestie.pos, M.left) > 0.01) return 'positions not traded with reversed actor order';
    return true;
  }));

  out.push(test('swap with keepPaths follows the paths', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = {
      set: 'void', vo: 'x',
      actors: [
        { id: 'hero', pos: [-3, 0, 0], path: [{ t: 0, pos: [-3, 0, 0] }, { t: 1, pos: [-1, 0, 0], gait: 'glide' }, { t: 1.02, pos: [2, 0, 0], gait: 'glide' }] },
        { id: 'dad', pos: [2, 0, 0], path: [{ t: 0, pos: [2, 0, 0] }, { t: 1, pos: [2, 0, 0] }, { t: 1.02, pos: [-1, 0, 0], gait: 'glide' }] },
      ],
      fx: { swap: { t: 1.01, ids: ['hero', 'dad'], keepPaths: true } },
    };
    const s = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1.5, cast);
    if (dist(s.byId.hero.pos, [2, 0, 0]) > 0.05) return 'hero not at the path end';
    if (dist(s.byId.dad.pos, [-1, 0, 0]) > 0.05) return 'dad not at the path end';
    return true;
  }));

  out.push(test('prop follow rides under its actor and switches actor', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = {
      set: 'void', vo: 'x',
      actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: [-3, 0.1, 0], path: [{ t: 0, pos: [-3, 0.1, 0] }, { t: 2, pos: [1, 0.1, 0], gait: 'glide' }] }, { id: 'dad', pos: [3, 0.1, 0] }],
      props: [{ type: 'skateboard', follow: [{ t: 0, id: 'hero' }, { t: 2.5, id: 'dad' }] }],
    };
    const a = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1, cast), b = evalShot(ctx(shot), 2.6, cast);
    if (dist(a.props[0].pos as number[], a.byId.hero.pos) > 0.01) return 'board not under hero';
    if (dist(b.props[0].pos as number[], b.byId.dad.pos) > 0.01) return 'board did not switch to dad';
    return true;
  }));

  out.push(test('strafe keeps facing while moving', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'dad', pos: [0, 0, 0], rot: -90, strafe: true, path: [{ t: 0, pos: [0, 0, 0] }, { t: 2, pos: [4, 0, 0], gait: 'glide' }] }] };
    const s = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1, cast);
    return Math.abs(s.byId.dad.rot - -90) < 0.5 ? true : `rot ${s.byId.dad.rot.toFixed(1)} instead of -90`;
  }));

  out.push(test('a carried actor keeps its keyed pose while moving', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: [0, 0, 0], pose: 'crouch', path: [{ t: 0, pos: [0, 0, 0] }, { t: 2, pos: [0, 4, 0], gait: 'carried' }] }] };
    const s = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1, cast).byId.hero;
    const want = resolvePose('crouch').hipY;
    return Math.abs(s.pose.hipY - want) < 0.05 && s.pos[1] > 0.5 && s.pos[1] < 3.5 ? true : `hipY ${s.pose.hipY.toFixed(2)} (want ${want}), y ${s.pos[1].toFixed(2)}`;
  }));

  out.push(test('talking fades in and out (no pose pop)', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'center', talk: [[1, 2]] }] };
    let worst = 0;
    for (let f = 20; f < 70; f++) {
      const a = evalShot(ctx(shot), f / 30, cast).byId.hero, b = evalShot(ctx(shot), (f + 1) / 30, cast).byId.hero;
      for (const j of ['head', 'armR'] as const) for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) worst = Math.max(worst, Math.abs(a.pose[j][k] - b.pose[j][k]));
    }
    return worst < 8 ? true : `pose changes ${worst.toFixed(1)}° in one frame around the talk boundaries`;
  }));

  out.push(test('idle motion is continuous across shot boundaries', () => {
    const spec = { id: 'hero', pos: 'center', pose: 'relaxed' } as const;
    const A: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [spec], camera: { pos: [0, 1.5, 5], look: [0, 1, 0] } };
    const B: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'y', actors: [spec], camera: { pos: [0.1, 1.5, 5], look: [0, 1, 0] } };
    const a = evalShot(ctx(A, 3, 10), 3 - 1 / 30, cast).byId.hero, b = evalShot(ctx(B, 3, 13), 0, cast, ctx(A, 3, 10)).byId.hero;
    let worst = 0;
    for (const j of ['spine', 'head', 'armL', 'armR'] as const) for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) worst = Math.max(worst, Math.abs(a.pose[j][k] - b.pose[j][k]));
    return worst < 3 ? true : `pose jumps ${worst.toFixed(1)}° across the boundary`;
  }));

  out.push(test('near-identical framing in the same set flows (no snap)', () => {
    const A: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'center' }], camera: { pos: [0, 1.5, 5], look: [0, 1, 0] } };
    const B: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'y', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'center' }], camera: { pos: [0.3, 1.55, 4.8], look: [0.05, 1, 0] } };
    const ca = ctx(A, 3, 0), cb = ctx(B, 3, 3);
    const fl = flowInfo(ca, cb, cast);
    if (!fl.on) return `not detected as a jump cut (${fl.reason})`;
    const endA = evalShot(ca, 3, cast).cam, startB = evalShot(cb, 0, cast, ca).cam;
    const gap = endA.pos.distanceTo(startB.pos) + endA.look.distanceTo(startB.look);
    if (gap > 0.01) return `camera still jumps ${gap.toFixed(3)} m at the boundary`;
    let worst = 0;
    for (let f = 0; f < 40; f++) worst = Math.max(worst, evalShot(cb, f / 30, cast, ca).cam.pos.distanceTo(evalShot(cb, (f + 1) / 30, cast, ca).cam.pos));
    return worst < 0.05 ? true : `camera moves ${worst.toFixed(3)} m in one frame during the flow`;
  }));

  out.push(test('a real angle change stays a cut', () => {
    const A: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'center' }], camera: { pos: [0, 1.5, 5], look: [0, 1, 0] } };
    const B: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'y', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'center' }], camera: { pos: [4, 1.5, 2], look: [0, 1.4, 0] } };
    const fl = flowInfo(ctx(A, 3, 0), ctx(B, 3, 3), cast);
    return fl.on ? `flowed although the angle changed ${fl.angle}°` : true;
  }));

  out.push(test('IK puts the hand at the mouth', () => {
    const pose = withReach(resolvePose({ reachR: { to: 'mouth' } }));
    const s = evalActor({ id: 'hero', pos: [0, 0, 0], pose }, cast.hero, 0, 1);
    const target = at(s.bones.head, 0, -0.165, 0.212 + 0.075);
    const d = at(s.bones.handR).distanceTo(target);
    return d < 0.04 ? true : `wrist is ${d.toFixed(3)} m from the mouth target`;
  }));

  out.push(test('audit flags two characters on the same spot', () => {
    const ep: Episode = { slug: 't', title: 't', voice: { id: 'x' }, shots: [{ set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'center' }, { id: 'bestie', pos: 'center+0.1,0,0' }], camera: { shot: 'full', target: 'hero' } }] };
    const tm: Timing = { fps: 30, total: 2, shots: [{ start: 0, dur: 2, section: 0 }], sections: [] };
    const r = auditEpisode(ep, tm);
    return r.findings.some(f => f.check === 'overlap') ? true : 'overlap not reported';
  }));

  out.push(test('audit flags a forced jump cut', () => {
    const A: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'center' }], camera: { pos: [0, 1.5, 5], look: [0, 1, 0] } };
    const B: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'y', cut: 'cut', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'center' }], camera: { pos: [0.2, 1.5, 5], look: [0, 1, 0] } };
    const ep: Episode = { slug: 't', title: 't', voice: { id: 'x' }, shots: [A, B] };
    const tm: Timing = { fps: 30, total: 4, shots: [{ start: 0, dur: 2, section: 0 }, { start: 2, dur: 2, section: 0 }], sections: [] };
    return auditEpisode(ep, tm).findings.some(f => f.check === 'jumpcut') ? true : 'jump cut not reported';
  }));

  out.push(test('camera keeps its angle when its target turns (swap)', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'left', rot: 90 }, { id: 'bestie', pos: 'right', rot: -90 }], fx: { swap: { t: 1, ids: ['hero', 'bestie'] } }, camera: { shot: 'wide', target: ['hero', 'bestie'], angle: -60 } };
    const a = evalShot(ctx(shot), 0.97, cast).cam, b = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1.03, cast).cam;
    const d = a.pos.distanceTo(b.pos);
    return d < 0.2 ? true : `camera jumps ${d.toFixed(2)} m at the swap`;
  }));

  out.push(test('characters ease into a run (no leg snap)', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: [0, 0, 0], path: [{ t: 0.5, pos: [0, 0, 0] }, { t: 2.5, pos: [8, 0, 0], gait: 'run' }] }] };
    let worst = 0;
    for (let f = 10; f < 30; f++) {
      const a = evalShot(ctx(shot), f / 30, cast).byId.hero, b = evalShot(ctx(shot), (f + 1) / 30, cast).byId.hero;
      for (const j of ['legL', 'legR', 'armL', 'armR'] as const) for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) worst = Math.max(worst, Math.abs(a.pose[j][k] - b.pose[j][k]));
    }
    return worst < 30 ? true : `a joint moves ${worst.toFixed(0)}° in one frame when the run starts`;
  }));

  out.push(test('set RNG stays in [0, 1) for negative seeds (no undefined colours)', () => {
    for (let seed = -40; seed < 40; seed++) {
      const r = rng(seed * 13 + 1);
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) { const v = r(); if (!(v >= 0 && v < 1)) return `rng(${seed * 13 + 1}) gave ${v}`; }
    }
    return true;
  }));

  out.push(test('explicit camera move runs only inside moveAt (word cues)', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'roll then blink', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'center' }], camera: { pos: [0, 1.5, 5], look: [0, 1, 0], to: { pos: [4, 1.5, 5], look: [4, 1, 0] }, moveAt: [0, '@blink'] } };
    const words = [['roll', 0.1], ['then', 0.5], ['blink', 1.0]] as [string, number][];
    const c = (t: number) => evalShot({ shot, dur: 3, start: 0, words }, t, cast).cam.pos.x;
    if (Math.abs(c(0)) > 0.01) return `starts at x=${c(0).toFixed(2)}`;
    if (Math.abs(c(1.0) - 4) > 0.01 || Math.abs(c(2.5) - 4) > 0.01) return `not settled at the cue: x=${c(1.0).toFixed(2)} / ${c(2.5).toFixed(2)}`;
    return c(0.5) > 0.5 && c(0.5) < 3.5 ? true : `mid-move x=${c(0.5).toFixed(2)}`;
  }));

  out.push(test('audit flags a character whose move happens off-screen', () => {
    const A: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: [-20, 0, 0], path: [{ t: 0, pos: [-20, 0, 0] }, { t: 3, pos: [0, 0, 0], gait: 'run' }] }], camera: { pos: [0, 1.5, 5], look: [0, 1, 0], fov: 30 } };
    const ep: Episode = { slug: 't', title: 't', voice: { id: 'x' }, shots: [A] };
    const tm: Timing = { fps: 30, total: 4, shots: [{ start: 0, dur: 4, section: 0 }], sections: [] };
    return auditEpisode(ep, tm).findings.some(f => f.msg.includes('moves off-screen')) ? true : 'off-screen move not reported';
  }));

  out.push(test('swapper blinks before the swap and keeps later face keys after it', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [
      { id: 'hero', pos: 'left', face: 'smirk', faces: [{ t: 2, face: 'scared' }] },
      { id: 'bestie', pos: 'right' }], fx: { swap: { t: 1, ids: ['hero', 'bestie'] } } };
    const blink = evalShot(ctx(shot), 1 - 0.2 + 0.03, cast).byId.hero.face.eyes;
    if (blink > 0.3) return `no blink before the swap (eyes ${blink.toFixed(2)})`;
    const late = evalShot(ctx(shot), 2.6, cast).byId.hero.face;
    return late.brow > 0.5 ? true : `after the swap the face is not "scared" (brow ${late.brow.toFixed(2)})`;
  }));

  out.push(test('a camera placed behind a room wall is pulled back inside', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'cafeteria', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: 'aisle+0,0,-3.2', rot: 180 }], camera: { pos: [0, 1.5, -7], look: [0, 1.2, -2.8], fov: 40 } };
    const sc = evalShot(ctx(shot), 0.1, cast);
    const room = SETS.cafeteria.room!;
    if (sc.cam.pos.z < room.min[2]) return `camera still behind the back wall (z=${sc.cam.pos.z.toFixed(2)})`;
    return sc.camOut > 0 ? true : 'pull-in not reported';
  }));

  out.push(test('characters settle out of a run (no frozen mid-air stride)', () => {
    const shot: Shot3D = { set: 'void', vo: 'x', actors: [{ id: 'hero', pos: [8, 0, 0], path: [{ t: 0, pos: [8, 0, 0] }, { t: 2, pos: [0, 0, 0], gait: 'run' }] }] };
    let worst = 0;
    for (const t of [1.97, 2.0, 2.03, 2.1]) {
      const st = evalShot(ctx(shot), t, cast).byId.hero;
      const foot = Math.min(at(st.bones.footL).y, at(st.bones.footR).y) - 0.045 * st.scale;
      worst = Math.max(worst, foot - st.pos[1]);
    }
    return worst < 0.15 ? true : `feet ${worst.toFixed(2)} m off the floor as the run stops`;
  }));

  void THREE;
  return out;
}
@@@@ END

// Checks an episode spec against the registries so mistakes fail fast with a readable list.
// Runs inside calculateMetadata; check from the CLI with:
//   npx remotion compositions src/index.ts --props='{"slug":"<slug>"}'
import { CARDS } from '../cards';
import { SETS } from '../sets';
import { PALETTES } from '../sets/look';
import { FACES, POSES } from '../engine/rig';
import type { Episode, Shot3D } from '../types';
import { castOf } from './resolve';

// Mirrors LIB in tools/sfx/episode_audio.py
export const SFX_NAMES = ['whoosh', 'whooshUp', 'swoosh', 'boom', 'farBoom', 'thud', 'footsteps', 'gulp', 'click', 'pop', 'cloth', 'heartbeat',
  'subdrop', 'riser', 'swell', 'zap', 'crackle', 'wind', 'debris', 'rustle', 'chime', 'glint', 'ticks', 'ring', 'bell', 'whistle', 'groan', 'groanLow',
  'menu', 'tick', 'alert', 'horn', 'crack', 'splash'];
const PROPS = ['table', 'roundTable', 'chair', 'bed', 'desk', 'deskLamp', 'door', 'window', 'shelf', 'plant', 'tree', 'bush', 'lamp', 'fence', 'car', 'house',
  'building', 'clock', 'rug', 'crowd', 'sign', 'screen', 'box', 'crate', 'ball', 'basketball', 'cup', 'phone', 'book', 'laptop', 'glow', 'pillar', 'wall', 'portal', 'cone', 'trophy', 'skateboard', 'spot',
  'fire', 'smoke', 'firetruck', 'basket', 'binoculars', 'trafficlight', 'pizza', 'jar', 'iceHole', 'dog'];
const SHOTS = ['establishing', 'wide', 'full', 'medium', 'close', 'xclose', 'insert'];
const MOVES = ['static', 'drift', 'pushIn', 'pullOut', 'orbitL', 'orbitR', 'craneUp', 'craneDown', 'truckL', 'truckR', 'track', 'crashIn', 'shake', 'handheld'];
const OVERLAYS = ['label', 'title', 'stopwatch', 'stat', 'bubble', 'thought', 'crush', 'caption', 'flash', 'counter', 'news', 'hudList', 'word', 'menu'];

export function validate(ep: Episode): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const cast = castOf(ep);
  if (!ep.voice?.id) out.push('voice.id missing');
  const speakers = ['narrator', 'male', 'female', ...Object.keys(ep.voices || {})];
  ep.shots.forEach((shot, i) => {
    const at = `shot ${i}`;
    if (shot.who && !speakers.includes(shot.who)) out.push(`${at}: unknown speaker who:"${shot.who}" (have: ${speakers.join(', ')})`);
    if (!shot.vo && !shot.hold) out.push(`${at}: needs "vo" or "hold"`);
    (shot.sfx || []).forEach(c => { if (!SFX_NAMES.includes(c.name)) out.push(`${at}: unknown sfx "${c.name}"`); });
    (shot.overlays || []).forEach(o => { if (!OVERLAYS.includes(o.type)) out.push(`${at}: unknown overlay "${o.type}"`); });
    if (shot.kind === 'card') {
      if (!CARDS[shot.card as string]) out.push(`${at}: unknown card "${shot.card}" (have: ${Object.keys(CARDS).join(', ')})`);
      return;
    }
    const s = shot as Shot3D;
    const set = SETS[s.set];
    if (!set) {
      out.push(`${at}: unknown set "${s.set}" (have: ${Object.keys(SETS).join(', ')})`);
      return;
    }
    if (s.time && !PALETTES[s.time]) out.push(`${at}: unknown time/palette "${s.time}"`);
    const mark = (p: unknown, what: string) => {
      if (typeof p !== 'string') return;
      const name = p.split('+')[0].trim();
      if (!set.marks[name]) out.push(`${at}: ${what} mark "${name}" not in set ${s.set} (have: ${Object.keys(set.marks).join(', ')})`);
    };
    (s.actors || []).forEach(a => {
      if (!cast[a.id]) out.push(`${at}: unknown cast "${a.id}"`);
      mark(a.pos, `actor ${a.id}`);
      (a.path || []).forEach(w => mark(w.pos, `actor ${a.id} path`));
      const poses = [a.pose, ...(a.poses || []).map(k => k.pose)];
      poses.forEach(p => { if (typeof p === 'string' && !POSES[p]) out.push(`${at}: unknown pose "${p}"`); });
      const faces = [a.face, ...(a.faces || []).map(k => k.face)];
      faces.forEach(f => { if (typeof f === 'string' && !FACES[f]) out.push(`${at}: unknown face "${f}"`); });
    });
    (s.props || []).forEach(p => { if (!PROPS.includes(p.type)) out.push(`${at}: unknown prop "${p.type}"`); mark(p.pos, `prop ${p.type}`); });
    const c = s.camera;
    if (c) {
      if (c.shot && !SHOTS.includes(c.shot)) out.push(`${at}: unknown camera.shot "${c.shot}"`);
      if (c.move && !MOVES.includes(c.move)) out.push(`${at}: unknown camera.move "${c.move}"`);
      const ids = Array.isArray(c.target) ? (typeof c.target[0] === 'string' ? (c.target as string[]) : []) : typeof c.target === 'string' ? [c.target] : [];
      ids.forEach(id => { if (!(s.actors || []).some(a => a.id === id)) out.push(`${at}: camera target "${id}" is not in this shot`); });
    }
  });
  (ep.music || []).forEach(m => { if (m.shot >= ep.shots.length) out.push(`music cue at shot ${m.shot} is past the last shot`); });
  return out;
}
@@@@ END

// "Body settings" HUD: a videogame-style options panel floating over a 3D shot. A title bar, rows of
// sliders (label · bar · value) and an optional notification toast under it. Rows animate from `from` to
// `value` at their own cue, with a gold flash; warn rows turn red (the cost side of a change). Always
// inside the 9:16 centre column (560 px wide), so a hand-cut vertical short keeps it.
//
// Props
//   t       seconds since the panel appears (nothing for t < 0)
//   title   caps title (default "CONFIGURAÇÕES DO CORPO")
//   rows    [{ label, value, from?, at?, warn?, dim? }]  value 0–100; `at` = seconds since the panel appeared
//   note    toast text under the panel; noteAt = seconds since the panel appeared (default 0.6)
//   alarm   red pulsing frame + "ALARME" tag (the menu only opens in a real alarm)
//   y       'top' (default) | 'mid' | 'low' | 'above' (low, but clear of a bottom-centre stopwatch)
//   dur     seconds on screen; collapses over the last 0.25 s
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { C, COND, backOut, easeIn, easeOut, seg } from '../cards/kit';

export type MenuRow = { label: string; value: number; from?: number; at?: number; warn?: boolean; dim?: boolean };

const RED = '#ff5a4a';
const W_PANEL = 500;

export const BodyMenu: React.FC<{
  t: number; rows: MenuRow[]; title?: string; note?: string; noteAt?: number; alarm?: boolean; y?: 'top' | 'mid' | 'low' | 'above'; dur?: number;
}> = ({ t, rows, title = 'CONFIGURAÇÕES DO CORPO', note, noteAt = 0.6, alarm, y = 'top', dur }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const outK = dur != null ? easeIn(seg(t, dur - 0.25, dur)) : 0;
  if (outK >= 1) return null;
  const inK = backOut(seg(t, 0, 0.3), 1.6);
  const rowH = 50;
  const panelH = 56 + rows.length * rowH + 12;
  const top = y === 'top' ? 36 : y === 'low' ? 1080 - panelH - 60 : y === 'above' ? 1080 - panelH - 175 : 540 - panelH / 2;
  const pulse = alarm ? 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 9) : 0;
  const frame = alarm ? `rgba(255,90,74,${0.55 + 0.4 * pulse})` : 'rgba(120,200,255,0.75)';
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <div style={{
        position: 'absolute', left: 960 - W_PANEL / 2, width: W_PANEL, top,
        transform: `scaleY(${Math.max(0.02, inK * (1 - outK))}) scaleX(${0.9 + 0.1 * Math.min(1, inK)})`, transformOrigin: '50% 0%',
        opacity: Math.min(1, seg(t, 0, 0.12) * 1.5) * (1 - outK),
        background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14,22,52,0.9) 0%, rgba(8,12,34,0.92) 100%)',
        border: `3px solid ${frame}`, borderRadius: 14,
        boxShadow: `0 0 ${alarm ? 26 + 20 * pulse : 22}px ${alarm ? 'rgba(255,70,60,0.55)' : 'rgba(90,180,255,0.45)'}, 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)`,
        fontFamily: COND, color: C.cream, overflow: 'hidden',
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '10px 20px 8px', borderBottom: '2px solid rgba(120,200,255,0.35)' }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 28, letterSpacing: '0.06em', color: '#dff3ff' }}>{title}</div>
          {alarm && <div style={{ background: RED, color: '#fff', fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 22, padding: '3px 10px', borderRadius: 6, letterSpacing: '0.08em', opacity: 0.7 + 0.3 * pulse }}>ALARME</div>}
        </div>
        <div style={{ padding: '8px 22px 8px' }}>
          {rows.map((r, i) => {
            const rowIn = easeOut(seg(t, 0.12 + i * 0.06, 0.32 + i * 0.06));
            const at = r.at ?? 0;
            const k = r.from === undefined ? 1 : easeOut(seg(t, at, at + 0.45));
            const v = r.from === undefined ? r.value : r.from + (r.value - r.from) * k;
            const changing = r.from !== undefined && t >= at && t < at + 0.9;
            const flash = r.from !== undefined ? Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(t - at - 0.2) / 0.5) : 0;
            const col = r.warn ? RED : r.dim ? 'rgba(220,230,255,0.45)' : C.goldHi;
            return (
              <div key={i} style={{
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', height: rowH, gap: 16, opacity: rowIn * (r.dim ? 0.6 : 1), transform: `translateX(${(1 - rowIn) * -30}px)`,
                background: changing ? `rgba(255,213,107,${0.1 + 0.18 * flash})` : 'transparent', borderRadius: 8, margin: '0 -10px', padding: '0 10px',
              }}>
                <div style={{ width: 120, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 30, letterSpacing: '0.04em', color: r.warn ? RED : '#f2f6ff' }}>{r.label}</div>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 14, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)', borderRadius: 9, position: 'relative' }}>
                  <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 0, bottom: 0, width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v))}%`, background: r.warn ? RED : `linear-gradient(90deg, ${C.goldDeep}, ${C.goldHi})`, borderRadius: 9, boxShadow: flash > 0 ? `0 0 ${14 * flash}px ${col}` : 'none' }} />
                  <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: -6, left: `calc(${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v))}% - 13px)`, width: 26, height: 26, borderRadius: 13, background: '#fff', border: `4px solid ${col}`, boxShadow: '0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)' }} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ width: 60, textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 34, color: col, transform: `scale(${1 + 0.25 * flash})` }}>{Math.round(v)}</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
      {note && (() => {
        const nK = easeOut(seg(t, noteAt, noteAt + 0.3));
        if (nK <= 0) return null;
        return (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute', left: 960 - W_PANEL / 2 + 20, width: W_PANEL - 40, top: y === 'low' || y === 'above' ? top - 62 : top + panelH * Math.max(0.02, inK) + 18,
            opacity: nK * (1 - outK), transform: `translateY(${(1 - nK) * 20}px)`,
            background: 'rgba(255,90,74,0.95)', color: '#fff', fontFamily: COND, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: '0.04em',
            textAlign: 'center', padding: '10px 16px', borderRadius: 10, boxShadow: '0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)',
          }}>{note.toUpperCase()}</div>
        );
      })()}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
@@@@ END

// White rounded speech (or thought) bubble with handwritten text and a tail that points at a screen
// point — usually a character's mouth/head from `project()`. Pops out of the tail tip, bobs gently,
// and shrinks back into the tip at the end.
//
// Props
//   t         seconds since the bubble appears (nothing for t < 0)
//   text      the line (Patrick Hand; wraps at maxWidth)
//   x, y      screen point the tail points to (px)
//   kind      'speech' (default) | 'thought' (rounder bubble, tail of shrinking dots)
//   side      'auto' (default: bubble grows away from the nearer frame edge) | 'left' | 'right'
//   place     'auto' (default: above the point, below when y < 340) | 'above' | 'below'
//   gap       vertical gap between the point and the bubble edge (default 90)
//   size      font size in px (default 46)
//   maxWidth  max bubble text width in px (default 560)
//   dur       seconds on screen; pops back over the last 0.22 s (omit = stays)
//   W, H      frame size (default 1920×1080)
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { C, HAND, backOut, clamp01, easeIn, f, seg } from '../cards/kit';

export const Bubble: React.FC<{
  t: number; text: string; x: number; y: number; kind?: 'speech' | 'thought'; side?: 'auto' | 'left' | 'right'; place?: 'auto' | 'above' | 'below';
  gap?: number; size?: number; maxWidth?: number; dur?: number; W?: number; H?: number;
}> = ({ t, text, x, y, kind = 'speech', side = 'auto', place = 'auto', gap = 90, size = 46, maxWidth = 560, dur, W = 1920, H = 1080 }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const outK = dur != null ? easeIn(seg(t, dur - 0.22, dur)) : 0;
  if (outK >= 1) return null;
  const sx = side === 'left' ? -1 : side === 'right' ? 1 : x > W * 0.55 ? -1 : 1; // direction the bubble extends
  const below = place === 'below' || (place === 'auto' && y < 340);
  const sy = below ? 1 : -1;
  const thought = kind === 'thought';

  const pop = backOut(seg(t, 0, 0.3), 2.2) * (1 - outK);
  const textIn = clamp01((t - 0.04) / 0.1);
  const bob = Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 3;

  const ax = x - sx * 70; // near vertical edge of the bubble
  const by = y + sy * gap; // bubble edge nearest the point
  const b1 = ax + sx * 52, b2 = ax + sx * 122; // tail base on that edge
  const inset = sy * 9; // tuck the tail base inside the bubble
  const tail = thought
    ? null
    : `M${f(b1)},${f(by + inset)} Q${f((b1 + x) / 2 + sx * 6)},${f((by + y) / 2)} ${f(x)},${f(y)} Q${f((b2 + x) / 2 + sx * 18)},${f((by + y) / 2 - sy * 8)} ${f(b2)},${f(by + inset)} Z`;
  const dots = thought
    ? [0.28, 0.58, 0.86].map((k, i) => ({ cx: x + (ax + sx * 90 - x) * k, cy: y + (by - y) * k, r: 7 + i * 5 }))
    : [];

  const box: React.CSSProperties = {
    position: 'absolute',
    [sx > 0 ? 'left' : 'right']: sx > 0 ? ax : W - ax,
    [below ? 'top' : 'bottom']: below ? by : H - by,
    minWidth: 210, maxWidth: maxWidth + 2 * 36, padding: thought ? '30px 46px' : '22px 36px',
    background: '#fffdf8', borderRadius: thought ? 999 : 38,
    fontFamily: HAND, fontSize: size, lineHeight: 1.12, color: C.ink, textAlign: 'center',
    boxShadow: 'inset 0 -5px 0 rgba(40,30,80,0.08)',
  };
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill
      style={{
        pointerEvents: 'none', transform: `translateY(${bob}px) scale(${pop})`, transformOrigin: `${x}px ${y}px`,
        filter: 'drop-shadow(0 6px 0 rgba(20,14,40,0.28)) drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.35))', opacity: clamp01(t / 0.06),
      }}
    >
      <svg width={W} height={H} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
        {tail && <path d={tail} fill="#fffdf8" />}
        {dots.map((d, i) => (
          <circle key={i} cx={d.cx} cy={d.cy} r={d.r} fill="#fffdf8" opacity={clamp01((t - i * 0.06) / 0.12)} />
        ))}
      </svg>
      <div style={box}>
        <span style={{ opacity: textIn }}>{text}</span>
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// Pink heart badge with a percentage floating above a character's head: how much they like the hero.
// Anchored with `project()` like Bubble. Counts from `from` to `value` over `countDur`, pops in,
// bobs gently, and pulses when the number climbs. 0% draws a dim, hollow heart.
//
// Props
//   t         seconds since the badge appears (nothing for t < 0)
//   x, y      screen point above the head (px), from project(headTop)
//   value     target percentage 0..100
//   from      starting percentage (default: value, i.e. no count)
//   countDur  seconds for the count (default 0.9)
//   scale     px per metre at the head, so far-away badges shrink
//   dur       seconds on screen; shrinks out over the last 0.2 s (omit = stays)
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { COND, backOut, clamp01, easeIn, easeOut, seg } from '../cards/kit';

const HEART = 'M12 21.3l-1.4-1.3C5.4 15.4 2 12.3 2 8.5 2 5.4 4.4 3 7.5 3c1.7 0 3.4.8 4.5 2.1C13.1 3.8 14.8 3 16.5 3 19.6 3 22 5.4 22 8.5c0 3.8-3.4 6.9-8.6 11.5L12 21.3z';

export const CrushMeter: React.FC<{
  t: number; x: number; y: number; value: number; from?: number; countDur?: number; scale?: number; dur?: number;
}> = ({ t, x, y, value, from, countDur = 0.9, scale = 400, dur }) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const outK = dur != null ? easeIn(seg(t, dur - 0.2, dur)) : 0;
  if (outK >= 1) return null;
  const start = from ?? value;
  const k = easeOut(seg(t, 0.15, 0.15 + countDur));
  const v = Math.round(start + (value - start) * k);
  const rising = value > start && k > 0 && k < 1;
  const pop = backOut(seg(t, 0, 0.28), 2.4) * (1 - outK);
  const pulse = rising ? 1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 22) : 1;
  const size = Math.max(30, Math.min(58, scale * 0.11)); // number px, shrinks with distance
  const empty = v <= 0;
  const pink = empty ? '#c9b8c4' : '#ff4f9a';
  const bob = Math.sin(t * 2.3) * 3;
  const top = Math.max(y - size * 0.55 + bob, size * 1.45 + 14); // keep the whole badge inside the frame when the head is near the top
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none', opacity: clamp01(t / 0.06) }}>
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute', left: x, top, transform: `translate(-50%, -100%) scale(${pop * pulse})`, transformOrigin: '50% 100%',
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: size * 0.18, padding: `${size * 0.12}px ${size * 0.34}px ${size * 0.12}px ${size * 0.22}px`,
          background: empty ? 'rgba(40,30,48,0.78)' : 'rgba(58,14,40,0.82)', borderRadius: 999,
          border: `${Math.max(2, size * 0.06)}px solid ${pink}`,
          boxShadow: empty ? '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)' : `0 0 ${size * 0.5}px rgba(255,79,154,0.75), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)`,
          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
        }}
      >
        <svg width={size * 0.95} height={size * 0.95} viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path d={HEART} fill={empty ? 'none' : pink} stroke={pink} strokeWidth={empty ? 2 : 0.5} />
        </svg>
        <span style={{ fontFamily: COND, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: size, lineHeight: 1, color: empty ? '#d9cdd5' : '#ffffff', letterSpacing: 1 }}>
          {v}%
        </span>
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// 2D effect overlays drawn over (or between) 3D layers: electric crackles around a character,
// anime speed lines, full-frame flashes.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { rand } from '../engine/fx';

export type Pt = { x: number; y: number };

function bolt(r: () => number, a: Pt, b: Pt, jag: number, segs: number): string {
  const pts: Pt[] = [a];
  const dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
  const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
  const nx = -dy / len, ny = dx / len;
  for (let i = 1; i < segs; i++) {
    const k = i / segs;
    const off = (r() * 2 - 1) * jag * Math.sin(Math.PI * k);
    pts.push({ x: a.x + dx * k + nx * off, y: a.y + dy * k + ny * off });
  }
  pts.push(b);
  return 'M' + pts.map(p => `${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}`).join(' L');
}

/**
 * Electric arcs hugging a silhouette. `anchors` are screen points on/near the body (head, shoulders,
 * hands, hips); `scale` is px per metre at the subject so arcs keep a sensible size in any framing.
 */
export const Crackles: React.FC<{ frame: number; anchors: Pt[]; scale: number; center?: Pt; intensity?: number; seed?: number; color?: string; W?: number; H?: number }> = ({
  frame, anchors, scale, center, intensity = 1, seed = 1, color = '#a66bff', W = 1920, H = 1080,
}) => {
  if (intensity <= 0 || anchors.length === 0) return null;
  const bucket = Math.floor(frame / 2); // new pattern every 2 frames
  const r = rand(seed * 1000 + bucket * 17 + 3);
  const count = Math.round((1 + r() * 2.5) * intensity);
  const paths: { d: string; w: number; o: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    if (r() > 0.85) continue; // occasional gaps = flicker
    const a = anchors[Math.floor(r() * anchors.length)];
    // arcs leave the silhouette outward (away from the body centre) so they never scribble across the face
    const ang = center ? Math.atan2(a.y - center.y, a.x - center.x) + (r() - 0.5) * 1.3 : r() * Math.PI * 2;
    const len = (0.12 + r() * 0.28) * scale;
    const start = { x: a.x + Math.cos(ang) * 0.06 * scale, y: a.y + Math.sin(ang) * 0.06 * scale };
    const end = { x: start.x + Math.cos(ang + (r() - 0.5) * 0.6) * len, y: start.y + Math.sin(ang + (r() - 0.5) * 0.6) * len };
    paths.push({ d: bolt(r, start, end, len * 0.25, 6), w: 1 + r(), o: 0.7 + r() * 0.3 });
    if (r() < 0.5) {
      const mid = { x: (start.x + end.x) / 2, y: (start.y + end.y) / 2 };
      const end2 = { x: mid.x + (r() - 0.5) * len * 0.7, y: mid.y + (r() - 0.5) * len * 0.7 };
      paths.push({ d: bolt(r, mid, end2, len * 0.15, 4), w: 0.7, o: 0.6 });
    }
  }
  const sw = Math.max(1.5, scale * 0.006);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <svg width={W} height={H} viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}>
        <defs>
          <filter id={`cglow${seed}`} x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
            <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation={sw * 2.2} result="b" />
            <feMerge>
              <feMergeNode in="b" />
              <feMergeNode in="b" />
              <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
            </feMerge>
          </filter>
        </defs>
        <g filter={`url(#cglow${seed})`} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" fill="none">
          {paths.map((p, i) => (
            <g key={i} opacity={p.o * Math.min(1, intensity)}>
              <path d={p.d} stroke={color} strokeWidth={sw * 2.6 * p.w} />
              <path d={p.d} stroke="#f4ecff" strokeWidth={sw * p.w} />
            </g>
          ))}
        </g>
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** Anime speed lines streaking horizontally (dir -1 = moving left). */
export const SpeedLines: React.FC<{ t: number; n?: number; dir?: 1 | -1; speed?: number; opacity?: number; seed?: number; band?: [number, number]; W?: number; H?: number }> = ({
  t, n = 34, dir = -1, speed = 5200, opacity = 0.75, seed = 4, band = [0.04, 0.96], W = 1920, H = 1080,
}) => {
  const r = rand(seed);
  const lines: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const y = H * (band[0] + r() * (band[1] - band[0]));
    const len = 160 + r() * 700;
    const th = 1.2 + r() * 3.8;
    const span = W + len * 2;
    const x0 = r() * span;
    const v = speed * (0.6 + r() * 0.8);
    const x = ((((x0 + dir * v * t) % span) + span) % span) - len;
    const o = opacity * (0.25 + r() * 0.75);
    lines.push(
      <rect key={i} x={x} y={y - th / 2} width={len} height={th} rx={th / 2} fill={`url(#sl${seed})`} opacity={o} />,
    );
  }
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <svg width={W} height={H} viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}>
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`sl${seed}`} x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="0">
            <stop offset="0" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity={dir < 0 ? 0.95 : 0} />
            <stop offset="1" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity={dir < 0 ? 0 : 0.95} />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        {lines}
      </svg>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

export const Flash: React.FC<{ t: number; at: number; dur?: number; color?: string; peak?: number }> = ({ t, at, dur = 0.16, color = '#ffffff', peak = 0.85 }) => {
  const k = (t - at) / dur;
  if (k < 0 || k > 1) return null;
  const o = peak * (k < 0.15 ? k / 0.15 : Math.pow(1 - (k - 0.15) / 0.85, 1.6));
  return <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: color, opacity: o, mixBlendMode: 'screen', pointerEvents: 'none' }} />;
};

// Final-look overlays: IFOLOGY's heavy vignette plus fine animated film grain.
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';

export const Grade: React.FC<{ vignette?: number; grain?: number; tint?: string }> = ({ vignette = 0.55, grain = 0.035, tint }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  // A few pre-baked grain tiles cycled per frame (deterministic, cheap).
  const tiles = useMemo(() => {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.width = c.height = 256;
      const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
      const img = g.createImageData(256, 256);
      let s = 1234 + k * 999;
      for (let i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
        s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
        const v = s >>> 24;
        img.data[i] = img.data[i + 1] = img.data[i + 2] = v;
        img.data[i + 3] = 255;
      }
      g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
      out.push(c.toDataURL());
    }
    return out;
  }, []);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      {tint && <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: tint, mixBlendMode: 'soft-light' }} />}
      <AbsoluteFill
        style={{
          background: `radial-gradient(ellipse 72% 70% at 50% 48%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 52%, rgba(10,6,14,${vignette * 0.55}) 78%, rgba(6,4,10,${vignette}) 100%)`,
        }}
      />
      {grain > 0 && (
        <AbsoluteFill style={{ backgroundImage: `url(${tiles[frame % tiles.length]})`, backgroundSize: '256px 256px', opacity: grain, mixBlendMode: 'overlay' }} />
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// "Palavra-destaque": the key word of a line pops in big on its spoken cue, centred, always inside the
// 9:16 centre column (608 of 1920 px) so a hand-cut vertical short keeps it. Yellow by default (the
// payoff colour), white for setup words. Long text shrinks and wraps to stay in the column.
//
// Props
//   t      seconds since the word appears (nothing for t < 0)
//   text   the word(s), shown in caps
//   color  'yellow' (default) | 'white' | 'red' | any CSS colour
//   y      'low' (default, under the faces) | 'top' | 'mid'
//   dur    seconds on screen; shrinks away over the last 0.2 s (default 1.5)
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill } from 'remotion';
import { C, COND, backOut, easeIn, seg } from '../cards/kit';

const COLORS: Record<string, string> = { yellow: C.goldHi, white: '#ffffff', red: '#ff5a4a' };
export const KEYWORD_COLUMN = 560; // px: text box width, inside the 608 px 9:16 column

export const KeyWord: React.FC<{ t: number; text: string; color?: string; y?: 'low' | 'top' | 'mid'; dur?: number; W?: number; H?: number }> = ({
  t, text, color = 'yellow', y = 'low', dur = 1.5, W = 1920, H = 1080,
}) => {
  if (t < 0) return null;
  const outK = easeIn(seg(t, dur - 0.2, dur));
  if (outK >= 1) return null;
  const up = text.toUpperCase();
  // condensed caps run ~0.5 em per glyph: size the longest line to the column, capped at 150 px
  const longest = Math.max(...up.split(/\s+/).map(w => w.length), Math.min(up.length, 9));
  const size = Math.round(Math.min(150, KEYWORD_COLUMN / (0.52 * longest)));
  const popK = seg(t, 0, 0.22);
  const scale = (0.35 + 0.65 * backOut(popK, 2.6)) * (1 - 0.35 * outK);
  const cy = y === 'top' ? H * 0.2 : y === 'mid' ? H * 0.5 : H * 0.76;
  const fill = COLORS[color] || color;
  const ink = 'rgba(10,8,25,0.95)';
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute', left: W / 2 - KEYWORD_COLUMN / 2, width: KEYWORD_COLUMN, top: cy, transform: `translateY(-50%) scale(${scale}) rotate(${-2.5 * (1 - popK)}deg)`,
          opacity: Math.min(1, popK * 4) * (1 - outK), textAlign: 'center', fontFamily: COND, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: size, lineHeight: 0.98,
          letterSpacing: '0.02em', color: fill, WebkitTextStroke: `${Math.max(4, size * 0.07)}px ${ink}`, paintOrder: 'stroke fill',
          textShadow: `0 ${size * 0.06}px 0 ${ink}, 0 0 ${size * 0.25}px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)`,
        }}
      >
        {up}
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
