// City park: big lawn, a round paved plaza with a two-tier fountain at the origin, three curving
// paths leaving it (towards +z, -x and +x/-z), a duck pond at (-17, -14), benches, park lamps,
// flower beds, round trees, a distant tree line and hills.
//
// Heights: lawn y = 0, path top y = 0.02, plaza top y = 0.03, fountain rim top y ≈ 0.7.
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { envMaterial, flat, toon } from '../engine/materials';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import { At, Ball, Box, Cone, Cyl, G, mix, rng, Tree } from './kit';
import { RoundTree } from './suburb';
import { Bench, blob, lampsOn, mapMaterial, ParkLamp, TrashCan } from './outdoorKit';

const GRASS = '#67b04f';
const PATH = '#e6d6b4';
const PATH_EDGE = '#c9b48c';
const PLAZA = '#e9dfc9';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Geometry (module level)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const disc48 = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 56);
// water veil falling from the upper bowl (lathe points bottom -> top so faces point outwards)
const veilGeo = new THREE.LatheGeometry([[1.34, 0.52], [1.31, 0.85], [1.24, 1.18], [1.14, 1.44], [1.04, 1.57]].map(([r, y]) => new THREE.Vector2(r, y)), 48);
// distant scenery: toon bands without the rim crescent (no glowing outlines on hill silhouettes)
const farMat = (c: string) => toon(c, { rim: 0, levels: [110, 190, 255] });
const rimTorus = new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.055, 10, 64);

/** Flat ribbon along a curve (normals up), for paths. */
function ribbon(pts: [number, number][], width: number, samples = 120) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts.map(([x, z]) => new THREE.Vector3(x, 0, z)), false, 'centripetal');
  const pos: number[] = [], nrm: number[] = [], uv: number[] = [], idx: number[] = [];
  const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
    const t = i / samples;
    const p = curve.getPointAt(t);
    const tan = curve.getTangentAt(t);
    const side = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(tan, up).normalize().multiplyScalar(width / 2);
    pos.push(p.x + side.x, 0, p.z + side.z, p.x - side.x, 0, p.z - side.z);
    nrm.push(0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0);
    uv.push(0, t, 1, t);
    if (i < samples) {
      const a = i * 2;
      idx.push(a, a + 2, a + 1, a + 1, a + 2, a + 3);
    }
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nrm, 3));
  g.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
  g.setIndex(idx);
  return { geo: g, curve };
}

const PATHS: [number, number][][] = [
  [[0, 6.5], [1.5, 13], [-2.5, 21], [-2, 30], [4, 42], [6, 60]], // A: towards the default camera (+z)
  [[-6.5, 0], [-13, -2.5], [-21, 1.5], [-31, -0.5], [-44, -5], [-62, -4]], // B: west (-x)
  [[4.6, -4.6], [10, -9.5], [17, -8.5], [26, -13], [40, -11], [58, -16]], // C: east / back
];
const PATH_W = 2.6;
const pathGeos = PATHS.map(p => ({ inner: ribbon(p, PATH_W), edge: ribbon(p, PATH_W + 0.36) }));

/** Point on path i at parameter t (for placing benches/lamps beside it). */
function along(i: number, t: number, offset = 0): { p: Vec3; ry: number } {
  const c = pathGeos[i].inner.curve;
  const p = c.getPointAt(t), tan = c.getTangentAt(t);
  const side = new THREE.Vector3(-tan.z, 0, tan.x).normalize(); // left of travel
  return { p: [p.x + side.x * offset, 0, p.z + side.z * offset], ry: Math.atan2(-side.x * Math.sign(offset || 1), -side.z * Math.sign(offset || 1)) };
}

// Streaky translucent material for the falling water veil (vertical streams, brighter at the lip).
let veilMat: THREE.MeshBasicMaterial | null = null;
function veilMaterial() {
  if (veilMat) return veilMat;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = 256;
  c.height = 64;
  const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
  const rand = rng(77);
  for (let x = 0; x < 256; x += 4) {
    const a = 0.12 + rand() * 0.55;
    g.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${a.toFixed(2)})`;
    g.fillRect(x, 0, 2 + Math.floor(rand() * 3), 64);
  }
  const grd = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 64);
  grd.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)');
  grd.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  g.fillStyle = grd;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 64);
  const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  t.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  t.repeat.set(5, 1);
  t.flipY = false; // v = 0 at the bottom of the lathe, canvas row 0 = top: flip so the lip gets the bright band
  veilMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: t, color: '#d6f2ff', transparent: true, depthWrite: false, toneMapped: false });
  return veilMat;
}

// Pond (ellipse) and picnic blanket texture
const POND: { c: [number, number]; rx: number; rz: number } = { c: [-17, -14], rx: 7.2, rz: 4.6 };
let checker: THREE.CanvasTexture | null = null;
function checkerTex() {
  if (checker) return checker;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = 128;
  const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
    g.fillStyle = (i + j) % 2 ? '#f6f1e6' : '#d8433a';
    g.fillRect(i * 16, j * 16, 16, 16);
  }
  checker = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  checker.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  checker.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
  return checker;
}

// Spots trees must avoid (plaza, paths, pond, picnic).
function clearOf(x: number, z: number, margin: number) {
  if (Math.hypot(x, z) < 10 + margin) return false;
  const dx = (x - POND.c[0]) / (POND.rx + margin + 1.5), dz = (z - POND.c[1]) / (POND.rz + margin + 1.5);
  if (dx * dx + dz * dz < 1) return false;
  for (const p of PATHS) for (let i = 0; i < p.length - 1; i++) {
    const [ax, az] = p[i], [bx, bz] = p[i + 1];
    const vx = bx - ax, vz = bz - az, L = vx * vx + vz * vz;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((x - ax) * vx + (z - az) * vz) / L));
    if (Math.hypot(x - (ax + vx * t), z - (az + vz * t)) < PATH_W / 2 + margin + 1.2) return false;
  }
  if (Math.hypot(x - 9, z - 9) < 4.5) return false; // picnic lawn
  return true;
}

// Trees: hand-placed framing trees + a scattered grove (deterministic).
const TREES: { p: Vec3; s: number; seed: number; pine?: boolean }[] = (() => {
  const out: { p: Vec3; s: number; seed: number; pine?: boolean }[] = [
    { p: [-9, 0, 9], s: 1.15, seed: 1 }, { p: [10, 0, 2.5], s: 1.25, seed: 2 }, { p: [-9.5, 0, -11], s: 1.1, seed: 3 },
    { p: [6, 0, -14], s: 1.3, seed: 4 }, { p: [-5, 0, -13], s: 1.0, seed: 5 }, { p: [-26, 0, -10], s: 1.2, seed: 6 },
    { p: [-8, 0, 20], s: 1.2, seed: 7 }, { p: [7, 0, 22], s: 1.1, seed: 8 }, { p: [16, 0, 0], s: 1.0, seed: 9, pine: true },
  ];
  const rand = rng(41);
  let tries = 0;
  while (out.length < 60 && tries++ < 2000) {
    const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2, r = 14 + rand() * 46;
    const x = Math.cos(a) * r, z = Math.sin(a) * r;
    if (!clearOf(x, z, 1.5)) continue;
    if (out.some(t => Math.hypot(t.p[0] - x, t.p[2] - z) < 5.5)) continue;
    out.push({ p: [x, 0, z], s: 0.95 + rand() * 0.45, seed: 20 + out.length, pine: rand() < 0.18 });
  }
  return out;
})();

const FLOWER_COLS = ['#e8453c', '#f2b632', '#f07fb0', '#ffffff', '#9a6be0', '#ff8a3a'];
const FlowerBed: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; rx: number; rz: number; seed: number; r?: number }> = ({ p, rx, rz, seed, r = 0 }) => {
  const rand = rng(seed);
  const flowers: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.round(rx * rz * 5); i++) {
    const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2, d = Math.sqrt(rand()) * 0.88;
    flowers.push(<Ball key={i} p={[Math.cos(a) * rx * d, 0.16 + rand() * 0.08, Math.sin(a) * rz * d]} s={0.09 + rand() * 0.05} c={FLOWER_COLS[Math.floor(rand() * FLOWER_COLS.length)]} ico shadow={false} />);
  }
  return (
    <At p={p} r={r}>
      <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial('#7a5a42')} position={[0, 0.04, 0]} scale={[rx, 0.08, rz]} receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={blob} material={envMaterial('#4f9b45')} position={[0, 0.08, 0]} scale={[rx * 0.92, 0.12, rz * 0.92]} receiveShadow />
      {flowers}
    </At>
  );
};

const Duck: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; r?: number; s?: number; c?: string }> = ({ p, r = 0, s = 1, c = '#f6f1e6' }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r} s={s}>
    <Ball p={[0, 0.1, 0]} s={[0.17, 0.12, 0.25]} c={c} />
    <Ball p={[0, 0.27, 0.15]} s={0.09} c={c === '#f6f1e6' ? '#2f7a5a' : c} />
    <Cone p={[0, 0.26, 0.27]} r={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[0.035, 0.09, 0.035]} c="#f28a2b" />
    <Ball p={[0.05, 0.3, 0.2]} s={0.014} c="#111" />
    <Ball p={[-0.05, 0.3, 0.2]} s={0.014} c="#111" />
  </At>
);

const Fountain: React.FC = () => {
  const stone = '#d6ccb9', stoneD = '#bfb39e';
  const water = '#6cc3ea';
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial(stoneD)} position={[0, 0.25, 0]} scale={[2.75, 0.5, 2.75]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={rimTorus} material={envMaterial(stone)} position={[0, 0.56, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[2.62, 2.62, 2.4]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial(water)} position={[0, 0.505, 0]} scale={[2.6, 0.01, 2.6]} receiveShadow />
      {/* ripples */}
      {[1.3, 1.9].map(r => <mesh key={r} geometry={rimTorus} material={flat('#bfe9fb', 0.6)} position={[0, 0.515, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[r, r, 0.2]} />)}
      {/* column + upper bowl */}
      <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial(stone)} position={[0, 0.95, 0]} scale={[0.32, 1.0, 0.32]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial(stoneD)} position={[0, 1.5, 0]} scale={[1.05, 0.22, 1.05]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={rimTorus} material={envMaterial(stone)} position={[0, 1.62, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[1.02, 1.02, 1.4]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial(water)} position={[0, 1.615, 0]} scale={[1.0, 0.01, 1.0]} />
      {/* water: jet with a tapering tip + droplets, a thin veil spilling from the upper bowl */}
      <mesh geometry={disc48} material={flat('#e2f6ff', 0.85)} position={[0, 2.0, 0]} scale={[0.06, 0.8, 0.06]} />
      <mesh geometry={G.cone} material={flat('#eefaff', 0.85)} position={[0, 2.55, 0]} scale={[0.09, 0.3, 0.09]} />
      {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => {
        const a = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = 0.22 + (i % 3) * 0.12;
        return <Ball key={'d' + i} p={[Math.cos(a) * r, 2.5 - (i % 3) * 0.22, Math.sin(a) * r]} s={0.035} c="#eaf9ff" glow />;
      })}
      <mesh geometry={veilGeo} material={veilMaterial()} renderOrder={3} />
    </group>
  );
};

const PicnicBlanket: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; r?: number }> = ({ p, r = 0 }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <mesh geometry={G.box} material={mapMaterial(checkerTex())} position={[0, 0.012, 0]} scale={[2.2, 0.02, 1.7]} receiveShadow />
    <At p={[0.6, 0.02, -0.3]}>
      <Box p={[0, 0.16, 0]} s={[0.55, 0.32, 0.36]} c="#b5703f" />
      <Box p={[0, 0.34, 0]} s={[0.58, 0.05, 0.4]} c="#8a5532" />
    </At>
    <Ball p={[-0.6, 0.14, 0.35]} s={0.13} c="#d8433a" />
    <Ball p={[-0.35, 0.12, 0.45]} s={0.11} c="#7fc24a" />
  </At>
);

// winter (variant odd): snow on the lawn, the pond frozen over (pale ice, no ducks or lily pads), frosted hills
const SNOW = '#e9f0f4';
const ICE = '#cfe6f1';
const ParkScene: React.FC<{ time: string; winter?: boolean }> = React.memo(({ time, winter }) => {
  const on = lampsOn(time);
  const rand = rng(9);
  // benches around the plaza, facing the fountain
  const plazaBenches = [20, 135, 215, 250, 340].map(deg => {
    const a = (deg * Math.PI) / 180, r = 6.3;
    return { p: [Math.cos(a) * r, 0.03, Math.sin(a) * r] as Vec3, ry: Math.atan2(-Math.cos(a), -Math.sin(a)) };
  });
  // lamps along paths (alternating sides) and around the plaza
  const lamps: Vec3[] = [];
  [0, 1, 2].forEach(i => [0.12, 0.34, 0.56, 0.78].forEach((t, j) => lamps.push(along(i, t, (j % 2 ? 1 : -1) * (PATH_W / 2 + 0.7)).p)));
  [65, 160, 290].forEach(deg => {
    const a = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
    lamps.push([Math.cos(a) * 8.6, 0, Math.sin(a) * 8.6]);
  });
  const pathBenches = [along(0, 0.2, 2.2), along(1, 0.24, -2.2), along(2, 0.3, 2.2), along(0, 0.5, -2.2)];
  return (
    <group>
      {/* lawn */}
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={envMaterial(winter ? SNOW : GRASS)} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[700, 700, 1]} receiveShadow />
      {/* plaza */}
      <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial(mix(PLAZA, '#000', 0.12))} position={[0, 0.0, 0]} scale={[8.0, 0.05, 8.0]} receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial(PLAZA)} position={[0, 0.005, 0]} scale={[7.6, 0.05, 7.6]} receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={rimTorus} material={envMaterial(mix(PLAZA, '#000', 0.08))} position={[0, 0.031, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[4.6, 4.6, 0.25]} receiveShadow />
      <Fountain />
      {/* paths */}
      {pathGeos.map((g, i) => (
        <group key={i}>
          <mesh geometry={g.edge.geo} material={envMaterial(PATH_EDGE)} position={[0, 0.012, 0]} receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={g.inner.geo} material={envMaterial(PATH)} position={[0, 0.02, 0]} receiveShadow />
        </group>
      ))}
      {plazaBenches.map((b, i) => <Bench key={i} p={b.p} r={b.ry} />)}
      {pathBenches.map((b, i) => <Bench key={'pb' + i} p={[b.p[0], 0, b.p[2]]} r={b.ry} c="#a8653a" />)}
      <TrashCan p={[plazaBenches[1].p[0] * 1.14 + 1.3, 0.03, plazaBenches[1].p[2] * 1.14]} c="#2f6b4f" />
      <TrashCan p={[pathBenches[0].p[0] + 1.4, 0, pathBenches[0].p[2]]} c="#2f6b4f" />
      {lamps.map((p, i) => <ParkLamp key={i} p={p} on={on} />)}
      {/* flower beds between the paths, bushes round the plaza */}
      <FlowerBed p={[-6.4, 0, 6.6]} rx={2.2} rz={1.3} r={0.8} seed={1} />
      <FlowerBed p={[6.9, 0, 4.6]} rx={2.0} rz={1.2} r={-0.6} seed={2} />
      <FlowerBed p={[-3.2, 0, -8.6]} rx={2.4} rz={1.2} r={0.3} seed={3} />
      {[[-8.2, 3.4], [8.6, -1.5], [2.0, -9.4], [-6.9, -5.6], [9.6, 6.8]].map(([x, z], i) => (
        <group key={i}>
          <mesh geometry={blob} material={envMaterial('#4e9a45')} position={[x, 0.42, z]} scale={[0.95, 0.62, 0.8]} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={blob} material={envMaterial('#58a54d')} position={[x + 0.7, 0.32, z + 0.2]} scale={0.55} castShadow receiveShadow />
        </group>
      ))}
      {/* pond */}
      <At p={[POND.c[0], 0, POND.c[1]]}>
        <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial('#d9c79c')} position={[0, 0.0, 0]} scale={[POND.rx + 0.7, 0.04, POND.rz + 0.7]} receiveShadow />
        <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial(winter ? ICE : '#5cb6e0')} position={[0, 0.012, 0]} scale={[POND.rx, 0.04, POND.rz]} receiveShadow />
        <mesh geometry={disc48} material={envMaterial(winter ? '#dcf0f8' : '#4aa3d2')} position={[0.6, 0.02, -0.3]} scale={[POND.rx * 0.62, 0.04, POND.rz * 0.6]} receiveShadow />
        {Array.from({ length: 22 }, (_, i) => {
          const a = (i / 22) * Math.PI * 2 + rand() * 0.15;
          return <Ball key={i} p={[Math.cos(a) * (POND.rx + 0.45), 0.08, Math.sin(a) * (POND.rz + 0.45)]} s={[0.32 + rand() * 0.2, 0.18 + rand() * 0.1, 0.28 + rand() * 0.15]} c={rand() < 0.5 ? '#a9a49a' : '#bdb7ab'} ico />;
        })}
        {!winter && [[-3.5, -1.5], [2.5, 1.8], [-1, 2.4], [4.4, -1.2]].map(([x, z], i) => (
          <mesh key={i} geometry={G.circle} material={envMaterial('#4f9a45')} position={[x, 0.05, z]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, i]} scale={0.42 + (i % 2) * 0.12} receiveShadow />
        ))}
        {Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => (
          <Cyl key={i} p={[-6.3 + (i % 3) * 0.35, 0.5 + (i % 2) * 0.12, -1.6 + Math.floor(i / 3) * 0.4]} r={[0, 0, (i % 3 - 1) * 0.12]} s={[0.03, 1.0 + (i % 2) * 0.25, 0.03]} c="#4f8a3a" seg8 />
        ))}
        {!winter && <>
          <Duck p={[1.2, 0.03, 0.4]} r={2.2} />
          <Duck p={[2.3, 0.03, -0.6]} r={2.6} c="#f2c53c" s={0.6} />
          <Duck p={[2.9, 0.03, -1.1]} r={2.4} c="#f2c53c" s={0.6} />
        </>}
      </At>
      {/* picnic */}
      <PicnicBlanket p={[9, 0, 9]} r={0.4} />
      {/* trees */}
      {TREES.map((t, i) => (t.pine ? <Tree key={i} p={t.p} s={t.s * 1.5} kind="pine" leaf="#3f8a4f" /> : <RoundTree key={i} p={t.p} s={t.s} seed={t.seed} />))}
      {/* distant tree line + hills (fogged) */}
      {Array.from({ length: 36 }, (_, i) => {
        const a = (i / 36) * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = 78 + (i % 3) * 7;
        return <mesh key={i} geometry={blob} material={farMat(winter ? (i % 2 ? '#c9d9de' : '#bfd2d8') : i % 2 ? '#4b8f4a' : '#45874a')} position={[Math.cos(a) * r, 3, Math.sin(a) * r]} rotation={[0, -a, 0]} scale={[7, 7 + (i % 4), 15]} />;
      })}
      {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => {
        const a = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.3;
        return <mesh key={'h' + i} geometry={blob} material={farMat(winter ? '#d6e3e8' : '#5c9c55')} position={[Math.cos(a) * 160, -8, Math.sin(a) * 160]} scale={[60, 26 + (i % 3) * 8, 60]} />;
      })}
    </group>
  );
});

export const ParkSet: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ time, variant }) => <ParkScene time={time} winter={variant % 2 === 1} />;

const benchMark = (() => {
  const a = (135 * Math.PI) / 180;
  return [Math.cos(a) * 6.3, 0.03, Math.sin(a) * 6.3] as Vec3;
})();

export const PARK_MARKS: Record<string, Vec3> = {
  center: [0, 0.03, 4.6], // on the plaza in front of the fountain (camera on +z)
  fountain: [0, 0.03, 3.2], // right at the fountain rim
  bench: benchMark, // seat of the plaza bench at 135°: sit here with rot 135 (degrees, faces the fountain)
  path: along(0, 0.3).p.map((v, i) => (i === 1 ? 0.02 : v)) as Vec3, // on the main path towards +z
  pathFar: along(0, 0.6).p.map((v, i) => (i === 1 ? 0.02 : v)) as Vec3,
  pond: [-12.5, 0, -8.6], // lawn at the pond's edge, ducks in front (-z)
  ice: [-15.5, 0.03, -12.6], // out on the (winter) pond ice, ~3 m from the near shore
  shore: [-11.6, 0, -9.0], // near shore of the pond, facing the ice (rot ~ -125)
  lawn: [6, 0, 12], // open grass by the picnic blanket
  picnic: [9, 0.02, 9],
  west: along(1, 0.35).p.map((v, i) => (i === 1 ? 0.02 : v)) as Vec3, // path B (towards -x)
};

const N = (v: unknown, d: number) => (typeof v === 'number' ? v : d);
const flameGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 7);
const flameOuter = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#ff5a1a', toneMapped: false });
const flameInner = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#ffd34d', toneMapped: false });

/** Toon flame tongues on a ring; k = 0..1 grows them in. */
const Flames: React.FC<{ r: number; k: number; t: number }> = ({ r, k, t }) => {
  if (k <= 0) return null;
  const tongues = Array.from({ length: 22 }, (_, i) => {
    const inner = i >= 15, a = (i / (inner ? 7 : 15)) * Math.PI * 2 + (inner ? 0.4 : 0);
    const rr = r * (inner ? 0.42 : 0.82), f = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * (7 + (i % 5)) + i * 1.7));
    const h = k * r * (inner ? 0.9 : 0.75) * f, w = r * (inner ? 0.16 : 0.13) * (0.6 + 0.4 * k);
    return <mesh key={i} geometry={flameGeo} material={inner ? flameInner : flameOuter} position={[Math.cos(a) * rr, h / 2 + 0.01, Math.sin(a) * rr]} scale={[w, h, w]} renderOrder={5} />;
  });
  return (
    <group>
      {tongues}
      <Glow p={[0, r * 0.45, 0]} size={r * 3.2} color="#ff7a2f" opacity={0.55 * k} />
    </group>
  );
};
const S = (v: unknown, d: string) => (typeof v === 'string' ? v : d);
const triGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 3);
const V3 = (v: unknown, d: Vec3): Vec3 => (Array.isArray(v) && v.length === 3 ? (v as Vec3) : d);

/** Billowing toon smoke: opaque grey puffs rise from the origin, swell, drift with the wind and
 *  shrink away at the top. Deterministic in t. */
const SMOKE_SHADES = ['#3f3b45', '#524e58', '#67636d', '#7e7a83', '#96929a'];
export const Smoke: React.FC<{ t: number; h?: number; r?: number; n?: number; wind?: [number, number]; speed?: number; seed?: number; out?: number }> = ({ t, h = 8, r = 0.5, n = 34, wind = [0.25, 0.05], speed = 1.1, seed = 1, out = 0 }) => {
  const puffs: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const rnd = (k: number) => { const x = Math.sin(i * 12.9898 + seed * 78.233 + k * 37.719) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x); };
    const ph = (((t * speed) / h + i / n + rnd(1) * 0.25) % 1 + 1) % 1; // 0 = source, 1 = top
    const spread = r * (0.5 + 2.4 * ph);
    const drift = ph * ph * h;
    // `out`: smoke first rolls out of the opening (+z) before it climbs
    const p: Vec3 = [wind[0] * drift + (rnd(2) - 0.5) * spread, ph * h, wind[1] * drift + (rnd(3) - 0.5) * spread + out * Math.min(1, ph * 5)];
    const grow = Math.min(1, ph / 0.08) * Math.min(1, (1 - ph) / 0.18);
    const size = r * (0.6 + 1.9 * ph) * grow * (0.8 + 0.4 * rnd(4));
    if (size < 0.02) continue;
    const shade = SMOKE_SHADES[Math.min(SMOKE_SHADES.length - 1, Math.floor(ph * SMOKE_SHADES.length + rnd(5) * 0.8))];
    puffs.push(<mesh key={i} geometry={G.ico} material={envMaterial(shade)} position={p} scale={size} />);
  }
  return <group>{puffs}</group>;
};

/** Ladder-truck basket. Origin = 0.1 m under the rider's feet (so it can `follow` an actor);
 *  `from` = world point of the ladder pivot on the truck: the boom is drawn from there to the basket. */
const Basket: React.FC<{ pos: Vec3; from?: Vec3; c: string }> = ({ pos, from, c }) => {
  const rail = '#d9dde4';
  let boom: React.ReactNode = null;
  if (from) {
    const a = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.2, 0.25);
    const b = new THREE.Vector3(from[0] - pos[0], from[1] - pos[1], from[2] - pos[2]);
    const d = b.clone().sub(a), len = d.length();
    const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), d.clone().normalize());
    const mid = a.clone().add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
    const rungs = Math.floor(len / 0.45);
    boom = (
      <group position={mid.toArray()} quaternion={q}>
        {[-0.32, 0.32].map(z => <Box key={z} p={[0, 0, z]} s={[len, 0.2, 0.08]} c="#b9bec8" />)}
        <Box p={[0, -0.12, 0]} s={[len, 0.06, 0.6]} c="#8d929c" />
        {Array.from({ length: rungs }, (_, i) => <Box key={i} p={[-len / 2 + (i + 0.5) * (len / rungs), 0.02, 0]} s={[0.05, 0.05, 0.62]} c={rail} />)}
      </group>
    );
  }
  return (
    <group>
      {boom}
      <Box p={[0, 0.05, 0]} s={[1.3, 0.1, 1.0]} c={c} />
      {/* solid lower panels, open rails above */}
      <Box p={[0, 0.38, 0.49]} s={[1.3, 0.56, 0.04]} c={c} />
      <Box p={[0, 0.38, -0.49]} s={[1.3, 0.56, 0.04]} c={c} />
      {[-0.64, 0.64].map(x => <Box key={x} p={[x, 0.38, 0]} s={[0.04, 0.56, 1.0]} c={c} />)}
      {[[-0.62, -0.47], [0.62, -0.47], [-0.62, 0.47], [0.62, 0.47]].map(([x, z], i) => <Box key={i} p={[x, 0.62, z]} s={[0.05, 1.05, 0.05]} c={rail} />)}
      {[-0.47, 0.47].map(z => <Box key={z} p={[0, 1.13, z]} s={[1.3, 0.05, 0.05]} c={rail} />)}
      {[-0.62, 0.62].map(x => <Box key={x} p={[x, 1.13, 0]} s={[0.05, 0.05, 1.0]} c={rail} />)}
    </group>
  );
};

/** Red ladder truck, length along x with the cab at -x. Ladder pivot (turntable top) at local [2.6, 2.75, 0].
 *  `stowed` draws the ladder folded along the roof (no basket shot). */
const FireTruck: React.FC<{ t: number; c: string; stowed?: boolean }> = ({ t, c, stowed }) => {
  const on = Math.floor(t * 4) % 2 === 0;
  return (
    <group>
      <Box p={[0.4, 0.95, 0]} s={[8.4, 1.1, 2.5]} c={c} />
      <Box p={[0.9, 1.9, 0]} s={[5.6, 0.85, 2.46]} c={mix(c, '#000', 0.12)} />
      <Box p={[-3.6, 1.95, 0]} s={[1.9, 1.5, 2.45]} c={c} />
      <Box p={[-4.56, 2.15, 0]} s={[0.04, 0.75, 2.1]} c="#a9c6de" />
      {[-1, 1].map(s => <Box key={s} p={[-3.55, 2.15, s * 1.23]} s={[1.2, 0.6, 0.03]} c="#a9c6de" />)}
      {[-1, 1].map(s => <Box key={'st' + s} p={[0.4, 1.12, s * 1.26]} s={[8.4, 0.14, 0.02]} c="#f4f1ea" />)}
      {[-3.1, 1.6, 3.3].flatMap(x => [-1, 1].map(s => <Cyl key={`${x}${s}`} p={[x, 0.5, s * 1.12]} r={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[0.5, 0.32, 0.5]} c="#1b1b20" />))}
      <Box p={[-3.6, 2.76, -0.45]} s={[0.35, 0.13, 0.8]} c={on ? '#ff3b30' : '#6a1a16'} glow={on} />
      <Box p={[-3.6, 2.76, 0.45]} s={[0.35, 0.13, 0.8]} c={!on ? '#3b8bff' : '#16306a'} glow={!on} />
      {on && <Glow p={[-3.6, 2.9, -0.45]} size={1.6} color="#ff3b30" opacity={0.5} />}
      {!on && <Glow p={[-3.6, 2.9, 0.45]} size={1.6} color="#3b8bff" opacity={0.5} />}
      <Cyl p={[2.6, 2.5, 0]} s={[0.8, 0.3, 0.8]} c="#9aa0aa" />
      {[-1, 1].flatMap(sx => [-1, 1].map(sz => <Box key={`o${sx}${sz}`} p={[0.4 + sx * 3.6, 0.25, sz * 1.65]} s={[0.25, 0.5, 0.8]} c="#9aa0aa" />))}
      {stowed && <Box p={[-0.2, 2.82, 0]} s={[6.4, 0.2, 0.75]} c="#b9bec8" />}
    </group>
  );
};

/** A pair of binoculars lying on a surface, barrels pointing along +z. */
const Binoculars: React.FC = () => (
  <At p={[0, 0.04, 0]}>
    {[-1, 1].map(s => (
      <group key={s}>
        <Cyl p={[s * 0.045, 0, 0]} r={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[0.036, 0.14, 0.036]} c="#22252f" />
        <Cyl p={[s * 0.045, 0, 0.075]} r={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[0.04, 0.02, 0.04]} c="#3a3f4c" />
        <Cyl p={[s * 0.045, 0, 0.087]} r={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} s={[0.028, 0.004, 0.028]} c="#8fc2ff" glow />
      </group>
    ))}
    <Box p={[0, 0.01, -0.02]} s={[0.06, 0.03, 0.06]} c="#3a3f4c" />
  </At>
);

/** Free-standing prop by name. Every prop sits on y=0 at its origin unless noted. */
export const WorldProp: React.FC<{ spec: PropSpec; t: number }> = ({ spec, t }) => {
  const c = spec.color;
  const body = (() => {
    switch (spec.type) {
      case 'table': return <Table c={c || '#9b6a4a'} w={N(spec.w, 1.4)} d={N(spec.d, 0.8)} />;
      case 'roundTable': return <Table round w={N(spec.w, 0.9)} c={c || '#8f6a52'} cloth={S(spec.cloth, '') || undefined} />;
      case 'chair': return <Chair c={c} />;
      case 'bed': return <Bed c={c} />;
      case 'desk': return <Desk c={c} screen={S(spec.screen, '#7fb2ff')} lamp={!!spec.lamp} />;
      case 'deskLamp': return <DeskLamp />;
      case 'door': return <Door c={c} />;
      case 'window': return <Window glass={S(spec.glass, spec.lit ? '#ffd27e' : '#9fc6e8')} lit={!!spec.lit} w={N(spec.w, 1.2)} h={N(spec.h, 1.4)} />;
      case 'shelf': return <Shelf c={c} />;
      case 'plant': return <Plant leaf={c} />;
      case 'tree': return <Tree kind={(spec.kind as 'round') || 'round'} leaf={c} />;
      case 'bush': return <Bush c={c} />;
      case 'lamp': return <StreetLamp on={!!spec.on} />;
      case 'fence': return <Fence len={N(spec.len, 4)} c={c} />;
      case 'car': return <Car c={c} />;
      case 'house': return <House c={c} lit={!!spec.lit} seed={N(spec.seed, 1)} />;
      case 'building': return <Building c={c} h={N(spec.h, 20)} w={N(spec.w, 8)} lit={!!spec.lit} seed={N(spec.seed, 1)} />;
      case 'clock': return <WallClock t={t} frozen={!!spec.frozen} />;
      case 'rug': return <Rug c={c} w={N(spec.w, 2.4)} d={N(spec.d, 1.6)} round={!!spec.round} />;
      case 'crowd': return <Crowd rows={N(spec.rows, 4)} cols={N(spec.cols, 12)} seed={N(spec.seed, 5)} />;
      case 'sign': return <Sign w={N(spec.w, 2)} h={N(spec.h, 0.6)} text={S(spec.text, 'SIGN')} bg={S(spec.bg, '#1d2333')} fg={S(spec.fg, '#ffffff')} />;
      case 'screen': return <Sign w={N(spec.w, 1.6)} h={N(spec.h, 0.9)} text={S(spec.text, '')} bg={c || '#16203a'} fg={S(spec.fg, '#f0b44c')} />;
      case 'box':
      case 'crate': return <Box p={[0, N(spec.h, 0.5) / 2, 0]} s={[N(spec.w, 0.5), N(spec.h, 0.5), N(spec.d, 0.5)]} c={c || '#b98a5e'} />;
      case 'ball': return <Ball p={[0, 0.11, 0]} s={0.11} c={c || '#f4f1ea'} />;
      case 'basketball': return <Ball p={[0, 0.12, 0]} s={0.12} c={c || '#e0702b'} />;
      case 'jar': return (
        <At>
          <Cyl p={[0, 0.13, 0]} s={[0.1, 0.26, 0.1]} c={c || '#cfeee4'} />
          {spec.empty ? null : <Cyl p={[0, 0.09, 0]} s={[0.08, 0.14, 0.08]} c="#8dff6a" glow />}
          <Cyl p={[0, 0.28, 0]} s={[0.105, 0.045, 0.105]} c="#2b2d36" />
        </At>
      );
      case 'cup': return <At p={[0, 0.06, 0]}><Cyl s={[0.045, 0.11, 0.045]} c={c || '#f3efe6'} /></At>;
      case 'phone': return (
        <At p={[0, 0.006, 0]} r={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <Box s={[0.075, 0.15, 0.012]} c="#17181e" />
          <Plane p={[0, 0, 0.007]} s={[0.064, 0.135, 1]} c={spec.broken ? '#3a3d48' : c || '#8fc2ff'} glow={!spec.broken} />
          {spec.broken ? (
            <>
              <Box p={[-0.008, 0.02, 0.009]} r={[0, 0, 0.9]} s={[0.05, 0.003, 0.002]} c="#e9edf5" />
              <Box p={[0.012, -0.012, 0.009]} r={[0, 0, -0.5]} s={[0.055, 0.003, 0.002]} c="#e9edf5" />
              <Box p={[0.004, -0.04, 0.009]} r={[0, 0, 1.3]} s={[0.04, 0.003, 0.002]} c="#e9edf5" />
            </>
          ) : null}
        </At>
      );
      case 'book': return <Box p={[0, 0.02, 0]} s={[0.17, 0.04, 0.23]} c={c || '#c8402f'} />;
      case 'laptop': return (
        <At>
          <Box p={[0, 0.01, 0]} s={[0.36, 0.02, 0.25]} c="#c9ccd4" />
          <Box p={[0, 0.13, -0.12]} r={[-0.25, 0, 0]} s={[0.36, 0.24, 0.015]} c="#c9ccd4" />
          <Plane p={[0, 0.13, -0.11]} r={[-0.25, 0, 0]} s={[0.32, 0.2, 1]} c={c || '#8fc2ff'} glow />
        </At>
      );
      case 'glow': return <Ball p={[0, N(spec.y, 1), 0]} s={N(spec.size, 0.3)} c={c || '#ffe08a'} glow />;
      case 'pillar': return <Cyl p={[0, N(spec.h, 3) / 2, 0]} s={[N(spec.w, 0.3), N(spec.h, 3), N(spec.w, 0.3)]} c={c || '#d8d2c4'} />;
      case 'wall': return <Box p={[0, N(spec.h, 3) / 2, 0]} s={[N(spec.w, 4), N(spec.h, 3), 0.15]} c={c || '#d8cfc0'} />;
      case 'portal': return (
        <At p={[0, 1.3, 0]}>
          <mesh rotation={[0, 0, 0]} scale={[1, 1.4, 1]}>
            <torusGeometry args={[0.9, 0.08, 12, 48]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial color={c || '#8fd3ff'} toneMapped={false} />
          </mesh>
          <Plane s={[1.7, 2.4, 1]} c={mix(c || '#8fd3ff', '#ffffff', 0.4)} glow opacity={0.6} />
        </At>
      );
      case 'cone': return <Cone p={[0, 0.35, 0]} s={[0.22, 0.7, 0.22]} c={c || '#f07b2b'} />;
      case 'spot': {
        // a flat glowing ring on the floor ("the spot you leave behind")
        // `ignite` (seconds, cue-resolved): flames grow in over 0.5 s from that time
        const r = N(spec.size, 0.6);
        const ig = typeof spec.ignite === 'number' ? spec.ignite : undefined;
        const k = ig === undefined ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - ig) / 0.5));
        return (
          <group>
            <At p={[0, 0.012, 0]} r={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
              <mesh scale={r} renderOrder={3}><circleGeometry args={[1, 48]} /><meshBasicMaterial color={c || '#b07cff'} transparent opacity={0.35 + 0.4 * k} depthWrite={false} toneMapped={false} /></mesh>
              <mesh scale={r} renderOrder={4}><ringGeometry args={[0.86, 1, 64]} /><meshBasicMaterial color="#ffffff" transparent opacity={0.85} depthWrite={false} toneMapped={false} /></mesh>
              <mesh scale={r * 1.25} renderOrder={3}><ringGeometry args={[0.8, 1, 64]} /><meshBasicMaterial color={c || '#b07cff'} transparent opacity={0.25} depthWrite={false} toneMapped={false} /></mesh>
            </At>
            <Flames r={r} k={k} t={t} />
          </group>
        );
      }
      case 'dog': return (
        // a small toon dog facing +z: body, head with ears and snout, four legs, tail up; wags with t
        <At>
          <Box p={[0, 0.42, 0]} s={[0.26, 0.24, 0.55]} c={c || '#b5793f'} />
          <Box p={[0, 0.6, 0.33]} s={[0.22, 0.2, 0.22]} c={c || '#b5793f'} />
          <Box p={[0, 0.56, 0.47]} s={[0.12, 0.09, 0.1]} c="#e9d2b0" />
          <Box p={[0, 0.58, 0.53]} s={[0.05, 0.04, 0.03]} c="#1b1b20" />
          {[-1, 1].map(k => <Box key={'e' + k} p={[k * 0.09, 0.72, 0.3]} r={[0, 0, k * 0.3]} s={[0.06, 0.12, 0.05]} c="#6e4524" />)}
          {[[-1, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, 1]].map(([x, z], i) => <Box key={i} p={[x * 0.09, 0.15, z * 0.2]} s={[0.07, 0.3, 0.07]} c={c || '#b5793f'} />)}
          <At p={[0, 0.52, -0.28]} r={[-0.7, Math.sin(t * 14) * 0.5, 0]}><Box p={[0, 0.1, 0]} s={[0.05, 0.22, 0.05]} c={c || '#b5793f'} /></At>
        </At>
      );
      case 'iceHole': {
        // a break in pond ice: crack lines grow over the second before `ignite` (cue-resolved), then the
        // hole opens (dark water, broken slabs round the rim). `cracks: true` = cracks only, no hole.
        // An actor standing at the same spot with pos y ≈ -0.9 reads as treading water (the water disc hides the body).
        const r = N(spec.size, 0.75);
        const ig = typeof spec.ignite === 'number' ? spec.ignite : undefined;
        const ck = ig === undefined ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - ig + 1) / 1));
        const open = !spec.cracks && (ig === undefined || t >= ig);
        const ok = open ? Math.min(1, (t - (ig ?? -1)) / 0.15) : 0;
        return (
          <group>
            {Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => {
              const a = (i / 9) * Math.PI * 2 + (i % 3) * 0.31;
              const L = r * (1.4 + (i % 4) * 0.45) * ck;
              return <Box key={i} p={[Math.cos(a) * L / 2, 0.036, Math.sin(a) * L / 2]} r={[0, -a, 0]} s={[Math.max(0.001, L), 0.004, 0.025]} c="#5f7f90" />;
            })}
            {open && (
              <>
                <At p={[0, 0.038, 0]} s={[ok, 1, ok]}>
                  <Cyl s={[r, 0.01, r]} c={c || '#1d3f5e'} />
                  <Cyl p={[0, 0.006, 0]} s={[r * 0.55, 0.004, r * 0.55]} c="#2a5578" />
                </At>
                {Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
                  const a = (i / 7) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.4;
                  return <Box key={'s' + i} p={[Math.cos(a) * r * 1.02, 0.05, Math.sin(a) * r * 1.02]} r={[0.12 * ((i % 2) * 2 - 1), -a, 0.08]} s={[0.22 * ok, 0.05, 0.34 * ok]} c={i % 2 ? '#e6f4fa' : '#cfe6f1'} />;
                })}
              </>
            )}
          </group>
        );
      }
      case 'skateboard': return (
        <At p={[0, 0.07, 0]}>
          <Box s={[0.21, 0.025, 0.8]} c={c || '#7a4fa0'} />
          {[[-1, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, 1]].map(([x, z], i) => <Cyl key={i} p={[x * 0.08, -0.04, z * 0.28]} r={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} s={[0.03, 0.03, 0.03]} c="#f3efe6" />)}
        </At>
      );
      case 'fire': {
        // free-standing toon flames (window/doorway fires); `ignite` grows them in like `spot`
        const ig = typeof spec.ignite === 'number' ? spec.ignite : undefined;
        const k = ig === undefined ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - ig) / 0.5));
        return <Flames r={N(spec.size, 0.5)} k={k} t={t + N(spec.seed, 0)} />;
      }
      case 'smoke': return <Smoke t={t} h={N(spec.h, 8)} r={N(spec.size, 0.5)} n={N(spec.n, 34)} speed={N(spec.speed, 1.1)} seed={N(spec.seed, 1)} wind={(Array.isArray(spec.wind) ? spec.wind : [0.25, 0.05]) as [number, number]} />;
      case 'firetruck': return <FireTruck t={t} c={c || '#c8302a'} stowed={!!spec.stowed} />;
      case 'basket': return <Basket pos={spec.pos || [0, 0, 0]} from={spec.from ? V3(spec.from, [0, 0, 0]) : undefined} c={c || '#c8302a'} />;
      case 'binoculars': return <Binoculars />;
      case 'pizza': return (
        // a slice lying flat, tip toward +z
        <At p={[0, 0.008, 0]} s={N(spec.size, 1)}>
          <mesh geometry={triGeo} material={envMaterial('#f2c14e')} rotation={[0, Math.PI, 0]} scale={[0.1, 0.014, 0.14]} castShadow />
          <Box p={[0, 0.006, -0.075]} s={[0.17, 0.026, 0.035]} c="#c98a45" />
          {[[-0.025, -0.03], [0.03, -0.035], [0.0, 0.02]].map(([x, z], i) => <Cyl key={i} p={[x, 0.009, z]} s={[0.016, 0.004, 0.016]} c="#a3312a" />)}
        </At>
      );
      case 'trafficlight': return <TrafficLight p={[0, 0, 0]} state={(S(spec.state, 'red') as 'red' | 'amber' | 'green')} arm={N(spec.arm, 3.2)} />;
      case 'trophy': return (
        <At>
          <Box p={[0, 0.06, 0]} s={[0.2, 0.12, 0.2]} c="#2b2d36" />
          <Cyl p={[0, 0.2, 0]} s={[0.03, 0.18, 0.03]} c="#e8b84a" />
          <Cone p={[0, 0.38, 0]} r={[Math.PI, 0, 0]} s={[0.13, 0.22, 0.13]} c="#e8b84a" />
        </At>
      );
      default:
        return <Box p={[0, 0.25, 0]} s={0.5} c={c || '#ff00ff'} />;
    }
  })();
  // optional path animation
  let pos: Vec3 = spec.pos || [0, 0, 0];
  let r = spec.rot;
  if (spec.path && spec.path.length) {
    const pts = spec.path;
    if (t <= pts[0].t) pos = pts[0].pos;
    else if (t >= pts[pts.length - 1].t) pos = pts[pts.length - 1].pos;
    else
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++)
        if (t >= pts[i].t && t < pts[i + 1].t) {
          const k = (t - pts[i].t) / (pts[i + 1].t - pts[i].t);
          pos = pts[i].pos.map((v, j) => v + (pts[i + 1].pos[j] - v) * k) as Vec3;
          if (pts[i].rot && pts[i + 1].rot) r = pts[i].rot!.map((v, j) => v + (pts[i + 1].rot![j] - v) * k) as Vec3;
        }
  }
  const rr: Vec3 = typeof r === 'number' ? [0, (r * Math.PI) / 180, 0] : r ? (r.map(v => (v * Math.PI) / 180) as Vec3) : [0, 0, 0];
  return <group position={pos} rotation={rr} scale={spec.scale ?? 1}>{body}</group>;
};

// City rooftop at night: a 26 × 20 m tar roof 45 m above the street with a 1 m parapet, a stair
// door hut, a wooden water tower, AC units, vents, an antenna, string lights and a little lounge;
// a lit skyline all around (instanced windows), a big moon over the front (-z) ledge.
//
// Roof floor y = 0 (x ∈ [-12.65, 12.65], z ∈ [-9.65, 9.65] inside the parapet); parapet top y = 1.1;
// the street is at y = -45. The open "view" side is -z (moon, skyline); hut + water tower at +z.
import React from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { envMaterial, flat } from '../engine/materials';
import type { Vec3 } from '../types';
import type { SetProps } from './index';
import { At, Ball, Box, Chair, Cone, Cyl, Door, G, mix, Plant, rng, Table } from './kit';
import { PALETTES } from './look';
import { decalMaterial, facadeWindows, glowMaterial, Halo, Inst, Instances, LightPool, nightness, skyFlat, WindowSet } from './outdoorKit';

const RW = 26, RD = 20; // roof footprint
const STREET = -45;
const IN_X = RW / 2 - 0.35, IN_Z = RD / 2 - 0.35; // inner parapet faces
const MOON_DIR = new THREE.Vector3(0.32, 0.27, -0.91).normalize();

Object.assign(PALETTES, {
  // Night over the city: dark sky with stars, soft blue moonlight from the moon side, fog pushed back so
  // the lit skyline reads. (The moon itself is a mesh in the rooftop set.)
  rooftopNight: {
    skyTop: '#060a1e', skyHorizon: '#2a3366', skyBottom: '#2a3366', fog: '#1d2549', fogNear: 70, fogFar: 360,
    hemiSky: '#6c7ac4', hemiGround: '#2c2638', hemi: 1.8, key: '#c9d6ff', keyInt: 1.05, keyDir: [0.38, 0.62, -0.68],
    rim: '#c4d4ff', rimAmbient: 0.55, stars: true, windows: '#ffcf7a', windowsLit: true,
  },
});

const WALL = '#8f7f8e', CAP = '#b3aab4', FLOOR = '#66687e';
const SKY_COLS = ['#7d84a4', '#8b88a6', '#968fa4', '#6f7998', '#a199ae', '#857d97', '#7b8fa6'];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Props
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const WaterTower: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; s?: number }> = ({ p, s = 1 }) => {
  const steel = '#3c3f4c', wood = '#9a6844', hoop = '#34303a';
  return (
    <At p={p} s={s}>
      {[[-1, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, 1]].map(([x, z], i) => <Cyl key={i} p={[x * 1.3, 2.2, z * 1.3]} s={[0.11, 4.4, 0.11]} c={steel} seg8 />)}
      {[1.2, 3.3].map(y => (
        <group key={y}>
          <Box p={[0, y, 1.3]} s={[2.6, 0.1, 0.1]} c={steel} />
          <Box p={[0, y, -1.3]} s={[2.6, 0.1, 0.1]} c={steel} />
          <Box p={[1.3, y, 0]} s={[0.1, 0.1, 2.6]} c={steel} />
          <Box p={[-1.3, y, 0]} s={[0.1, 0.1, 2.6]} c={steel} />
        </group>
      ))}
      {[0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, -Math.PI / 2].map((r, i) => (
        <At key={i} r={r}>
          <Box p={[0, 2.25, 1.3]} r={[0, 0, 0.68]} s={[3.2, 0.06, 0.06]} c={steel} />
        </At>
      ))}
      <Cyl p={[0, 4.45, 0]} s={[2.25, 0.16, 2.25]} c={steel} />
      <Cyl p={[0, 6.25, 0]} s={[1.9, 3.5, 1.9]} c={wood} />
      {[4.9, 6.2, 7.5].map(y => <Cyl key={y} p={[0, y, 0]} s={[1.93, 0.09, 1.93]} c={hoop} />)}
      <Cone p={[0, 8.6, 0]} s={[2.1, 1.3, 2.1]} c="#5c4c56" />
      <Ball p={[0, 9.3, 0]} s={0.12} c="#5c4c56" />
      {/* ladder */}
      <Box p={[0.35, 6.3, 1.93]} s={[0.04, 3.6, 0.04]} c={steel} />
      <Box p={[-0.35, 6.3, 1.93]} s={[0.04, 3.6, 0.04]} c={steel} />
      {Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => <Box key={i} p={[0, 4.7 + i * 0.4, 1.93]} s={[0.7, 0.04, 0.04]} c={steel} />)}
    </At>
  );
};

const ACUnit: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; r?: number }> = ({ p, r = 0 }) => (
  <At p={p} r={r}>
    <Box p={[0, 0.08, 0]} s={[1.9, 0.16, 1.4]} c="#4c4f5c" />
    <Box p={[0, 0.7, 0]} s={[1.8, 1.08, 1.3]} c="#c6c9d3" />
    <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={envMaterial('#2c2e38')} position={[0, 1.245, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={0.46} />
    <Box p={[0, 1.26, 0]} r={0.5} s={[0.85, 0.03, 0.1]} c="#7d8090" />
    <Box p={[0, 1.26, 0]} r={2.07} s={[0.85, 0.03, 0.1]} c="#7d8090" />
    {[-0.3, -0.1, 0.1, 0.3].map(y => <Box key={y} p={[0, 0.7 + y, 0.655]} s={[1.5, 0.04, 0.02]} c="#8f93a2" />)}
  </At>
);

const Vent: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; h?: number }> = ({ p, h = 0.9 }) => (
  <At p={p}>
    <Cyl p={[0, h / 2, 0]} s={[0.16, h, 0.16]} c="#a9adb9" />
    <Cone p={[0, h + 0.12, 0]} s={[0.32, 0.24, 0.32]} c="#a9adb9" />
  </At>
);

const DoorHut: React.FC<{ p: Vec3; lit: boolean }> = ({ p, lit }) => (
  <At p={p}>
    <Box p={[0, 1.5, 0]} s={[3.4, 3.0, 3.2]} c="#9a7d86" />
    <Box p={[0, 3.08, 0]} s={[3.7, 0.16, 3.5]} c={CAP} />
    <Door p={[0.4, 0, -1.6]} r={Math.PI} c="#5a6f8f" frame="#d9d2c8" />
    {/* lamp over the door */}
    <Box p={[0.4, 2.55, -1.68]} s={[0.34, 0.12, 0.2]} c="#2c2e38" />
    <Box p={[0.4, 2.48, -1.7]} s={[0.26, 0.03, 0.14]} c={lit ? '#fff0c8' : '#d8d2c6'} glow={lit} />
    {lit && <Halo p={[0.4, 2.4, -1.8]} r={0.9} />}
    {lit && <LightPool p={[0.4, -p[1], -2.6]} rx={2.4} rz={1.8} o={0.4} />}
    {/* small window */}
    <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={lit ? flat('#ffd890') : envMaterial('#9fb9cf')} position={[-1.71, 1.8, 0.2]} rotation={[0, -Math.PI / 2, 0]} scale={[0.9, 0.7, 1]} />
    {/* antenna */}
    <Cyl p={[1.0, 5.2, 0.9]} s={[0.04, 4.2, 0.04]} c="#3c3f4c" seg8 />
    {[4.0, 5.0, 6.0].map((y, i) => <Box key={y} p={[1.0, y, 0.9]} s={[0.9 - i * 0.2, 0.03, 0.03]} c="#3c3f4c" />)}
    <Ball p={[1.0, 7.35, 0.9]} s={0.09} c="#ff4a3a" glow />
    {lit && <Halo p={[1.0, 7.35, 0.9]} r={0.5} c="#ff5a40" o={0.6} />}
  </At>
);

const BULB_COLS = ['#ffd27e', '#ff6a5a', '#7fe08a', '#7fc2ff', '#ffe9a8', '#f7a0e0'];
/** Festoon lights hanging between points (each span sags). */
const StringLights: React.FC<{ pts: Vec3[]; on: boolean }> = ({ pts, on }) => {
  const bulbs: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  const wire: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  let k = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const a = pts[i], b = pts[i + 1];
    const len = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[2] - a[2]);
    const n = Math.max(2, Math.round(len / 0.65));
    const sag = 0.06 * len;
    let prev: Vec3 = a;
    for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
      const t = j / n;
      const p: Vec3 = [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t - sag * 4 * t * (1 - t), a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t];
      const mid: Vec3 = [(prev[0] + p[0]) / 2, (prev[1] + p[1]) / 2, (prev[2] + p[2]) / 2];
      const d = new THREE.Vector3(p[0] - prev[0], p[1] - prev[1], p[2] - prev[2]);
      const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), d.clone().normalize());
      wire.push(<mesh key={'w' + k} geometry={G.cyl8} material={envMaterial('#26242c')} position={mid} quaternion={q} scale={[0.012, d.length(), 0.012]} />);
      if (j < n) {
        const c = BULB_COLS[k % BULB_COLS.length];
        bulbs.push(<Ball key={'b' + k} p={[p[0], p[1] - 0.09, p[2]]} s={[0.06, 0.08, 0.06]} c={on ? c : mix(c, '#ffffff', 0.5)} glow={on} />);
        if (on) bulbs.push(<sprite key={'h' + k} material={glowMaterial(c, 0.45)} position={[p[0], p[1] - 0.09, p[2]]} scale={[0.55, 0.55, 1]} renderOrder={6} />);
      }
      prev = p;
      k++;
    }
  }
  return <group>{wire}{bulbs}</group>;
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Skyline
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
type SB = { x: number; z: number; w: number; d: number; top: number; c: string; spire: boolean; tank: boolean; crown: string | null };
const SKYLINE: SB[] = (() => {
  const rand = rng(1234);
  const out: SB[] = [];
  const step = 34;
  for (let gx = -6; gx <= 6; gx++)
    for (let gz = -6; gz <= 6; gz++) {
      const x = gx * step + (rand() - 0.5) * 8, z = gz * step + (rand() - 0.5) * 8;
      const r = Math.hypot(x, z);
      const skip = rand() < 0.12;
      if (r < 27 || r > 215 || skip) continue;
      const w = 12 + rand() * 14, d = 12 + rand() * 14;
      let top = -32 + rand() * 38 + Math.min(1, r / 110) * 34; // rises with distance
      if (rand() < 0.1) top += 30; // the odd skyscraper
      if (z < 0 && Math.abs(x) < 60 && r < 70) top = Math.min(top, -8); // keep the front view open
      // keep a clear corridor under the moon
      const az = Math.atan2(x, -z) - Math.atan2(MOON_DIR.x, -MOON_DIR.z);
      if (z < 0 && Math.abs(az) < 0.2) top = Math.min(top, r * 0.14 - 8);
      out.push({ x, z, w, d, top, c: SKY_COLS[Math.floor(rand() * SKY_COLS.length)], spire: top > 30 && rand() < 0.5, tank: top < 12 && rand() < 0.3, crown: top > 20 && rand() < 0.35 ? (rand() < 0.5 ? '#7fe0ff' : '#ffcf7a') : null });
    }
  // landmark tower under the moon
  out.push({ x: 18, z: -175, w: 22, d: 22, top: 62, c: '#8d8aa8', spire: true, tank: false, crown: '#ffcf7a' });
  out.push({ x: -70, z: -140, w: 18, d: 18, top: 48, c: '#7b8fa6', spire: false, tank: false, crown: '#7fe0ff' });
  return out;
})();

const Skyline: React.FC<{ time: string }> = React.memo(({ time }) => {
  const n = nightness(time);
  const lit = n >= 0.75;
  const litFrac = n >= 1 ? 0.55 : n >= 0.75 ? 0.42 : n > 0.3 ? 0.18 : 0;
  const L: Inst[] = [], D: Inst[] = [];
  SKYLINE.forEach((b, i) => {
    const h = b.top - STREET;
    // only the two facades that face our roof
    const fx = b.x < 0 ? { x: b.x + b.w / 2, ry: Math.PI / 2 } : { x: b.x - b.w / 2, ry: -Math.PI / 2 };
    const fz = b.z < 0 ? { z: b.z + b.d / 2, ry: 0 } : { z: b.z - b.d / 2, ry: Math.PI };
    const off = 0.12;
    const common = { h: b.top, y0: STREET + 4, floor: 3.4, col: 2.6, ww: 1.5, wh: 2.0, off, wall: b.c };
    if (h > 6) {
      facadeWindows({ ...common, x: fx.x, z: b.z, ry: fx.ry, w: b.d - 1.2, seed: i * 2 + 1 }, litFrac, L, D, '#8aa3c4');
      facadeWindows({ ...common, x: b.x, z: fz.z, ry: fz.ry, w: b.w - 1.2, seed: i * 2 + 2 }, litFrac, L, D, '#8aa3c4');
    }
  });
  // our own building, below the parapet
  [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, -Math.PI / 2].forEach((ry, i) => {
    const alongX = i % 2 === 0;
    facadeWindows({ x: alongX ? 0 : Math.sin(ry) * RW / 2, z: alongX ? Math.cos(ry) * RD / 2 : 0, ry, w: (alongX ? RW : RD) - 1.6, h: -2.4, y0: STREET + 4, floor: 3.4, col: 2.4, ww: 1.3, wh: 1.9, off: 0.04, wall: WALL, seed: 900 + i }, litFrac, L, D);
  });
  const roads: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  for (let i = -6; i <= 6; i++) {
    const o = i * 34 + 17;
    roads.push(<mesh key={'rx' + i} geometry={G.plane} material={lit ? flat('#ffb760', 0.55) : decalMaterial('#3a3d4c')} position={[0, STREET + 0.05, o]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[460, 3, 1]} />);
    roads.push(<mesh key={'rz' + i} geometry={G.plane} material={lit ? flat('#ffb760', 0.55) : decalMaterial('#3a3d4c')} position={[o, STREET + 0.06, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[3, 460, 1]} />);
  }
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={G.plane} material={envMaterial('#2c2f40')} position={[0, STREET, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[900, 900, 1]} />
      {roads}
      {SKYLINE.map((b, i) => {
        const h = b.top - STREET;
        return (
          <group key={i}>
            <Box p={[b.x, STREET + h / 2, b.z]} s={[b.w, h, b.d]} c={b.c} shadow={false} />
            <Box p={[b.x, b.top + 0.3, b.z]} s={[b.w + 0.4, 0.6, b.d + 0.4]} c={mix(b.c, '#000', 0.2)} shadow={false} />
            {b.crown && (
              <>
                <Box p={[b.x, b.top + 2.6, b.z]} s={[b.w * 0.7, 4, b.d * 0.7]} c={mix(b.c, '#fff', 0.1)} shadow={false} />
                <Box p={[b.x, b.top + 1.4, b.z]} s={[b.w * 0.7 + 0.1, 0.5, b.d * 0.7 + 0.1]} c={lit ? b.crown : mix(b.c, '#fff', 0.3)} glow={lit} shadow={false} />
              </>
            )}
            {b.spire && (
              <>
                <Cone p={[b.x, b.top + (b.crown ? 4.6 : 0.6) + 5, b.z]} s={[1.2, 10, 1.2]} c={mix(b.c, '#fff', 0.2)} four shadow={false} />
                <mesh geometry={G.sphere} material={flat('#ff4a3a')} position={[b.x, b.top + (b.crown ? 4.6 : 0.6) + 10.2, b.z]} scale={0.35} />
                {lit && <sprite material={glowMaterial('#ff5a40', 0.7)} position={[b.x, b.top + (b.crown ? 4.6 : 0.6) + 10.2, b.z]} scale={[4, 4, 1]} />}
              </>
            )}
            {b.tank && <WaterTower p={[b.x + b.w * 0.2, b.top + 0.6, b.z - b.d * 0.15]} s={0.8} />}
          </group>
        );
      })}
      <WindowSet lit={L} dark={D} k={`sky|${time}`} fogLit={false} />
    </group>
  );
});

const Moon: React.FC<{ dir: THREE.Vector3 }> = ({ dir }) => {
  const p = dir.clone().multiplyScalar(250);
  const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), dir.clone().negate());
  return (
    <group position={p} quaternion={q}>
      <sprite material={glowMaterial('#b8c8ff', 0.5, false)} scale={[110, 110, 1]} renderOrder={-5} />
      <mesh geometry={G.circle} material={skyFlat('#f3ecd6')} scale={15} renderOrder={-4} />
      {[[-5, 4, 3.2], [4.5, -2, 2.4], [-2, -7, 1.8], [6, 6, 1.4], [0.5, 1.5, 1.2]].map(([x, y, r], i) => (
        <mesh key={i} geometry={G.circle} material={skyFlat('#e0d6bd')} position={[x, y, 0.05]} scale={r} renderOrder={-3} />
      ))}
    </group>
  );
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Roof
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const Roof: React.FC<{ time: string }> = React.memo(({ time }) => {
  const n = nightness(time);
  const on = n >= 0.75;
  const pavers: Inst[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) pavers.push({ p: [-8.1 + (i % 2) * 0.05, 0.012, 3.9 - i * 1.15], s: [1.5, 0.024, 1.0] });
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) pavers.push({ p: [-6.6 + i * 1.6, 0.012, -6.4], s: [1.4, 0.024, 1.0] });
  const seams: Inst[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < 8; i++) seams.push({ p: [-IN_X + i * (2 * IN_X / 8), 0.004, 0], s: [0.05, 0.008, 2 * IN_Z] });
  return (
    <group>
      {/* building + roof slab + parapet */}
      <Box p={[0, (STREET - 0.3) / 2, 0]} s={[RW, -STREET - 0.3, RD]} c={WALL} />
      <Box p={[0, -0.15, 0]} s={[2 * IN_X, 0.3, 2 * IN_Z]} c={FLOOR} />
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={decalMaterial('#5a5c70')} items={() => seams} k="seams" />
      {[-1, 1].map(s => (
        <group key={s}>
          <Box p={[0, 0.35, s * (RD / 2 - 0.175)]} s={[RW, 1.3, 0.35]} c={WALL} />
          <Box p={[0, 1.05, s * (RD / 2 - 0.175)]} s={[RW + 0.3, 0.12, 0.6]} c={CAP} />
          <Box p={[s * (RW / 2 - 0.175), 0.35, 0]} s={[0.35, 1.3, RD - 0.7]} c={WALL} />
          <Box p={[s * (RW / 2 - 0.175), 1.05, 0]} s={[0.6, 0.12, RD - 0.95]} c={CAP} />
        </group>
      ))}
      <Instances geo={G.box} mat={decalMaterial('#9c97a6')} items={() => pavers} k="pavers" />
      <DoorHut p={[-8.5, 0, 6.6]} lit={on} />
      <WaterTower p={[7.6, 0, 5.6]} />
      <ACUnit p={[-2.6, 0, 8.4]} />
      <ACUnit p={[-0.4, 0, 8.4]} />
      <ACUnit p={[1.8, 0, 8.4]} />
      {/* duct from the AC bank into the hut */}
      <Box p={[-5.1, 0.55, 8.4]} s={[3.0, 0.6, 0.6]} c="#aeb2bf" />
      <Box p={[-3.75, 0.55, 8.4]} s={[0.2, 0.7, 0.7]} c="#8f93a2" />
      <Vent p={[-11.2, 0, -3.0]} />
      <Vent p={[-11.2, 0, -1.6]} h={0.6} />
      <Vent p={[11.4, 0, 0.8]} h={1.2} />
      <Vent p={[3.6, 0, 1.2]} h={0.5} />
      {/* satellite dish */}
      <At p={[11.0, 0, -6.2]} r={-0.6}>
        <Cyl p={[0, 0.5, 0]} s={[0.06, 1.0, 0.06]} c="#5c6070" seg8 />
        <mesh geometry={G.sphere} material={envMaterial('#dfe2ea')} position={[0, 1.15, 0.05]} rotation={[-0.9, 0, 0]} scale={[0.6, 0.6, 0.16]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      </At>
      {/* lounge corner */}
      <Table p={[-3.4, 0, 2.6]} round w={0.9} h={0.72} c="#e9e2d2" />
      <Chair p={[-4.2, 0, 2.5]} r={Math.PI / 2 + 0.3} c="#d8433a" />
      <Chair p={[-2.6, 0, 2.7]} r={-Math.PI / 2 - 0.2} c="#2f7a5a" />
      <Plant p={[-11.6, 0, 8.6]} s={1.6} />
      <Plant p={[-11.6, 0, 6.8]} s={1.3} leaf="#5aa54a" />
      <Plant p={[-6.4, 0, 8.7]} s={1.2} pot="#8a5a3c" />
      {/* string-light poles + lights */}
      <Cyl p={[5.4, 1.6, -5.2]} s={[0.05, 3.2, 0.05]} c="#3c3f4c" seg8 />
      <Cyl p={[-11.6, 1.6, -7.6]} s={[0.05, 3.2, 0.05]} c="#3c3f4c" seg8 />
      <StringLights pts={[[-6.9, 2.9, 4.95], [5.4, 3.15, -5.2], [6.3, 4.2, 4.3]]} on={on} />
      <StringLights pts={[[-6.9, 2.9, 4.95], [-11.6, 3.15, -7.6]]} on={on} />
    </group>
  );
});

const RooftopScene: React.FC<{ time: string }> = ({ time }) => {
  const isNight = nightness(time) >= 1;
  const pal = PALETTES[time];
  // with a palette that already draws a moon disc in the sky (stock `night`), sit on top of it
  const dir = time !== 'rooftopNight' && pal?.sun ? new THREE.Vector3(...pal.sun.dir).normalize() : MOON_DIR;
  return (
    <group>
      <Roof time={time} />
      <Skyline time={time} />
      {isNight && <Moon dir={dir} />}
    </group>
  );
};

export const RooftopSet: React.FC<SetProps> = ({ time }) => <RooftopScene time={time} />;

export const ROOFTOP_MARKS: Record<string, Vec3> = {
  center: [0, 0, -2], // open roof, moon side ahead (-z)
  ledge: [1.5, 0, -8.9], // at the front parapet (rot 180 looks out over the city, rot 0 faces back)
  onLedge: [4.5, 1.11, -9.83], // standing ON the parapet cap (danger shot)
  door: [-8.1, 0, 4.2], // just outside the stair door (door faces -z)
  waterTower: [6.2, 0, 2.2], // in front of the water tower
  acUnits: [-0.4, 0, 6.6], // in front of the AC bank
  lounge: [-3.4, 0, 1.6], // by the little table + chairs
  corner: [11.2, 0, -8.4], // front-right corner by the satellite dish
};
