@@@@ FILE tools/build-episode.mjs | text-crlf | 7991 | f63dcd1264da0dcbe3257564691fcbffa9af56738b614a0e4bb7ec5a00b5c57d
// Finish an episode: (re)build the soundtrack, render the Episode composition, mux with a
// loudness-normalised mix (−14 LUFS, −1 dBTP), and write review sheets (one frame per shot).
//   node tools/build-episode.mjs <slug> [--from <sec> --to <sec>] [--no-audio] [--skip-audit] [--crf 18] [--concurrency N]
// A full build refuses to start while the scene audit has errors (range previews skip the gate).
// Output: final/<Episode title>.mp4 (the previous cut moves to final/archive/), or out/<slug>/preview_<from>-<to>.mp4 for a range.
import { spawn, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const slug = args[0];
const opt = k => { const i = args.indexOf(k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : undefined; };
if (!slug) {
  console.error('usage: node tools/build-episode.mjs <slug> [--from s --to s] [--no-audio]');
  process.exit(1);
}
const from = opt('--from'), to = opt('--to');
const D = path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'episodes', slug);
const OUT = path.join(ROOT, 'out', slug);
fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
const run = (cmd, a) => {
  console.log('>', cmd, a.join(' '));
  const r = spawnSync(cmd, a, { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: ROOT, shell: process.platform === 'win32' });
  if (r.status !== 0) process.exit(r.status ?? 1);
};
const q = s => `"${s}"`;
// live progress for `node tools/progress.mjs <slug>`: step, frames, % and Remotion's own time-remaining estimate
const PROG = path.join(OUT, 'progress.json');
const BUILD_T0 = Date.now();
const progress = (step, extra = {}) => {
  try { fs.writeFileSync(PROG, JSON.stringify({ slug, step, started: BUILD_T0, updated: Date.now(), range: from !== undefined ? [+from, +to] : null, ...extra })); } catch { /* best effort */ }
};
progress('audit');
const timing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(D, 'timing.json'), 'utf8'));
const fps = timing.fps || 30;

if (from === undefined && !args.includes('--skip-audit')) {
  const r = spawnSync('node', [path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'qa.cjs'), 'audit', slug], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: ROOT });
  if (r.status !== 0) {
    console.error(`
scene audit has errors: fix them (out/${slug}/audit.json) before the final render, or pass --skip-audit.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

// fresh clone: the paid mp3s are in git, the derived .wav are not — rebuild them locally (no ElevenLabs call)
if (!args.includes('--no-audio') && fs.existsSync(path.join(D, 'sections.json'))) {
  const secs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(D, 'sections.json'), 'utf8'));
  if (secs.some(s => s.file && !fs.existsSync(path.join(D, s.file)) && fs.existsSync(path.join(D, 'vo', `${s.id}.mp3`))))
    run('node', [q(path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'episode.mjs')), 'pace', slug]);
}

if (!args.includes('--no-audio')) {
  progress('audio');
  run(q(path.join(ROOT, '.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe')), ['-I', q(path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'sfx', 'episode_audio.py')), slug]);
}

// a range preview gets its own file: sharing video_silent.mp4 let a preview clobber a full build running at the same time
const silent = path.join(OUT, from !== undefined ? `video_silent_${from}-${to}.mp4` : 'video_silent.mp4');
const frames = from !== undefined ? [`--frames=${Math.round(+from * fps)}-${Math.round(+to * fps) - 1}`] : [];
// defaults measured on a 12-core RTX 3060 box (20 s range): concurrency 4 → 85 s, 6 → 74 s, 8 → 67 s, 10 → 66 s;
// CRF 18 is 39% of CRF 14's size at SSIM 0.994 (no visible difference; YouTube re-encodes anyway)
const concurrency = opt('--concurrency') ?? Math.max(2, os.cpus().length - 4), crf = opt('--crf') ?? 18;
const t0 = Date.now();
// Remotion prints "Rendered 46/60, time remaining: 2s" lines (and "Encoded N/T"): keep them out of the log,
// write them to progress.json, and print one short line every 2 %
await new Promise(resolve => {
  const a = ['remotion', 'render', 'Episode', q(silent), `--props=${q(JSON.stringify({ slug }).replace(/"/g, '\\"'))}`, '--muted', `--concurrency=${concurrency}`, `--crf=${crf}`, ...frames];
  console.log('> npx', a.join(' '));
  progress('render', { done: 0, total: 0 });
  const child = spawn('npx', a, { cwd: ROOT, shell: process.platform === 'win32' });
  let lastPct = -1, buf = '';
  const onData = chunk => {
    buf += chunk.toString();
    const lines = buf.split(/\r?\n|\r/);
    buf = lines.pop();
    for (const line of lines) {
      const m = /(Rendered|Encoded) (\d+)\/(\d+)(?:, time remaining: (.+))?/.exec(line);
      if (!m) { if (line.trim() && !/^\s*\+|Bundl|Copying|Getting|composition/i.test(line)) console.log(line); continue; }
      const [, kind, done, total, eta] = m;
      progress(kind === 'Rendered' ? 'render' : 'encode', { done: +done, total: +total, eta: eta || null });
      const pct = Math.floor((100 * +done) / +total);
      if (kind === 'Rendered' && (pct >= lastPct + 2 || +done === +total)) { lastPct = pct; console.log(`render ${pct}% (${done}/${total})${eta ? `, ~${eta} left` : ''}`); }
    }
  };
  child.stdout.on('data', onData);
  child.stderr.on('data', onData);
  child.on('close', code => { if (code !== 0) { progress('failed', { code }); process.exit(code ?? 1); } resolve(); });
});
console.log(`render: ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)} s (concurrency ${concurrency}, crf ${crf})`);

// Every finished episode sits directly in final/, named by its title (e.g. "What If You Could Swap Places With Anyone.mp4"),
// so all the videos can be browsed in one folder. A rebuild moves the previous cut to final/archive/<slug>_<date>.mp4.
const ep = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(D, 'episode.json'), 'utf8'));
const niceName = (ep.title || slug).replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
const final = from !== undefined ? path.join(OUT, `preview_${from}-${to}.mp4`) : path.join(ROOT, 'final', `${niceName}.mp4`);
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(final), { recursive: true });
if (from === undefined && fs.existsSync(final)) {
  const stamp = fs.statSync(final).mtime.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace('T', '-');
  const arch = path.join(ROOT, 'final', 'archive');
  fs.mkdirSync(arch, { recursive: true });
  fs.renameSync(final, path.join(arch, `${slug}_${stamp}.mp4`));
}
progress('mux');
const mix = path.join(D, 'mix.wav');
const audioIn = fs.existsSync(mix) ? ['-ss', String(from ?? 0), '-i', q(mix)] : [];
run('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-y', '-i', q(silent), ...audioIn, '-c:v', 'copy',
  ...(audioIn.length ? ['-af', 'loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11', '-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', '320k', '-ar', '48000', '-shortest'] : []), '-movflags', '+faststart', q(final)]);

// review sheet: one frame from the middle of every shot
if (from === undefined) {
  progress('sheets');
  const shotsDir = path.join(OUT, 'shots');
  fs.rmSync(shotsDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(shotsDir, { recursive: true });
  timing.shots.forEach((s, i) => {
    spawnSync('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-y', '-ss', (s.start + s.dur / 2).toFixed(3), '-i', final, '-frames:v', '1', '-vf', 'scale=480:-2',
      path.join(shotsDir, `${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}.png`)]);
  });
  const per = 30;
  for (let p = 0; p * per < timing.shots.length; p++) {
    spawnSync('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-y', '-framerate', '1', '-start_number', String(p * per), '-i', path.join(shotsDir, '%03d.png'),
      '-vf', `trim=end_frame=${per},tile=6x5:padding=4:color=white`, '-frames:v', '1', '-update', '1', path.join(OUT, `sheet_${p + 1}.png`)]);
  }
}
// subtitles + the marked shorts' timecodes for the user's own 9:16 edit (no-op on a range preview)
if (from === undefined && !timing.draft) run('node', [q(path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'episode.mjs')), 'srt', slug]);
progress('done', { final });
console.log('done:', final);
@@@@ END
@@@@ FILE tools/build.mjs | text-crlf | 2467 | 957ed13fe5b3fc2fe6333323c2649021c53fa4da3a4f3beedff507ecf05e5362
// One-command finish for a composition: render PNG frames, run its Python sound design,
// mux a 1080p H.264 master, and write a review contact sheet.
//   node tools/build.mjs <CompositionId> <slug> [sfxScript]
//   node tools/build.mjs PillSprint pill_sprint tools/sfx/pill_sprint.py
// Output: final/<slug>.mp4, out/<slug>/frames/*.png, out/<slug>/sheet.png
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const [comp, slug, sfx] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!comp || !slug) {
  console.error('usage: node tools/build.mjs <CompositionId> <slug> [sfxScript]');
  process.exit(1);
}
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));
const run = (cmd, args, opts = {}) => {
  console.log('>', cmd, args.join(' '));
  const r = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: root, shell: process.platform === 'win32', ...opts });
  if (r.status !== 0) process.exit(r.status ?? 1);
};

const outDir = path.join(root, 'out', slug);
const frames = path.join(outDir, 'frames');
fs.rmSync(frames, { recursive: true, force: true });
fs.mkdirSync(frames, { recursive: true });
run('npx', ['remotion', 'render', comp, `"${frames}"`, '--sequence', '--image-format=png', '--concurrency=4', '--log=error']);

let audio = null;
if (sfx) {
  const py = path.join(root, '.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe');
  run(`"${py}"`, ['-I', `"${path.join(root, sfx)}"`]);
  audio = path.join(root, 'public', 'audio', `${slug}_mix.wav`);
}

fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, 'final'), { recursive: true });
const final = path.join(root, 'final', `${slug}.mp4`);
const first = fs.readdirSync(frames).filter(f => f.endsWith('.png')).sort()[0];
const pattern = path.join(frames, first.replace(/\d+\.png$/, m => `%0${m.length - 4}d.png`));
run('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-y', '-framerate', '30', '-i', `"${pattern}"`,
  ...(audio ? ['-i', `"${audio}"`] : []),
  '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'slow', '-crf', '14', '-profile:v', 'high', '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', '-movflags', '+faststart',
  ...(audio ? ['-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', '320k', '-ar', '48000', '-shortest'] : []), `"${final}"`]);
run('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-y', '-framerate', '30', '-i', `"${pattern}"`, '-vf', `"select='not(mod(n\\,4))',scale=480:-2,tile=6x5:padding=4:color=white"`,
  '-frames:v', '1', '-update', '1', `"${path.join(outDir, 'sheet.png')}"`]);
console.log('done:', final);
@@@@ END
@@@@ FILE tools/episode.mjs | text-crlf | 31093 | 145114b4fdb0c584bf6c90dc2b528bcd456f41f9415cb339cfe7dd6be2cc9e4d
// Episode voice pipeline.
//   node tools/episode.mjs check <slug>             validate vo text (tags, SSML, raw numbers) BEFORE spending credits — STORY_BLUEPRINT.md §6.9/§6.4
//   node tools/episode.mjs sections <slug>          split narration into ElevenLabs TTS sections → sections.json (+ prints the credit estimate)
//   node tools/episode.mjs voice <slug> [s01 s02…]   call ElevenLabs (with-timestamps) for sections lacking audio, trim/level/pace them → vo/sNN.wav
//   node tools/episode.mjs align <slug>             exact word timing from the TTS alignment → timing.json (every cut lands on its first word)
//   node tools/episode.mjs draft <slug>             estimated timing (180 wpm) for previewing before any voice exists
//   node tools/episode.mjs script <slug>            readable script.md (speakers, timestamps) to show the user before voicing
//   node tools/episode.mjs pace <slug>              re-level/re-pace downloaded sections without new ElevenLabs calls
// Files live in public/episodes/<slug>/.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));

// .env isn't auto-loaded by node; pick up ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from ROOT/.env without a dotenv dependency.
(function loadEnv() {
  const f = path.join(ROOT, '.env');
  if (!fs.existsSync(f)) return;
  for (const line of fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const m = line.match(/^([A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*)=(.*)$/);
    if (m && !(m[1] in process.env)) process.env[m[1]] = m[2];
  }
})();

const [cmd, slug, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!cmd || !slug) {
  console.error('usage: node tools/episode.mjs <check|sections|voice|align|draft|script|pace|srt> <slug> [...]');
  process.exit(1);
}
const DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'episodes', slug);
const read = f => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, f), 'utf8'));
const write = (f, o) => fs.writeFileSync(path.join(DIR, f), JSON.stringify(o, null, 1));
const ep = read('episode.json');
const FPS = ep.fps || 30;
const DEFAULT_DIRECTION = '[calm]'; // user found "energetic, quick pace" too hyper (2026-10-28); eleven_v4 reads short delivery tags best, so keep this brief
// House voices (ElevenLabs, eleven_v4, PT-BR). Shots set `who`; episode.voices can add or override speakers.
// episode.json's voice.id always wins for the narrator — this is only the fallback.
export const HOUSE_VOICES = {
  narrator: 'u7N1p4OIOc6Fl7y72WE7', // Yuri — Natural Brazilian Narrator (user's pick, 2026-11-08)
  male: 'H2bV051FngNxkuTNROyc', // Eduardo — Brazilian Portuguese (young, confident): boys, men
  female: 'n2a9VtkZLl8j1FSXHsL7', // Sofia — Natural & Expressive (young, gentle): girls, women
};
const MAX_CHARS = 2500;
const CREDITS_PER_CHAR = 0.4; // measured 2026-11-08: 199 chars → 80 credits on eleven_v4 with Yuri. Varies by model/voice — treat as an estimate.

/** Spoken words only: drop [direction]/audio-tag brackets and <tags>. */
const spoken = s => (s || '').replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, ' ').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
// \p{L}/\p{N} (not a-z0-9) so accented PT letters (á é í ó ú ã õ â ê ô ü ç à) survive normalisation.
const norm = s => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[’']/g, "'").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}' ]+/gu, ' ').trim();
const toks = s => norm(spoken(s).replace(/[-–—]/g, ' ')).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);

/** Mechanical gate on `vo` text, run before any ElevenLabs call: catches the unambiguous mistakes from
 *  STORY_BLUEPRINT.md §6.9 (tags, SSML) and §6.4 (numbers) that a human/agent could otherwise miss and pay
 *  credits for. Does NOT judge tag placement, descriptiveness or voice-match — those need a reader's
 *  judgment and stay in STORY_BLUEPRINT.md §9's checklist, self-certified before the credit checkpoint. */
function checkVoiceText(episode) {
  const errors = [];
  episode.shots.forEach((shot, i) => {
    const vo = shot.vo;
    if (!vo) return;
    const where = `shot #${i}${shot.id ? ` (${shot.id})` : ''}`;
    let depth = 0;
    for (const ch of vo) {
      if (ch === '[') depth++;
      else if (ch === ']') { if (depth === 0) errors.push(`${where}: stray ']' with no matching '[' in vo`); else depth--; }
    }
    if (depth > 0) errors.push(`${where}: unclosed '[' in vo (${depth} still open) — ElevenLabs will read the bracket text aloud instead of treating it as a tag`);
    const angle = vo.match(/<[^>]*>/g);
    if (angle) errors.push(`${where}: SSML/HTML-like tag ${angle.join(', ')} in vo — eleven_v4 doesn't support <break> or any SSML; use punctuation or [tags] instead (STORY_BLUEPRINT.md §6.9)`);
    const digits = spoken(vo).match(/\d+/g); // digits outside [tags] only — a tag like a [9mm gunshot] sound cue is fine
    if (digits) errors.push(`${where}: raw digit(s) ${digits.join(', ')} in vo — spell numbers, dates, money, time and abbreviations out for narration (STORY_BLUEPRINT.md §6.4), e.g. "365" → "trezentos e sessenta e cinco"`);
  });
  return errors;
}

/** Style lint on `vo` (COLA_ROTEIRO "Voz", 2026-11-09): warnings only, never blocks the voice step.
 *  - sentences over 15 spoken words (the hard cap; sentences can span shots, reported at their first shot);
 *  - banned words/phrases (weak adjectives + the COLA ban list);
 *  - two sentences in a row with the same opening word (same structure), outside the ladainha / climax ×3,
 *    which repeat on purpose: mark those shots `repeat: true` to silence it. */
const MAX_SENTENCE_WORDS = 15;
const BANNED = ['incrível', 'incríveis', 'fantástico', 'fantástica', 'fantásticos', 'fantásticas', 'surpreendente', 'surpreendentes',
  'em um mundo onde', 'de repente', 'jornada', 'tudo mudou', 'você não vai acreditar', 'no final das contas', 'mas espera, tem mais', 'embarca'];
function styleWarnings(episode) {
  const out = [];
  let cur = null; // the sentence being read: { words, at, repeat }
  let prevOpen = null, prevRepeat = false;
  const flush = () => {
    if (!cur) return;
    if (cur.words.length > MAX_SENTENCE_WORDS) out.push(`${cur.at}: ${cur.words.length}-word sentence (cap ${MAX_SENTENCE_WORDS}): "${cur.words.join(' ').slice(0, 90)}…"`);
    // same structure = the same first two words; 1–3-word staccato lines are exempt
    const open = cur.words.length > 3 ? norm(cur.words.slice(0, 2).join(' ')) : null;
    if (open && open === prevOpen && !(cur.repeat || prevRepeat)) out.push(`${cur.at}: two sentences in a row open with "${open}" — vary the structure (or mark the shot repeat: true)`);
    prevOpen = open; prevRepeat = cur.repeat;
    cur = null;
  };
  episode.shots.forEach((shot, i) => {
    if (!shot.vo) return;
    const where = `shot #${i}${shot.id ? ` (${shot.id})` : ''}`;
    const text = spoken(shot.vo);
    const low = ' ' + norm(text) + ' ';
    BANNED.forEach(b => { if (low.includes(' ' + norm(b) + ' ')) out.push(`${where}: banned "${b}" — show it, don't qualify it`); });
    if (/\bliteralmente\b/i.test(text) && (shot.who || 'narrator') === 'narrator') out.push(`${where}: banned "literalmente" in narration`);
    if ((shot.who || 'narrator') !== 'narrator') { flush(); prevOpen = null; return; } // character lines have their own ≤ 8-word rule
    for (const w of text.split(/\s+/).filter(x => /[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(x))) {
      if (!cur) cur = { words: [], at: where, repeat: !!shot.repeat };
      cur.words.push(w);
      if (/[.!?…][”"'»)]*$/.test(w)) flush();
    }
  });
  flush();
  return out;
}

function buildSections() {
  const sections = [];
  let cur = null, breakNext = false, lastWho = null;
  ep.shots.forEach((shot, i) => {
    const text = spoken(shot.vo);
    if (!text) {
      breakNext = true;
      return;
    }
    const who = shot.who || 'narrator';
    if (who !== lastWho) breakNext = true; // every speaker change starts a new single-speaker section
    lastWho = who;
    if (!cur || breakNext || cur.chars + shot.vo.length > MAX_CHARS) {
      cur = { id: `s${String(sections.length + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`, shots: [], parts: [], chars: 0 };
      sections.push(cur);
      breakNext = false;
    }
    cur.shots.push(i);
    cur.parts.push({ who, text: shot.vo.trim() });
    cur.chars += shot.vo.length + 1;
    if (shot.hold > 0) breakNext = true;
  });
  const voices = { ...HOUSE_VOICES, narrator: ep.voice.id || HOUSE_VOICES.narrator, ...(ep.voices || {}) };
  const direction = ep.voice.direction ?? DEFAULT_DIRECTION;
  return sections.map(s => {
    const who = s.parts[0].who; // one speaker per section (see breakNext above)
    const first = s.parts[0].text;
    const text = (first.startsWith('[') || who !== 'narrator' || !direction ? '' : direction + ' ') + s.parts.map(p => p.text).join(' ');
    return { id: s.id, shots: s.shots, voice_id: voices[who], model: ep.voice.model || 'eleven_v4', text, file: null };
  });
}

function sh(cmd, args, opts = {}) {
  const r = spawnSync(cmd, args, { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 30, ...opts });
  if (r.status !== 0) {
    console.error(r.stderr);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  return r;
}

/** One ElevenLabs call, text in = alignment out: character-accurate timestamps for exactly the text sent,
 *  so there is nothing to transcribe or fuzzy-match afterwards (that whole class of bug is gone with Whisper). */
// Retries only answers that mean "nothing was generated, try later": 429 (too many concurrent requests /
// rate limit) and 5xx. Any other error (bad key, bad voice, out of credits) fails at once.
async function synthesize(voiceId, text, model, tag = '') {
  if (!process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY) throw new Error('ELEVENLABS_API_KEY not set (expected in .env at the project root)');
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${voiceId}/with-timestamps`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'xi-api-key': process.env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        text,
        model_id: model,
        voice_settings: { stability: ep.voice.stability ?? 0.5, similarity_boost: ep.voice.similarityBoost ?? 0.8 },
      }),
    });
    if (res.ok) return res.json(); // { audio_base64, alignment: {characters, character_start_times_seconds, character_end_times_seconds}, normalized_alignment }
    const body = await res.text();
    if ((res.status === 429 || res.status >= 500) && attempt < 6) {
      const wait = Math.min(30, +(res.headers.get('retry-after') || 0) || 2 ** attempt) * 1000;
      console.log(`${tag}: ElevenLabs ${res.status}, retry ${attempt}/5 in ${wait / 1000} s`);
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, wait));
      continue;
    }
    throw new Error(`ElevenLabs TTS failed ${res.status}: ${body}`);
  }
}

function processVoice(src, dst, tempoOverride) {
  const tempo = tempoOverride ?? ep.voice.tempo ?? 1.0;
  const maxPause = ep.voice.maxPause ?? 0.45;
  const af = [
    'silenceremove=start_periods=1:start_threshold=-45dB:start_silence=0.03',
    'areverse', 'silenceremove=start_periods=1:start_threshold=-45dB:start_silence=0.06', 'areverse',
    `silenceremove=stop_periods=-1:stop_duration=${maxPause}:stop_threshold=-42dB:stop_silence=${maxPause}`,
    ...(tempo !== 1 ? [`atempo=${tempo}`] : []),
    'loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=9',
    'afade=t=in:d=0.01',
  ].join(',');
  sh('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-v', 'error', '-i', src, '-af', af, '-ar', '48000', '-ac', '1', dst]);
}

/** Keep narration pace consistent: measure the section, then time-stretch (pitch kept) toward targetWpm,
 *  both ways but only gently (voice.tempoRange, default ±10%: bigger stretches sound rushed or dragged).
 *  Short lines (< 12 words, e.g. "Cara.") are left as read. */
function pace(s) {
  const mp3 = path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.mp3`), wav = path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.wav`);
  processVoice(mp3, wav, 1.0);
  const words = toks(s.text).length;
  const wpm = words / (durOf(wav) / 60);
  const target = ep.voice.targetWpm ?? 175;
  const [lo, hi] = ep.voice.tempoRange ?? [0.9, 1.1];
  const tempo = ep.voice.tempo ?? (words < 12 ? 1 : Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, target / wpm)));
  if (Math.abs(tempo - 1) > 0.005) processVoice(mp3, wav, tempo);
  s.tempo = +tempo.toFixed(3);
  console.log(`${s.id}: ${durOf(wav).toFixed(2)} s  (${wpm.toFixed(0)} wpm read → ×${tempo.toFixed(2)} → ${(wpm * tempo).toFixed(0)} wpm)`);
}

const durOf = f => parseFloat(sh('ffprobe', ['-v', 'error', '-show_entries', 'format=duration', '-of', 'default=nw=1:nk=1', f]).stdout);

/** Silence intervals [{start,end}] in a file, via ffmpeg's own detector — used to mirror what
 *  processVoice's silenceremove filters will trim, so word times can be remapped onto the final audio. */
function detectSilences(file, dB, minDur) {
  const out = sh('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'info', '-i', file, '-af', `silencedetect=n=${dB}dB:d=${minDur}`, '-f', 'null', '-']).stderr;
  const starts = [...out.matchAll(/silence_start:\s*([\d.]+)/g)].map(m => parseFloat(m[1]));
  const ends = [...out.matchAll(/silence_end:\s*([\d.]+)/g)].map(m => parseFloat(m[1]));
  return starts.map((start, i) => ({ start, end: ends[i] ?? start }));
}

/** How processVoice's trim filters reshape the raw ElevenLabs audio's timeline: how much silence came off
 *  the head (same -45dB/0.03 the start filter uses), and every internal pause clipped down to maxPause
 *  (same -42dB/maxPause the stop filter uses). Mirrors the ffmpeg filter chain in processVoice() above —
 *  change one, change the other. */
function buildTimeMap(raw, maxPause) {
  const dur = durOf(raw);
  const lead = detectSilences(raw, -45, 0.03).find(s => s.start < 0.02);
  const T_lead = lead ? Math.max(0, lead.end - lead.start - 0.03) : 0;
  const clips = [];
  for (const s of detectSilences(raw, -42, maxPause)) {
    if (s.start < T_lead + 0.05 || s.end > dur - 0.05) continue; // part of the lead/trail trim, not a mid-clip
    const segDur = s.end - s.start;
    if (segDur > maxPause + 0.01) clips.push({ start: s.start - T_lead, end: s.end - T_lead, removed: segDur - maxPause });
  }
  return { T_lead, clips };
}

/** Raw (pre-trim, pre-tempo) ElevenLabs time → final processed-wav time. */
function mapTime(map, tRaw, tempo) {
  let t = Math.max(0, tRaw - map.T_lead), removed = 0;
  for (const c of map.clips) {
    if (t >= c.end) removed += c.removed;
    else if (t > c.start) removed += Math.max(0, t - c.start - (c.end - c.start - c.removed));
  }
  return Math.max(0, t - removed) / tempo;
}

/** Word list with raw timestamps straight from the ElevenLabs character alignment: no transcription, so no
 *  ASR drift, no "365"/"dodge balls" mismatches, and no unmatched words — we group the exact characters of
 *  the exact text we sent, skipping [bracket]/<tag> spans the same way `spoken()` does for the script. */
function wordsFromAlignment(alignment) {
  const chars = alignment.characters, starts = alignment.character_start_times_seconds, ends = alignment.character_end_times_seconds;
  const heard = chars.join('');
  const skip = new Array(chars.length).fill(false);
  for (const re of [/\[[^\]]*\]/g, /<[^>]*>/g]) {
    let m; while ((m = re.exec(heard))) for (let i = m.index; i < m.index + m[0].length; i++) skip[i] = true;
  }
  const words = [];
  let cur = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
    const isWord = !skip[i] && /\S/.test(chars[i]) && chars[i] !== '-' && chars[i] !== '–' && chars[i] !== '—';
    if (isWord) {
      cur ??= { t0: starts[i], chars: [] };
      cur.t1 = ends[i];
      cur.chars.push(chars[i]);
    } else if (cur) {
      words.push({ w: norm(cur.chars.join('')), t0: cur.t0 });
      cur = null;
    }
  }
  if (cur) words.push({ w: norm(cur.chars.join('')), t0: cur.t0 });
  return words.filter(w => w.w);
}

/** Lay shots and sections on the timeline. sectionDur[s] = audio length; shotOffset[i] = first-word time within its section. */
function layout(sections, sectionDur, shotOffset) {
  const LEAD = 0.12; // cut this much before the shot's first word
  const shots = ep.shots.map(() => ({ start: 0, dur: 0, section: null }));
  const secOf = {};
  sections.forEach((s, k) => s.shots.forEach(i => (secOf[i] = k)));
  const secStart = [];
  let cursor = 0.3;
  ep.shots.forEach((shot, i) => {
    const k = secOf[i];
    if (k === undefined) {
      shots[i] = { start: cursor, dur: shot.hold || 1.5, section: null };
      cursor += shots[i].dur;
      return;
    }
    const s = sections[k];
    const firstInSec = s.shots[0] === i;
    if (firstInSec) secStart[k] = cursor + 0.15;
    const start = firstInSec ? cursor : Math.max(shots[i - 1].start + 0.5, secStart[k] + shotOffset[i] - LEAD);
    shots[i] = { start, dur: 0, section: k };
    if (s.shots[s.shots.length - 1] === i) cursor = secStart[k] + sectionDur[k] + Math.max(shot.hold || 0, 0.3);
    else cursor = start;
  });
  // snap cuts to frame boundaries first, so start + dur of one shot is exactly the next start (no black frame)
  const snap = s => Math.round(s * FPS) / FPS;
  shots.forEach(s => (s.start = snap(s.start)));
  ep.shots.forEach((_, i) => {
    const next = i + 1 < shots.length ? shots[i + 1].start : snap(cursor + 0.4);
    shots[i].dur = +(next - shots[i].start).toFixed(4);
    shots[i].start = +shots[i].start.toFixed(4);
  });
  const total = +(shots[shots.length - 1].start + shots[shots.length - 1].dur).toFixed(3);
  return { fps: FPS, total, shots, sections: sections.map((s, k) => ({ file: `episodes/${slug}/vo/${s.id}.wav`, start: +(secStart[k] ?? 0).toFixed(3), dur: +sectionDur[k].toFixed(3) })) };
}

if (cmd === 'check') {
  const errors = checkVoiceText(ep);
  if (errors.length) {
    console.error(`${errors.length} problem(s) — fix before running 'voice' (this is what 'voice' itself refuses on, see below):`);
    errors.forEach(e => console.error('  - ' + e));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log(`vo text check: 0 problems, ${ep.shots.filter(s => s.vo).length} shots with narration.`);
  const style = styleWarnings(ep);
  if (style.length) {
    console.log(`\n${style.length} style warning(s) (COLA_ROTEIRO "Voz" — not blocking, but fix before the credit checkpoint):`);
    style.forEach(w => console.log('  ~ ' + w));
  } else console.log('style: no sentence over 15 words, no banned words, no repeated openings.');
  console.log(`Mechanical only (brackets, SSML, raw numbers) — still self-certify the judgment items in STORY_BLUEPRINT.md §9 (tag placement, descriptiveness, voice match) before the credit checkpoint.`);
} else if (cmd === 'sections') {
  const secs = buildSections();
  const old = fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, 'sections.json')) ? read('sections.json') : [];
  // keep downloaded audio for sections whose text didn't change
  secs.forEach(s => {
    const o = old.find(x => x.id === s.id && x.text === s.text);
    if (o) Object.assign(s, { file: o.file, tempo: o.tempo });
  });
  write('sections.json', secs);
  const bytes = secs.reduce((a, s) => a + Buffer.byteLength(s.text), 0);
  console.log(`${secs.length} sections, ${bytes} chars (~${Math.round(bytes * CREDITS_PER_CHAR)} ElevenLabs credits, estimate), ${ep.shots.length} shots`);
  secs.forEach(s => console.log(`${s.id}  shots ${s.shots[0]}–${s.shots[s.shots.length - 1]}  ${Buffer.byteLength(s.text)} B  ${s.file ? 'HAS AUDIO' : 'needs TTS'}`));
  const checkErrors = checkVoiceText(ep);
  if (checkErrors.length) {
    console.log(`\n${checkErrors.length} vo text problem(s) — run 'node tools/episode.mjs check ${slug}' for the full list, and fix before 'voice' (it will refuse otherwise):`);
    checkErrors.slice(0, 5).forEach(e => console.log('  - ' + e));
  }
} else if (cmd === 'voice') {
  const checkErrors = checkVoiceText(ep);
  if (checkErrors.length) {
    console.error(`Refusing to spend ElevenLabs credits: ${checkErrors.length} problem(s) in vo text (run 'node tools/episode.mjs check ${slug}' for the full list):`);
    checkErrors.forEach(e => console.error('  - ' + e));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const secs = read('sections.json');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(DIR, 'vo'), { recursive: true });
  // a fresh clone has the paid mp3 + alignment (in git) but not the derived .wav: rebuild it locally, no API call
  const paid = s => s.file && fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.mp3`)) && fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.align.json`));
  if (!rest.length) for (const s of secs) if (s.file && !fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, s.file)) && paid(s)) { console.log(`${s.id}: rebuilding ${s.file} from the saved mp3 (no ElevenLabs call)`); pace(s); }
  write('sections.json', secs);
  const ids = rest.length ? rest : secs.filter(s => !s.file || !fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, s.file))).map(s => s.id);
  ids.forEach(id => { if (!secs.some(x => x.id === id)) throw new Error('unknown section ' + id); });
  // a few calls at once (voice.parallel, default 3); sections.json is saved after EVERY finished section,
  // so a crash or a failed call never loses (and never re-bills) the audio already paid for
  const parallel = Math.max(1, ep.voice.parallel ?? 3);
  const t0 = Date.now();
  let next = 0;
  const failed = [];
  const worker = async () => {
    while (next < ids.length) {
      const id = ids[next++];
      const s = secs.find(x => x.id === id);
      console.log(`${s.id}: calling ElevenLabs (${Buffer.byteLength(s.text)} chars, voice ${s.voice_id}, ${s.model})…`);
      try {
        const r = await synthesize(s.voice_id, s.text, s.model, s.id);
        fs.writeFileSync(path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.mp3`), Buffer.from(r.audio_base64, 'base64'));
        fs.writeFileSync(path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.align.json`), JSON.stringify(r.alignment));
        Object.assign(s, { file: `vo/${s.id}.wav` });
        pace(s);
        write('sections.json', secs);
      } catch (e) {
        failed.push(s.id);
        console.error(`${s.id}: FAILED — ${e.message}`);
      }
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(parallel, ids.length) }, worker));
  write('sections.json', secs);
  console.log(`voice: ${ids.length - failed.length}/${ids.length} sections in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)} s (parallel ${parallel})`);
  if (failed.length) {
    console.error(`failed: ${failed.join(' ')} — fix the cause, then re-run 'voice ${slug}' (only these get a new call)`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
} else if (cmd === 'pace') {
  // re-level and re-pace already-downloaded sections (no new ElevenLabs calls)
  const secs = read('sections.json');
  secs.filter(s => s.file && fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.mp3`))).forEach(pace);
  write('sections.json', secs);
} else if (cmd === 'align') {
  const secs = read('sections.json');
  const missing = secs.filter(s => !s.file || !fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, s.file)) || !fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.align.json`)));
  if (missing.length) {
    console.error('sections without audio/alignment: ' + missing.map(s => s.id).join(' '));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const maxPause = ep.voice.maxPause ?? 0.45;
  const sectionDur = [], shotOffset = {}, allWords = [];
  for (const [k, s] of secs.entries()) {
    const mp3 = path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.mp3`), wav = path.join(DIR, s.file);
    const alignment = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, 'vo', `${s.id}.align.json`), 'utf8'));
    const map = buildTimeMap(mp3, maxPause);
    const tempo = s.tempo ?? 1;
    const words = wordsFromAlignment(alignment).map(w => ({ w: w.w, t: mapTime(map, w.t0, tempo) }));
    sectionDur[k] = durOf(wav);
    const sw = [], owner = [];
    s.shots.forEach(i => toks(ep.shots[i].vo).forEach(w => { sw.push(w); owner.push(i); }));
    if (words.length !== sw.length) {
      console.log(`${s.id}: WARNING word count mismatch — script has ${sw.length}, ElevenLabs voiced ${words.length} (mispronunciation or text drift; re-run 'sections' then 'voice' if the script changed)`);
    }
    const T = sw.map((_, j) => (words[j] ?? words[words.length - 1] ?? { t: 0 }).t);
    s.shots.forEach(i => (shotOffset[i] = T[owner.indexOf(i)]));
    allWords.push({ section: s.id, words: sw.map((w, j) => ({ w, t: +T[j].toFixed(3), shot: owner[j] })) });
    console.log(`${s.id}: ${sectionDur[k].toFixed(2)} s, ${sw.length} words`);
  }
  const timing = layout(secs, sectionDur, shotOffset);
  attachWords(timing, secs, allWords.map(x => x.words));
  write('timing.json', timing);
  write('words.json', allWords);
  report(timing);
} else if (cmd === 'draft') {
  const secs = buildSections();
  const WPS = 3.0;
  const sectionDur = secs.map(s => s.shots.reduce((a, i) => a + toks(ep.shots[i].vo).length / WPS + 0.15, 0));
  const shotOffset = {};
  secs.forEach(s => {
    let acc = 0;
    s.shots.forEach(i => { shotOffset[i] = acc; acc += toks(ep.shots[i].vo).length / WPS + 0.15; });
  });
  const timing = layout(secs, sectionDur, shotOffset);
  timing.draft = true;
  attachWords(timing, secs, secs.map(sec => {
    const out = [];
    sec.shots.forEach(i => { let acc = shotOffset[i]; toks(ep.shots[i].vo).forEach(w => { out.push({ w, t: acc, shot: i }); acc += 1 / WPS; }); });
    return out;
  }));

} else if (cmd === 'script') {
  // readable script for review: one line per shot, speaker names from the cast, times from timing.json
  const tm = fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, 'timing.json')) ? read('timing.json') : null;
  const castNames = { ...(ep.cast || {}) };
  const out = [`# ${ep.title}`, '', tm ? `${tm.draft ? 'Draft timing' : 'Voiced timing'}: ${Math.floor(tm.total / 60)}:${String(Math.round(tm.total % 60)).padStart(2, '0')}` : '', ''];
  ep.shots.forEach((shot, i) => {
    if (!shot.vo) return;
    const talker = (shot.actors || []).find(a => a.talk);
    const name = shot.who ? (talker ? (castNames[talker.id]?.name || talker.id) : shot.who).toUpperCase() : talker?.id === 'hero' ? 'YOU' : null;
    const dir = ep.voice.direction ?? DEFAULT_DIRECTION;
    const line = shot.vo.replace(new RegExp('^' + dir.replace(/[[\]()]/g, '\\$&') + '\\s*'), '').replace(/\[([^\]]*)\]/g, '*[$1]*').trim();
    const ts = tm ? `\`${Math.floor(tm.shots[i].start / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(tm.shots[i].start % 60)).padStart(2, '0')}\` ` : '';
    out.push(name ? `${ts}> **${name}:** ${line}` : `${ts}${line}`, '');
  });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(DIR, 'script.md'), out.join('\n'));
  console.log(`script.md: ${ep.shots.filter(s => s.vo).length} lines`);
} else if (cmd === 'srt') {
  // Subtitles for the user's own editor (they cut the 9:16 shorts by hand): the script's own words
  // (accents, punctuation) on ElevenLabs' exact word times. Plus the marked shorts with timecodes.
  const tm = read('timing.json');
  const nice = (ep.title || slug).replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const fin = path.join(ROOT, 'final');
  fs.mkdirSync(fin, { recursive: true });
  const ts = x => { const ms = Math.max(0, Math.round(x * 1000)); return `${String(Math.floor(ms / 3600000)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(Math.floor(ms / 60000) % 60).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(Math.floor(ms / 1000) % 60).padStart(2, '0')},${String(ms % 1000).padStart(3, '0')}`; };
  const cues = [];
  ep.shots.forEach((shot, i) => {
    const w = tm.shots[i]?.words;
    if (!shot.vo || !w?.length) return;
    // display words map 1:1 onto timed tokens (a hyphenated word may span several tokens)
    const disp = spoken(shot.vo).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    let k = 0;
    const timed = [];
    for (const d of disp) {
      const n = toks(d).length;
      if (!n) { if (timed.length) timed[timed.length - 1].text += ' ' + d; continue; }
      if (k >= w.length) break;
      timed.push({ text: d, t: tm.shots[i].start + w[k][1] });
      k += n;
    }
    // lines of ≤ 5 words / ≤ 32 chars, broken after punctuation; each stays until the next starts (max 2.5 s)
    let line = [];
    const flush = end => { if (line.length) cues.push({ t0: line[0].t, t1: end, text: line.map(x => x.text).join(' ') }); line = []; };
    timed.forEach((x, j) => {
      const len = line.map(y => y.text).join(' ').length + x.text.length;
      // never leave the sentence's last word alone on its own line: it may stretch the line to 6 words / 40 chars
      const ends = /[.!?…,;:]$/.test(x.text);
      if (line.length && (line.length >= 5 || len > 32) && !(ends && line.length < 6 && len <= 40)) flush(x.t);
      line.push(x);
      if (/[.!?…,;:]$/.test(x.text)) flush(timed[j + 1]?.t ?? x.t + 0.6);
    });
    flush((timed.at(-1)?.t ?? 0) + 0.6);
  });
  cues.forEach((c, j) => { const nx = cues[j + 1]; c.t1 = Math.min(c.t1, c.t0 + 2.5, nx ? nx.t0 : Infinity); if (c.t1 - c.t0 < 0.3) c.t1 = c.t0 + 0.3; });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(fin, `${nice}.srt`), cues.map((c, j) => `${j + 1}\n${ts(c.t0)} --> ${ts(c.t1)}\n${c.text}\n`).join('\n'));
  const ids = ep.shots.map(x => x.id);
  const tc = x => `${Math.floor(x / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(x % 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const clips = (ep.clips || []).map((c, j) => {
    const a = ids.indexOf(c.from), b = ids.indexOf(c.to);
    if (a < 0 || b < 0) return `${j + 1}. ${c.title}: shot ids not found`;
    const t0 = Math.max(0, tm.shots[a].start - 0.12), t1 = tm.shots[b].start + tm.shots[b].dur;
    return `${j + 1}. ${c.title}  ${tc(t0)} → ${tc(t1)}  (${Math.round(t1 - t0)} s)`;
  });
  if (clips.length) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(fin, `${nice} - cortes.txt`), `Cortes para shorts (9:16) — ${ep.title}\n\n${clips.join('\n')}\n`);
  console.log(`srt: ${cues.length} legendas -> final/${nice}.srt${clips.length ? `; ${clips.length} cortes -> final/${nice} - cortes.txt` : ''}`);
} else {
  console.error('unknown command ' + cmd);
  process.exit(1);
}

/** Per-shot word list [word, seconds-into-shot] so specs can cue effects on words ("@blink#2+0.1"). */
function attachWords(timing, secs, wordsPerSection) {
  secs.forEach((sec, k) => {
    const s0 = timing.sections[k].start;
    for (const w of wordsPerSection[k]) {
      const sh = timing.shots[w.shot];
      (sh.words ||= []).push([w.w, +(s0 + w.t - sh.start).toFixed(3)]);
    }
  });
}

function report(timing) {
  const short = timing.shots.map((s, i) => [i, s.dur]).filter(([, d]) => d < 0.8);
  console.log(`total ${timing.total.toFixed(1)} s (${(timing.total / 60).toFixed(2)} min), ${timing.shots.length} shots, avg ${(timing.total / timing.shots.length).toFixed(2)} s/shot`);
  if (short.length) console.log('very short shots (merge or extend): ' + short.map(([i, d]) => `#${i} ${d}s`).join(', '));
}

# Skeleton for a new episode. Copy to tools/episodes/<slug_with_underscores>.py, set SLUG, fill the beats.
#   .venv/Scripts/python -I tools/episodes/<file>.py   -> public/episodes/<slug>/episode.json
# episode.json is regenerated from the .py: never hand-edit the JSON.
# Beats, word budgets and rules: docs/story/COLA_ROTEIRO.md. Schema: src/types.ts. Cards: src/cards (CARDS).
# One shot per 2.5–5 s of narration; ids unique (edits by id hit the first match); vo in PT-BR,
# numbers spelled out, [tags] in English (COLA "Tags de áudio").
# ritmo='rapido' (house pacing): automatic sub-cuts (coverage 'fast') on automatic cameras and whip/zoom on set
# changes. Override per shot: coverage='calm' in the dilemma, 'off' for a held tableau; cut='smash' on a reveal/punchline.
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))  # python -I drops the script dir
from kit import *  # noqa: E402,F401,F403  (A, S, C, cam, walk, crush, TALK, SW, episode, load_timing, resolve_countdowns, write)

SLUG = 'novo-episodio'
TITLE = 'E Se Você ...?'

# Marks and repeated actors/props go here, e.g.:
# HERO_DESK = 'seat2'
# RULES = ['REGRA UM', 'REGRA DOIS', 'REGRA TRÊS']

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. abertura fria (0:00–0:20)
# Plan 1 = close of an object; power visible by 0:08; witness line + deadpan answer.
# S('c1', 'bedroom', 'Você ...', [A('hero', 'bed+0.6,0,0', 180, 'stand', 'neutral')], cam('insert', 'hero'))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. pergunta do título (0:20–0:25)
# S('t1', 'suburb', 'E se você ...? Veja o que realmente muda.', camera=cam('establishing', 'hero'),
#   overlays=[{'type': 'title', 'text': TITLE}])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. mecanismo + limite (0:25–0:50)
# C('m1', 'icon', '...')  # the body part; then the limit's signpost line ("Guarda isso.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. escada de números + ciência (0:50–1:25)
# C('n1', 'compare', '...', ...)  # NORMAL vs VOCÊ

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5. teste de prova (1:25–1:50)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 6. regras (1:50–2:30)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 7. ladainha de vantagens (2:30–3:40)
# 12–16 itens "X + número. Efeito em 1 linha." (COLA "Ladainha"); um plano por item, número em destaque + SFX:
# ladainha('v', 'suburb', [
#     {'vo': 'A moça da cantina custa três reais. Agora o pastel vem com dois recheios.',
#      'word': ('R$ 3', '@três'), 'actors': [...], 'camera': cam('medium', 'cantina')},
#     ...
# ])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 8. "mas" + problemas 1–3 (3:40–4:40)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 9. problema real (4:40–5:25)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 10. maestria + regra tema (5:25–6:05)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 11. crise (6:05–6:30)
# Countdown that lines up across cuts: put {'type': 'stopwatch', 'cd': 'main'} in each shot's overlays,
# then fill `clocks` at the bottom.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 12. dilema (6:30–6:50)
# Binary "A… ou B." then a silent hold: S('d9', ..., hold=2)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 13. clímax (6:50–7:35)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 14. consequência (7:35–8:00)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 15. mundo maior (8:00–9:10)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 16. gancho final (9:10–9:40)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 17. CTA (9:40–10:00)
# S('i1', 'suburb', 'Então: ...? E ...? Conta pra gente nos comentários. Todo poder tem um preço. Até a próxima.', ...)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- episode
ep = episode(
    SLUG, TITLE,
    ritmo='rapido',
    clips=[  # ≥ 4 shorts of ~90 s, whole shots, each opens on a cold hook (COLA "Cortes para shorts")
        # ('O poder', 'c1', 'n3'), ('Os problemas', 'p1', 'p9'), ('O plano', '...', '...'), ('O clímax', 'k1', 'k12'),
    ],
    cast={
        'bestie': {'name': '...'},
        # 'mom': {'name': 'Mãe'},
        # new characters: top/topColor/accent/bottom/bottomColor/shoes/hair — never gray (gray is the hero's)
    },
    music=[  # (first shot id, mood): curious, wonder, tension, action, sad, none
        # ('c1', 'curious'),
    ],
)

# Live countdowns from the real voice timing (no-op on the draft, which shows the fallback):
tm = load_timing(SLUG)
# clocks = {'main': (tm.at('<shot>', '<word>'), tm.at('<shot>', '<word>'), <total s>, 'tr', '<last shot id>')} if tm else {}
# resolve_countdowns(tm, clocks)

write(SLUG, ep)

import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))  # python -I drops the script dir
from kit import apply_ritmo  # noqa: E402  (house pacing; the rest of this older generator keeps its own helpers)

SLUG = 'invasao-zumbi'
GREEN = '#8dff6a'
shots = []


def A(id, pos, rot=0, pose='stand', face='neutral', **kw):
    d = {'id': id, 'pos': pos, 'rot': rot, 'pose': pose, 'face': face}
    d.update(kw)
    return d


def Z(id, pos, rot=0, **kw):
    """A zombie: arms out, half-asleep face, green spore glow."""
    kw.setdefault('pose', 'zombie')
    kw.setdefault('face', 'zombie')
    kw.setdefault('glow', GREEN)
    pose, face = kw.pop('pose'), kw.pop('face')
    return A(id, pos, rot, pose, face, **kw)


def walk(a, b, t0=0.2, t1=3.0, gait='shamble'):
    return [{'t': t0, 'pos': a}, {'t': t1, 'pos': b, 'gait': gait}]


def cam(shot, target, angle=0, **kw):
    d = {'shot': shot, 'target': target, 'angle': angle}
    d.update(kw)
    return d


def S(id, set_, vo=None, actors=None, camera=None, **kw):
    d = {'id': id, 'set': set_}
    if vo:
        d['vo'] = vo
    if actors:
        d['actors'] = actors
    if camera:
        d['camera'] = camera
    d.update(kw)
    shots.append(d)


def C(id, card, vo, **spec):
    d = {'id': id, 'kind': 'card', 'card': card, 'vo': vo}
    d.update(spec)
    shots.append(d)

       {'type': 'sign', 'pos': [-5.92, 1.95, 3.6], 'rot': 90, 'w': 1.1, 'h': 0.32, 'text': 'LAB. DE CIÊNCIAS', 'bg': '#f6f2e8', 'fg': '#1d2333'}]

BELL_CLS = {'type': 'box', 'pos': [-2.4, 2.6, -4.85], 'w': 0.5, 'h': 0.32, 'd': 0.18, 'color': '#c8402f'}
SUNPATCH = {'type': 'rug', 'pos': [0.4, 0.005, -3.6], 'w': 2.4, 'd': 1.3, 'color': '#fff0b0'}
FLOORSIT = {'hipY': -0.71, 'spine': [8, 0, 0], 'legL': [88, 8, 8], 'legR': [86, 8, 14], 'armL': [-25, 20, 0, 10], 'armR': [-25, 20, 0, 10], 'handL': 'open', 'handR': 'open'}
def crowd(n, x0, x1, z0, z1, seed=1, gap=0.9, keep=()):
    """n points on a jittered layout inside a box, never closer than `gap` to each other or to `keep` points."""
    import random
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    pts = list(keep)
    out = []
    tries = 0
    while len(out) < n and tries < 6000:
        tries += 1
        px, pz = rnd.uniform(x0, x1), rnd.uniform(z0, z1)
        if all((px - a) ** 2 + (pz - b) ** 2 >= gap * gap for a, b in pts):
            pts.append((px, pz))
            out.append((round(px, 2), round(pz, 2)))
    return out


def face_to(tx, tz):
    import math
    return lambda px, pz: round(math.degrees(math.atan2(tx - px, tz - pz)))


def horde(pts, rot=0, first=1, to=None, t1=5.0, **kw):
    """Zombie extras x01, x02… at pts; rot may be face_to(...); to=(tx, tz, frac) walks them that fraction toward a point."""
    out = []
    for k, (px, pz) in enumerate(pts):
        r = rot(px, pz) if callable(rot) else rot
        a = dict(kw)
        if to:
            tx, tz, fr = to
            a['path'] = walk([px, 0, pz], [round(px + (tx - px) * fr, 2), 0, round(pz + (tz - pz) * fr, 2)], 0.0, t1)
        out.append(Z(f'x{first + k:02d}', [px, 0, pz], r, **a))
    return out

def resolve_countdowns():
    """Turn CD/CDS markers into live countdowns that line up across cuts (story time runs faster than screen time)."""
    tp = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '..', 'public', 'episodes', SLUG, 'timing.json')
    tm = json.load(open(tp, encoding='utf-8')) if os.path.exists(tp) else None
    if not tm or len(tm['shots']) != len(shots):
        for sh in shots:
            for o in sh.get('overlays', []):
                if o.pop('cd', None):
                    o['from'] = '4:00'
        return

    def wt(sid, word):
        sh = tm['shots'][idx[sid]]
        return sh['start'] + next(t for w, t in sh['words'] if w == word)

    # both clocks sit bottom-centre (9:16 column, off the faces); they never overlap in time
    # y5: 0:30 runs down to 0:00 on "pisca"
    y5 = shots[idx['y5']]['overlays'][0]
    y5['tick'] = round(30 / max(0.5, wt('y5', 'pisca') - tm['shots'][idx['y5']]['start'] - 0.1), 3)
    clocks = {'bell': (wt('z6', 'quatro'), wt('e6', 'toca'), 240, 'bc', 'e6'),
              'sun': (wt('e7', 'trinta'), tm['shots'][idx['e11']]['start'] + tm['shots'][idx['e11']]['dur'], 30, 'bc', 'e11')}
    for i, sh in enumerate(shots):
        for o in sh.get('overlays', []):
            kind = o.pop('cd', None)
            if not kind:
                continue
            t0, t1, total, corner, last = clocks[kind]
            rate = total / (t1 - t0)
            st = tm['shots'][i]['start']
            begin = max(st, t0)
            left = max(0.0, total - (begin - t0) * rate)
            o.update({'from': f'{int(left // 60)}:{int(round(left % 60)) % 60:02d}' if round(left % 60) < 60 else f'{int(left // 60) + 1}:00',
                      'tick': round(rate, 3), 'corner': corner, 'keep': sh['id'] != last})
            if st < t0:
                o['at'] = round(t0 - st, 3)
            else:
                o['persist'] = True


resolve_countdowns()


def clean(o):
    """Drop None values (e.g. glow=None on a zombie that isn't glowing yet)."""
    if isinstance(o, dict):
        return {k: clean(v) for k, v in o.items() if v is not None}
    if isinstance(o, list):
        return [clean(v) for v in o]
    return o


out = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '..', 'public', 'episodes', SLUG, 'episode.json')
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
with open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(clean(ep), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
words = sum(len(s.get('vo', '').split()) for s in shots)
print(f'{len(shots)} shots, {words} words -> {os.path.normpath(out)}')

"""Shared helpers for episode generators (tools/episodes/<slug>.py -> public/episodes/<slug>/episode.json).

Use from a generator:
    import os, sys
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))   # python -I drops the script dir
    from kit import *

Then build shots with S(...) / C(...), the episode dict with ep = episode(...), and finish with write(SLUG, ep).
Start a new episode from _modelo.py.
"""
import json
import os

__all__ = ['shots', 'A', 'cam', 'S', 'C', 'ladainha', 'apply_ritmo', 'crush', 'walk', 'TALK', 'SW', 'shot_index', 'episode',
           'load_timing', 'resolve_countdowns', 'clean', 'write', 'NARRATOR', 'HOUSE_VOICES']

ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..', '..'))
NARRATOR = {'id': 'u7N1p4OIOc6Fl7y72WE7', 'model': 'eleven_v4'}  # Yuri (docs/pipeline/EPISODE.md, Voice)
HOUSE_VOICES = {'adulto': 'u4sbCzXyUVxIAihOtCss', 'adulta': 'dxIMMSJYSsbUSMhioLNb'}

shots = []
TALK = [[0.05, 3.0]]                                             # talk window for a short line


def SW(v):
    """A stopwatch that continues across cuts (no draw-in)."""
    return {'type': 'stopwatch', 'from': v, 'persist': True}


def A(id, pos, rot=0, pose='stand', face='neutral', **kw):
    """An actor."""
    d = {'id': id, 'pos': pos, 'rot': rot, 'pose': pose, 'face': face}
    d.update(kw)
    return d


def cam(shot, target, angle=0, **kw):
    """An automatic camera: shot = xclose|close|medium|full|wide|establishing|insert."""
    d = {'shot': shot, 'target': target, 'angle': angle}
    d.update(kw)
    return d


def S(id, set_, vo=None, actors=None, camera=None, **kw):
    """A 3D shot, appended to `shots`."""
    d = {'id': id, 'set': set_}
    if vo:
        d['vo'] = vo
    if actors:
        d['actors'] = actors
    if camera:
        d['camera'] = camera
    d.update(kw)
    shots.append(d)


def C(id, card, vo, **spec):
    """A card shot (src/cards), appended to `shots`."""
    d = {'id': id, 'kind': 'card', 'card': card, 'vo': vo}
    d.update(spec)
    shots.append(d)


def ladainha(prefix, set_, itens, sfx='chime', color='yellow', **common):
    """A list montage (COLA "Ladainha"): one 3D shot per item, ~4–6 s each, ids prefix1, prefix2, ...
    Each item is a dict of S() fields (vo required; actors, camera, set, fx, ... optional) plus
      word: the item's number or key word, shown as a palavra-destaque on its spoken cue with a short SFX.
            Either (shown text, cue) — ('R$ 3', '@três') — or a plain spoken word ('cinco' → cue '@cinco').
    `common` holds fields every item shares (e.g. coverage='fast'); an item's own fields win.
    sfx=None drops the per-item sound."""
    for i, it in enumerate(itens, 1):
        it = {'repeat': True, **common, **it}  # a ladainha repeats its structure on purpose (episode.mjs check)
        word = it.pop('word', None)
        overlays, cues = list(it.pop('overlays', [])), list(it.pop('sfx', []))
        if word:
            text, cue = word if isinstance(word, (list, tuple)) else (word.upper(), '@' + word.lower())
            overlays.insert(0, {'type': 'word', 'text': text, 'at': cue, 'color': color})
            if sfx:
                cues.insert(0, {'t': cue, 'name': sfx})
        if overlays:
            it['overlays'] = overlays
        if cues:
            it['sfx'] = cues
        S(f'{prefix}{i}', it.pop('set', set_), it.pop('vo'), it.pop('actors', None), it.pop('camera', None), **it)


def crush(actor, value, frm=None, at=0.3, **kw):
    """The pink crush-meter overlay over an actor."""
    d = {'type': 'crush', 'actor': actor, 'value': value, 'at': at}
    if frm is not None:
        d['from'] = frm
    d.update(kw)
    return d


def walk(a, b, t0=0.2, t1=3.0, gait='walk'):
    """A two-key path from a to b."""
    return [{'t': t0, 'pos': a}, {'t': t1, 'pos': b, 'gait': gait}]


def shot_index():
    """{shot id: index}; fails on duplicate ids (edits by id hit the first match)."""
    idx = {s['id']: i for i, s in enumerate(shots)}
    assert len(idx) == len(shots), 'duplicate shot ids'
    return idx


def apply_ritmo(shots_):
    """House pacing (since 2026-11-08): automatic sub-cuts on 3D shots (coverage 'fast' unless the shot sets
    its own; use 'calm' in the dilemma, 'off' for a held tableau). Automatic cameras re-frame per beat; explicit
    pos/path cameras punch in / orbit their own view (scene.ts beatView); over-the-shoulder shots are left alone.
    and a whip / zoom transition, alternating, on every 3D→3D set change that has no explicit cut.
    Smash cuts stay hand-placed (reveals, punchlines)."""
    alt = ['whip', 'zoom']
    n = 0
    for i, sh in enumerate(shots_):
        if sh.get('kind') == 'card':
            continue
        c = sh.get('camera') or {}
        if 'coverage' not in sh and not c.get('over'):
            sh['coverage'] = 'fast'
        prev = shots_[i - 1] if i else None
        if prev and prev.get('kind') != 'card' and 'cut' not in sh and prev.get('set') != sh.get('set'):
            sh['cut'] = alt[n % 2]
            n += 1


def episode(slug, title, cast, music, voices=None, voice=None, ritmo=None, clips=None, **kw):
    """The episode dict. music: [(shot id, mood), ...]. ritmo='rapido' applies the house pacing (apply_ritmo).
    clips: [(title, first shot id, last shot id), ...] — the ≥ 4 self-contained ~90 s shorts (COLA "Cortes")."""
    if ritmo == 'rapido':
        apply_ritmo(shots)
    idx = shot_index()
    ep = {
        'slug': slug,
        'title': title,
        'voice': dict(voice or NARRATOR),
        'voices': dict(voices if voices is not None else HOUSE_VOICES),
        'cast': cast,
        'music': [{'shot': idx[sid], 'mood': mood} for sid, mood in music],
        'shots': shots,
    }
    if clips:
        ep['clips'] = [{'title': t, 'from': a, 'to': b} for t, a, b in clips]
    ep.update(kw)
    return ep


class Timing:
    """Real voice timing (timing.json after `align`), by shot id."""

    def __init__(self, tm, idx):
        self.tm, self.idx = tm, idx

    def start(self, sid):
        return self.tm['shots'][self.idx[sid]]['start']

    def dur(self, sid):
        return self.tm['shots'][self.idx[sid]]['dur']

    def word(self, sid, w, n=1):
        """Seconds into shot `sid` where word `w` is spoken (n-th occurrence)."""
        hits = [t for x, t in self.tm['shots'][self.idx[sid]]['words'] if x == w]
        return hits[n - 1]

    def at(self, sid, w, n=1):
        """Absolute episode time of word `w` in shot `sid`."""
        return self.start(sid) + self.word(sid, w, n)

    @staticmethod
    def fmt(sec):
        """m:ss, rounded, never negative."""
        s = max(0, int(round(sec)))
        return f'{s // 60}:{s % 60:02d}'


def load_timing(slug):
    """Timing helper, or None while there's no voice yet or the shot count changed (draft keeps static values)."""
    p = os.path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'episodes', slug, 'timing.json')
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return None
    with open(p, encoding='utf-8') as f:
        tm = json.load(f)
    if len(tm['shots']) != len(shots):
        return None
    return Timing(tm, shot_index())


def resolve_countdowns(timing, clocks, fallback='4:00'):
    """Live countdowns that line up across cuts (story time can run faster than screen time).

    Mark overlays with {'type': 'stopwatch', 'cd': '<clock name>'}; clocks maps each name to
    (t0, t1, total_seconds, corner, last_shot_id): the clock reads `total` at absolute time t0 and 0 at t1.
    Without timing (draft) every marker shows `fallback`."""
    if timing is None:
        for sh in shots:
            for o in sh.get('overlays', []):
                if o.pop('cd', None):
                    o['from'] = fallback
        return
    for i, sh in enumerate(shots):
        for o in sh.get('overlays', []):
            kind = o.pop('cd', None)
            if not kind:
                continue
            t0, t1, total, corner, last = clocks[kind]
            rate = total / (t1 - t0)
            st = timing.tm['shots'][i]['start']
            begin = max(st, t0)
            left = max(0.0, total - (begin - t0) * rate)
            o.update({'from': f'{int(left // 60)}:{int(round(left % 60)) % 60:02d}' if round(left % 60) < 60 else f'{int(left // 60) + 1}:00',
                      'tick': round(rate, 3), 'corner': corner, 'keep': sh['id'] != last})
            if st < t0:
                o['at'] = round(t0 - st, 3)
            else:
                o['persist'] = True


def clean(o):
    """Drop None values recursively (e.g. glow=None)."""
    if isinstance(o, dict):
        return {k: clean(v) for k, v in o.items() if v is not None}
    if isinstance(o, list):
        return [clean(v) for v in o]
    return o


def write(slug, ep, drop_none=True):
    """Write public/episodes/<slug>/episode.json and print a one-line summary."""
    out = os.path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'episodes', slug, 'episode.json')
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
    with open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(clean(ep) if drop_none else ep, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    words = sum(len(s.get('vo', '').split()) for s in ep['shots'])
    print(f'{len(ep["shots"])} shots, {words} words -> {os.path.normpath(out)}')
@@@@ END

def M(rows, at=0.2, **kw):
    """Body-settings menu overlay. rows: (label, value) | (label, from, to, cue) | dicts."""
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        if isinstance(r, dict):
            out.append(r)
        elif len(r) == 2:
            out.append({'label': r[0], 'value': r[1]})
        else:
            d = {'label': r[0], 'from': r[1], 'value': r[2], 'at': r[3]}
            if len(r) > 4:
                d.update(r[4])
            out.append(d)
    o = {'type': 'menu', 'rows': out, 'at': at, 'y': 'low'}  # low: under the faces; shots with the bottom-centre clock pass y='top'
    o.update(kw)
    return o

# The grip: both right wrists on one point at the hole's edge, 1.0 m ahead of the hero's root (toward Ivy).
# reachR targets are root-local (forward = +z); Ivy is scaled 0.82, so her local target is divided by 0.82.
GRIP_H = {'to': [0.0, 0.16, 1.0]}                                       # hero (root y 0.04 -> grip y 0.2)
GRIP_I = lambda depth: {'to': [0.0, round((0.2 - depth) / 0.82 - 0.45, 3), 0.42]}  # Ivy at ICE, root y = depth
HOLD_H = {**PRONE, 'head': [-62, 0, 0], 'reachR': GRIP_H, 'armL': [150, 24, 0, 30]}
HOLD_I = lambda depth: {**TREAD, 'head': [-25, 0, 0], 'armL': [50, 35, 0, 30], 'reachR': GRIP_I(depth)}
SIDE_CAM = {'pos': [-13.83, 0.6, -14.06], 'look': [-15.3, 0.15, -12.42], 'fov': 40}  # perpendicular to the hero–Ivy line

def PULL(sid, depth, cue_word, camera):
    up = round(depth + 0.22, 2)
    S(sid, 'park', 'Puxa.', variant=1, time='golden', hold=0.5, props=[{'type': 'iceHole', 'pos': ICE, 'size': 0.6}],
      actors=[A('hero', ICE_NEAR, TO_ICE, HOLD_H, 'determined', contact=True,
                faces=[{'t': '@puxa', 'face': {'eyes': 0.5, 'brow': -0.9, 'mouth': -0.7, 'width': 1.2}, 'blend': 0.2}]),
              A('sister', [ICE[0], depth, ICE[2]], TO_SHORE, HOLD_I(depth), 'scared', contact=True,
                path=[{'t': '@puxa', 'pos': [ICE[0], depth, ICE[2]]}, {'t': '@puxa+0.4', 'pos': [ICE[0], up, ICE[2]], 'gait': 'carried'}],
                poses=[{'t': '@puxa', 'pose': HOLD_I(depth), 'blend': 0.05}, {'t': '@puxa+0.4', 'pose': HOLD_I(up), 'blend': 0.4}])],
      camera=camera, sfx=[{'t': '@puxa', 'name': 'crack' if cue_word else 'splash', 'vol': -8}],
      overlays=[{'type': 'stopwatch', 'cd': 'main', 'corner': 'bc'}], coverage='off', **({'cut': 'smash'} if cue_word else {}))

            if o.pop('cd', None):

else:
    idx = shot_index()
    keys = [(tm.at('k8', 'agora'), 600.0), (tm.start('f8') + tm.dur('f8'), 420.0), (tm.start('e13'), 70.0)]

    def clock_at(T):
        if T <= keys[0][0]:
            return keys[0][1], 0.0
        for (t0, v0), (t1, v1) in zip(keys, keys[1:]):
            if T <= t1:
                rate = (v0 - v1) / (t1 - t0)
                return v0 - (T - t0) * rate, rate
        return keys[-1][1], 0.0

    last = 'e13'
    for i, sh in enumerate(shots):
        for o in sh.get('overlays', []):
            if not o.pop('cd', None):
                continue
            st = tm.tm['shots'][i]['start']
            begin = max(st, keys[0][0])
            left, rate = clock_at(begin + 0.01)
            if rate == 0.0:
                rate = 0.001
            left = max(0.0, left)
            o.update({'from': f'{int(left // 60)}:{int(left % 60):02d}', 'tick': round(rate, 3), 'keep': sh['id'] != last})
            if st < keys[0][0]:
                o['at'] = round(keys[0][0] - st, 3)
            else:
                o['persist'] = True

write(SLUG, ep)
