// QA runner (no frames rendered):
//   node tools/qa.cjs selftest           engine self-tests (npm test)
//   node tools/qa.cjs audit <slug>       pre-render scene audit → out/<slug>/audit.json; exit 1 on errors
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const { createRequire } = require('module');
const req = createRequire(path.join(ROOT, 'package.json'));
const { bundle } = req('@remotion/bundler');
const { selectComposition, openBrowser } = req('@remotion/renderer');

(async () => {
  const [cmd, slug] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (!['audit', 'selftest'].includes(cmd) || (cmd === 'audit' && !slug)) {
    console.error('usage: node tools/qa.cjs selftest | audit <slug>');
    process.exit(2);
  }
  const serveUrl = await bundle({ entryPoint: path.join(ROOT, 'src/index.ts'), publicDir: path.join(ROOT, 'public') });
  const browser = await openBrowser('chrome', { chromiumOptions: { gl: 'angle' } });
  let code = 0;
  try {
    const comp = await selectComposition({
      serveUrl, id: cmd === 'audit' ? 'Audit' : 'SelfTest', inputProps: cmd === 'audit' ? { slug } : {},
      puppeteerInstance: browser, chromiumOptions: { gl: 'angle' }, timeoutInMilliseconds: 600000,
    });
    if (cmd === 'selftest') {
      const res = comp.props.results;
      for (const r of res) console.log(`${r.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${r.name}${r.pass ? '' : '  —  ' + r.detail}`);
      const failed = res.filter(r => !r.pass).length;
      console.log(`
${res.length - failed}/${res.length} passed`);
      code = failed ? 1 : 0;
    } else {
      const out = path.join(ROOT, 'out', slug);
      fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, 'audit.json'), JSON.stringify(comp.props.report, null, 1));
      console.log(comp.props.text);
      code = comp.props.report.findings.some(f => f.sev === 'error') ? 1 : 0;
    }
  } finally {
    await browser.close({ silent: true });
  }
  process.exit(code);
})();

// Review frames: event-anchored, labelled stills for the visual review and the independent reviewer.
//   node tools/review.mjs <slug>
// 1. runs the scene audit (out/<slug>/audit.json) for the event list
// 2. renders Episode in review mode (name tags, expected-position markers, shot/time banner):
//    - every event (swap, path jump, flow boundary): before / at / after, 960×540 each, stacked
//    - every shot: first frame after the cut + early / late / end frames, as a strip per shot (and overview sheets)
//    - flags near-uniform (blank) frames, e.g. a camera inside a wall
// 3. writes out/<slug>/review/manifest.json: each image with its shot, narration and what must be true
//
// Incremental rounds (after fixes):  node tools/review.mjs <slug> --only c8,r6,...
//   re-renders only those shots (ids, or plain shot indexes) plus the events that touch them, and keeps
//   every other image and manifest entry from the last full run. manifest.only lists what changed, so a
//   round-2 reviewer looks at just those. Refuses (asks for a full run) if the shot list or timing changed.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const slug = args.find(a => !a.startsWith('--') && args[args.indexOf(a) - 1] !== '--only');
const onlyArg = args.includes('--only') ? args[args.indexOf('--only') + 1] : null;
if (!slug || (args.includes('--only') && !onlyArg)) {
  console.error('usage: node tools/review.mjs <slug> [--only <shotId,shotId,...>]');
  process.exit(1);
}
const D = path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'episodes', slug);
const OUT = path.join(ROOT, 'out', slug, 'review');
const ep = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(D, 'episode.json'), 'utf8'));
const tmRaw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(D, 'timing.json'), 'utf8');
const tm = JSON.parse(tmRaw);
const fps = tm.fps || 30;
const timingHash = crypto.createHash('sha1').update(tmRaw).digest('hex').slice(0, 12);
const shotIds = ep.shots.map(s => s.id);

// --only: resolve shot ids to indexes and check the previous full run is still valid
let only = null, prev = null;
if (onlyArg) {
  const manifestPath = path.join(OUT, 'manifest.json');
  if (!fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) { console.error('--only needs a previous full run (no manifest.json). Run without --only first.'); process.exit(1); }
  prev = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8'));
  if (prev.timingHash !== timingHash || JSON.stringify(prev.shotIds) !== JSON.stringify(shotIds)) {
    console.error('timing.json or the shot list changed since the last full run (shot times/indexes moved). Run without --only.');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  only = new Set();
  for (const tok of onlyArg.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)) {
    const i = /^\d+$/.test(tok) ? +tok : shotIds.indexOf(tok);
    if (i < 0 || i >= shotIds.length) { console.error(`unknown shot "${tok}"`); process.exit(1); }
    only.add(i);
  }
}

// keep earlier reviewer reports: out/<slug>/review_history/reviewer_report_<time>.md
const prevReport = path.join(OUT, 'reviewer_report.md');
if (fs.existsSync(prevReport)) {
  const hist = path.join(ROOT, 'out', slug, 'review_history');
  fs.mkdirSync(hist, { recursive: true });
  fs.copyFileSync(prevReport, path.join(hist, `reviewer_report_${fs.statSync(prevReport).mtime.toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}.md`));
}
if (!only) fs.rmSync(OUT, { recursive: true, force: true });
fs.mkdirSync(path.join(OUT, 'raw'), { recursive: true });

// 1. audit (for events); errors are reported but don't stop the review frames
spawnSync('node', [path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'qa.cjs'), 'audit', slug], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: ROOT });
const audit = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'out', slug, 'audit.json'), 'utf8'));

const frameAt = (shot, t) => {
  const s = tm.shots[shot];
  const f0 = Math.round(s.start * fps), f1 = Math.round((s.start + s.dur) * fps) - 1;
  return Math.max(f0, Math.min(f1, f0 + Math.round(t * fps)));
};
const vo = i => (ep.shots[i].vo || '').replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, '').trim();

const jobs = [], items = [];
let render = true; // false while listing files of shots --only skips (paths only, no render job)
const job = (name, frame) => {
  if (render) jobs.push({ out: `../${slug}/review/raw/${name}`, id: 'Episode', props: { slug, review: true }, frame });
  return path.join(OUT, 'raw', name + '.jpg');
};
// an event touches its shot, and a flow also the shot it comes from
const touches = e => !only || only.has(e.shot) || (e.kind === 'flow' && only.has(e.shot - 1));

// 2a. events
audit.events.forEach((e, k) => {
  if (!touches(e)) return;
  const label = `${String(k).padStart(2, '0')}_${e.kind}_s${e.shot}`;
  let times, expect;
  if (e.kind === 'swap') {
    times = [e.t - 0.3, e.t + 0.1, e.t + 0.6];
    expect = `SWAP ${e.what}. Frame 1: both characters at their start spots, the swapper blinking. Frames 2–3: each character stands on the OTHER's dashed marker. Exactly one name tag per marker. No two tags on one spot, no character left behind.`;
  } else if (e.kind === 'jump') {
    times = [e.t - 0.2, e.t + 0.05, e.t + 0.5];
    expect = `JUMP: ${e.what}. The move should read as intended (a swap/teleport/momentum gag), not as a glitch. Nobody overlaps after it.`;
  } else if (e.kind === 'clip') {
    const d = tm.shots[e.shot].dur;
    times = [Math.max(0.03, e.t - 0.3), e.t, Math.min(d - 0.03, e.t + 0.3)];
    expect = `CLIP: ${e.what} (audit). Look at the body against the furniture/prop in all 3 frames: does any part visibly pass THROUGH it (a hand inside a box, legs inside a sofa, a head sunk into a desk)? If it shows, it's a defect: move the actor or prop, change the pose, or re-seat them. If the camera can't see it (behind the body, off-frame), say so and pass it.`;
  } else if (e.kind === 'flow') {
    const prevDur = tm.shots[e.shot - 1].dur;
    const pa = frameAt(e.shot - 1, prevDur - 0.05), b0 = frameAt(e.shot, 0.05), b1 = frameAt(e.shot, 1.0);
    const files = [job(label + '_a', pa), job(label + '_b', b0), job(label + '_c', b1)];
    items.push({ label, kind: 'flow', shot: e.shot, id: ep.shots[e.shot].id, files, vo: vo(e.shot),
      expect: `FLOW into shot ${e.shot}: the camera must continue smoothly from frame 1 (end of shot ${e.shot - 1}) through frames 2–3. No jump of the image between frames 1 and 2; characters keep their places.` });
    return;
  } else return; // plain cuts need no event frames
  const files = times.map((t, j) => job(`${label}_${'abc'[j]}`, frameAt(e.shot, t)));
  items.push({ label, kind: e.kind, shot: e.shot, id: ep.shots[e.shot].id, files, vo: vo(e.shot), expect });
});

// 2b. per shot: the first frame after the cut, then early / late / end frames (a strip), so cut-ins,
//     setups and late payoffs are all visible
const STRIP = [0, 0.3, 0.65, 0.93];
const stripT = s => STRIP.map(k => (k === 0 ? Math.min(0.04, s.dur / 2) : s.dur * k));
const strips = tm.shots.map((s, i) => {
  render = !only || only.has(i);
  return stripT(s).map((t, j) => job(`shot_${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}_${'abcd'[j]}`, frameAt(i, t)));
});
render = true;
const mids = strips.map(st => st[2]);
const rendered = new Set(jobs.map(j => path.join(OUT, 'raw', path.basename(j.out) + '.jpg')));
const isNew = f => rendered.has(f);

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'jobs.json'), JSON.stringify(jobs));
if (only) console.log(`--only: ${only.size} shots, ${items.length} events → ${jobs.length} frames`);
const r = spawnSync('node', [path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'stills.cjs'), path.join(OUT, 'jobs.json')], { encoding: 'utf8', cwd: ROOT });
const fails = (r.stdout || '').split('\n').filter(l => l.startsWith('FAIL'));
if (fails.length) console.log(fails.join('\n'));

// 3. compose: events stacked vertically at 960 px; overview sheets of mid frames
const ff = (args) => spawnSync('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-y', ...args], { stdio: 'inherit' });
for (const it of items) {
  const out = path.join(OUT, `${it.label}.jpg`);
  ff([...it.files.flatMap(f => ['-i', f]), '-filter_complex', `${it.files.map((_, j) => `[${j}]scale=960:-2[v${j}]`).join(';')};${it.files.map((_, j) => `[v${j}]`).join('')}vstack=inputs=${it.files.length}`, out]);
  it.image = path.relative(ROOT, out).replace(/\\/g, '/');
}
const shotImgs = strips.map((st, i) => {
  const out = path.join(OUT, `shot_${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}.jpg`);
  if (!only || only.has(i)) ff([...st.flatMap(f => ['-i', f]), '-filter_complex', `${st.map((_, j) => `[${j}]scale=480:-2[v${j}]`).join(';')};${st.map((_, j) => `[v${j}]`).join('')}hstack=inputs=${st.length}`, out]);
  return path.relative(ROOT, out).replace(/\\/g, '/');
});
const per = 12;
for (let p = 0; p * per < mids.length; p++) {
  const chunk = mids.slice(p * per, (p + 1) * per);
  if (only && !chunk.some(isNew)) continue; // overview sheet unchanged
  const out = path.join(OUT, `shots_${p + 1}.jpg`);
  const cols = 3;
  const rows = Math.ceil(chunk.length / cols);
  const pad = Array.from({ length: rows * cols - chunk.length }, () => chunk[chunk.length - 1]);
  const all = [...chunk, ...pad];
  ff([...all.flatMap(f => ['-i', f]), '-filter_complex',
    `${all.map((_, j) => `[${j}]scale=640:-2[v${j}]`).join(';')};${all.map((_, j) => `[v${j}]`).join('')}xstack=inputs=${all.length}:layout=${all.map((_, j) => `${(j % cols) * 640}_${Math.floor(j / cols) * 360}`).join('|')}`, out]);
}
// 2c. blank-frame check: a near-uniform picture (camera inside a wall or a prop, a missing set)
//     shows up as a tiny pixel spread after shrinking the frame to 32×18 greyscale
// --only: keep the old blank flags of images not re-rendered, re-check the new ones
const blank = only ? (prev.blank || []).filter(b => !rendered.has(path.join(ROOT, b.image))) : [];
for (const f of [...strips.flat(), ...items.flatMap(it => it.files)]) {
  if (only && !isNew(f)) continue;
  const r = spawnSync('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-i', f, '-vf', 'scale=32:18,format=gray', '-f', 'rawvideo', '-'], { maxBuffer: 1 << 20 });
  const px = r.stdout && r.stdout.length ? [...r.stdout] : null;
  if (!px) continue;
  const mean = px.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / px.length;
  const sd = Math.sqrt(px.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - mean) ** 2, 0) / px.length);
  if (sd < 8) blank.push({ image: path.relative(ROOT, f).replace(/\\/g, '/'), sd: +sd.toFixed(1) });
}
if (blank.length) console.log(`BLANK FRAMES (near-uniform picture — camera inside geometry?):\n${blank.map(b => `  ${b.image} (spread ${b.sd})`).join('\n')}`);

// --only: events of untouched shots come from the last run; the re-rendered ones replace theirs
const keptEvents = only ? prev.events.filter(e => !touches(e)) : [];
const events = [...keptEvents, ...items.map(({ files, ...rest }) => rest)]
  .sort((a, b) => a.shot - b.shot || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
const manifest = {
  slug, generated: new Date().toISOString(),
  timingHash, shotIds,
  ...(only ? {
    only: [...only].sort((a, b) => a - b).map(i => ({ shot: i, id: shotIds[i] })),
    onlyNote: 'Incremental run: only the shots in "only" (and their events) were re-rendered. Everything else is unchanged from the last full run.',
    fullRun: prev.fullRun || prev.generated,
  } : { fullRun: new Date().toISOString() }),
  audit: { errors: audit.findings.filter(f => f.sev === 'error'), warnings: audit.findings.filter(f => f.sev === 'warn') },
  blank,
  events,
  shots: ep.shots.map((s, i) => ({
    shot: i, id: s.id, kind: s.kind === 'card' ? `card:${s.card}` : s.set, vo: vo(i), words: tm.shots[i].words,
    strip: shotImgs[i], times: stripT(tm.shots[i]).map(t => +t.toFixed(2)),
    full: strips[i].map(f => path.relative(ROOT, f).replace(/\\/g, '/')),
  })),
  overview: fs.readdirSync(OUT).filter(f => f.startsWith('shots_')).map(f => `out/${slug}/review/${f}`),
};
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 1));
console.log(only
  ? `review frames (--only): ${only.size} shots, ${items.length} events re-rendered → out/${slug}/review/ (manifest.json, "only" lists them)`
  : `review frames: ${items.length} events, ${mids.length} shots → out/${slug}/review/ (manifest.json)`);

@@@@ FILE tools/sfx/episode_audio.py | text-crlf | 11709 | 10a2475db42576388324a49acb487a9c7457aab7d177f48c3446def49c6f5213
"""Full episode soundtrack: narration + music (ducked under the voice) + per-set ambience +
automatic and scripted sound effects → public/episodes/<slug>/mix.wav (stems in out/audio/<slug>/).

    .venv/Scripts/python -I tools/sfx/episode_audio.py <slug>

Scripted cues: shot "sfx": [{"t": 0.4, "name": "boom", "vol": -6, "dur": 1.2}], t = seconds into the shot.
Automatic: whoosh into cards, whip/flash/zoom/smash cuts, ticks + chime on stat overlays, hits on titles.
Music: episode "music": [{"shot": 0, "mood": "curious"}, {"shot": 14, "mood": "tension"}] or a file:
       {"shot": 0, "file": "music/my_track.mp3", "vol": -18} (path under public/).
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
from scipy.io import wavfile  # noqa: E402

import music as M  # noqa: E402
import sfxlib as S  # noqa: E402

SR = S.SR
ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '..'))
slug = sys.argv[1]
D = os.path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'episodes', slug)
ep = json.load(open(os.path.join(D, 'episode.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
tm = json.load(open(os.path.join(D, 'timing.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
TOTAL = tm['total'] + 1.0
N = int(TOTAL * SR)
S.seed(42)

OUTDOOR = {'suburb', 'city', 'park', 'stadium', 'rooftop', 'apartments'}
NIGHT = {'night', 'interiorNight', 'dusk', 'rooftopNight', 'cityNight', 'stadiumNight'}


def load_wav(path):
    sr, x = wavfile.read(path)
    integer = x.dtype.kind == 'i'
    x = x.astype(np.float64)
    if integer:
        x /= 32768.0
    if x.ndim == 1:
        x = np.stack([x, x], axis=1)
    if sr != SR:
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: expected {SR} Hz, got {sr}')
    return x


def decode(path):
    """Any audio file → float stereo at SR via ffmpeg."""
    raw = subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-v', 'error', '-i', path, '-f', 'f32le', '-ac', '2', '-ar', str(SR), '-'], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
    return np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1, 2).astype(np.float64)


class Bus:
    def __init__(self):
        self.x = np.zeros((N, 2))

    def add(self, t, y, db=0.0):
        if y.ndim == 1:
            y = S.stereo(y)
        i = int(round(t * SR))
        if i < 0:
            y, i = y[-i:], 0
        m = min(len(y), N - i)
        if m > 0:
            self.x[i:i + m] += y[:m] * 10 ** (db / 20)


vo, mus, amb, fx = Bus(), Bus(), Bus(), Bus()


def cue(spec, words, fallback=0.0):
    """Same word-cue syntax as src/episode/cue.ts: number, '@word', '@word#2', '@word+0.1'."""
    import re
    if spec is None:
        return fallback
    if isinstance(spec, (int, float)):
        return float(spec)
    m = re.match(r"^@((?:[^\W_]|')+)(?:#(\d+))?([+-][\d.]+)?$", str(spec).strip(), re.I)
    if not m:
        return fallback
    hits = [t for w, t in (words or []) if w == m.group(1).lower()]
    if not hits:
        return fallback
    n = int(m.group(2) or 1)
    return hits[min(n, len(hits)) - 1] + float(m.group(3) or 0)


# --- narration ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
draft = tm.get('draft', False)
if not draft:
    for sec in tm['sections']:
        vo.add(sec['start'], load_wav(os.path.join(ROOT, 'public', sec['file'])), 0)

# --- ambience per 3D shot (crossfaded) ------------------------------------------------------
for i, shot in enumerate(ep['shots']):
    st, du = tm['shots'][i]['start'], tm['shots'][i]['dur']
    if shot.get('kind') == 'card':
        continue
    seg = du + 0.3
    set_ = shot.get('set', 'suburb')
    night = shot.get('time') in NIGHT
    if set_ in OUTDOOR:
        a = S.ambience(seg, 0.12)
        if night:
            a = S.stereo(S.lp(S.pink(seg), 900) * 0.04, width=1)
            for c in range(int(seg * 3)):
                ch = S.osc(4300, 0.05) * np.sin(np.pi * S.t_axis(0.05) / 0.05) * 0.03
                j = int((c / 3 + 0.1) * SR)
                a[j:j + len(ch)] += S.stereo(ch, 0.5 - (c % 2))[: max(0, min(len(ch), len(a) - j))]
        if set_ == 'stadium':
            crowd = S.bp(S.pink(seg), 300, 2500) * (0.7 + 0.3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.3 * S.t_axis(seg)))
            a += S.stereo(S.norm(crowd) * 0.15, width=1)
        if set_ == 'apartments':
            # a building fire instead of birds: roar + flame rush + wood crackle, a siren far off
            a = S.stereo(S.lp(S.brown(seg), 300) * 0.03, width=1) + S.fire_bed(seg, 0.16) + S.siren(seg, 0.05, 0.75)
    else:
        a = S.stereo(S.lp(S.pink(seg), 500) * 0.05 + S.lp(S.brown(seg), 120) * 0.04, width=1)
    amb.add(st - 0.15, S.fade(a, 0.15, 0.15), -2)

# --- sound effects ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LIB = {
    'whoosh': lambda d: S.whoosh(d or 0.5, 2600, 500, 0.8),
    'whooshUp': lambda d: S.whoosh(d or 0.5, 500, 4000, 0.8),
    'swoosh': lambda d: S.whoosh(d or 0.25, 5000, 1500, 0.6),
    'boom': lambda d: S.boom(1.0, 0.0),
    'farBoom': lambda d: S.double_boom(0.8, 0.6),
    'thud': lambda d: S.footstep(1.0),
    'footsteps': lambda d: np.concatenate([np.vstack([S.footstep(0.7, 0.2 * (-1) ** k), np.zeros((int(0.27 * SR) - len(S.footstep()), 2))]) for k in range(int((d or 1.2) / 0.27))]),
    'gulp': lambda d: S.gulp(0.9),
    'click': lambda d: S.click(3200, 0.03, 0.6),
    'pop': lambda d: S.mouth_pop(0.7),
    'cloth': lambda d: S.cloth(d or 0.3, 0.4),
    'heartbeat': lambda d: S.heartbeat(1.0),
    'subdrop': lambda d: S.sub_drop(d or 0.9),
    'riser': lambda d: S.riser(d or 2.0),
    'swell': lambda d: S.reverse_swell(d or 0.5),
    'zap': lambda d: S.zap(3000, 0.06, 0.6),
    'crackle': lambda d: S.crackle_bed(d or 1.0, 25, 0.5),
    'wind': lambda d: S.wind_roar(d or 2.0, 0.7),
    'debris': lambda d: S.debris(d or 0.8, 0.5),
    'rustle': lambda d: S.rustle(d or 0.9, 0.4),
    'chime': lambda d: S.chime(0.45),
    'glint': lambda d: S.glint(0.4),
    'ticks': lambda d: S.ticks(d or 0.4, 26, 12, 0.18),
    'ring': lambda d: S.ringtone(d or 1.6),
    'bell': lambda d: S.school_bell(d or 2.5),
    'whistle': lambda d: S.whistle(d or 0.7),
    'groan': lambda d: S.groan(d or 1.4),
    'groanLow': lambda d: S.groan(d or 1.8, 0.3, 82.0),
    'menu': lambda d: S.ui_open(0.35),
    'tick': lambda d: S.ui_tick(0.3),
    'alert': lambda d: S.ui_alert(0.35),
    'horn': lambda d: S.horn(d or 0.8),
    'crack': lambda d: S.ice_crack(0.6),
    'splash': lambda d: S.splash(0.6),
}
DEFAULT_DB = {'whoosh': -9, 'swoosh': -12, 'whooshUp': -9, 'boom': -4, 'farBoom': -8, 'gulp': -2, 'chime': -8, 'ticks': -12, 'glint': -10,
              'wind': -8, 'riser': -10, 'crackle': -12, 'heartbeat': -4, 'subdrop': -8, 'click': -10, 'pop': -6, 'cloth': -10, 'footsteps': -10}

for i, shot in enumerate(ep['shots']):
    st = tm['shots'][i]['start']
    if shot.get('kind') == 'card':
        fx.add(st - 0.05, S.whoosh(0.3, 4200, 900, 0.5), -15)
    words = tm['shots'][i].get('words')
    swap = (shot.get('fx') or {}).get('swap')
    if swap:
        ts = st + cue(swap['t'], words, 0.5)
        fx.add(ts - 0.3, S.whoosh(0.3, 600, 5200, 0.6), -11)   # blink-blink charge
        fx.add(ts, S.mouth_pop(0.8), -6)                      # the swap 'pop'
        fx.add(ts, S.glint(0.4), -13)
    cut = shot.get('cut')
    if cut == 'whip':
        fx.add(st - 0.12, S.whoosh(0.3, 3000, 600, 0.9), -8)
    elif cut == 'flash':
        fx.add(st, S.glint(0.4), -12)
        fx.add(st, S.boom(0.6, 0.4), -12)
    elif cut == 'zoom':
        fx.add(st - 0.22, S.whoosh(0.35, 600, 5200, 0.7), -9)      # rising rush into the cut
    elif cut == 'smash':
        fx.add(st, S.boom(0.7, 0.2), -7)                            # hard hit on the frame
        fx.add(st, S.glint(0.3), -14)
    for o in shot.get('overlays', []):
        at = st + cue(o.get('at', 0), words, 0)
        if o['type'] == 'stat':
            fx.add(at, S.ticks(0.33, 30, 12, 0.18), -14)
            fx.add(at + 0.33, S.chime(0.45), -10)
        elif o['type'] == 'title':
            fx.add(at - 0.3, S.reverse_swell(0.3, 0.5), -10)
            fx.add(at, S.boom(0.8, 0.3), -9)
        elif o['type'] == 'label':
            fx.add(at, S.click(2600, 0.03, 0.4), -14)
        elif o['type'] == 'menu':
            # body-settings HUD: open blip, a slider tick per changing row, the toast's alert
            fx.add(at, S.ui_open(0.35), -9)
            for r in o.get('rows', []):
                if 'from' in r:
                    fx.add(st + cue(r.get('at', 0), words, 0), S.ui_tick(0.3), -10)
            if o.get('note'):
                fx.add(st + cue(o.get('noteAt', 0.6), words, 0) if isinstance(o.get('noteAt'), str) else at + o.get('noteAt', 0.6), S.ui_alert(0.35), -10)
    for c in shot.get('sfx', []):
        name = c['name']
        if name not in LIB:
            print(f'  ! unknown sfx "{name}" in shot {i} (known: {", ".join(LIB)})')
            continue
        fx.add(st + cue(c.get('t', 0), words, 0), LIB[name](c.get('dur')), c.get('vol', DEFAULT_DB.get(name, -8)))

# --- music --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cues = sorted(ep.get('music', [{'shot': 0, 'mood': 'curious'}]), key=lambda c: c['shot'])
for k, c in enumerate(cues):
    t0 = tm['shots'][c['shot']]['start']
    t1 = tm['shots'][cues[k + 1]['shot']]['start'] if k + 1 < len(cues) else TOTAL
    seg = t1 - t0 + 1.0
    if c.get('file'):
        y = decode(os.path.join(ROOT, 'public', c['file']))
        reps = int(np.ceil(seg * SR / len(y))) + 1
        y = np.tile(y, (reps, 1))[: int(seg * SR)]
    else:
        y = M.bed(c.get('mood', 'curious'), seg)
    y = S.fade(y, 0.6 if k == 0 else 1.0, 1.0 if k + 1 < len(cues) else 2.0)
    mus.add(t0 - (0 if k == 0 else 0.5), y, c.get('vol', -17))

# duck music + ambience under the voice (smoothed envelope sidechain)
env = np.abs(vo.x).mean(axis=1)
hop = 480
e = np.array([env[j:j + hop].max() for j in range(0, N, hop)])
g = np.zeros_like(e)
for j in range(len(e)):
    target = 1.0 if e[j] > 0.02 else 0.0
    coef = 0.5 if target > (g[j - 1] if j else 0) else 0.06  # fast attack, slow release
    g[j] = (g[j - 1] if j else 0) + coef * (target - (g[j - 1] if j else 0))
duck = np.repeat(g, hop)[:N]
mus.x *= (1 - 0.55 * duck)[:, None]
amb.x *= (1 - 0.35 * duck)[:, None]

# --- master -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stems first, then sum in place in float32: four float64 buses of a 15-min episode are ~640 MB each,
# and `vo + mus + amb + fx` used to allocate temporaries until it ran out of memory (menu-corpo, 2026-11-09).
out_dir = os.path.join(ROOT, 'out', 'audio', slug)
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
for name, b in (('vo', vo), ('music', mus), ('ambience', amb), ('sfx', fx)):
    S.write_wav(os.path.join(out_dir, f'{name}.wav'), S.norm(b.x, 0.9) if np.any(b.x) else b.x)
mix = vo.x.astype(np.float32)
vo.x = None
for b in (mus, amb, fx):
    mix += b.x.astype(np.float32)
    b.x = None
mix -= mix.mean(axis=0)
mix = S.hp(mix.T, 25, 2).T.astype(np.float32)
peak = np.max(np.abs(mix)) + 1e-9
mix /= peak
mix = (np.tanh(mix * 1.2) / np.tanh(1.2)).astype(np.float32)
mix = S.norm(mix, 10 ** (-1.0 / 20))
mix = S.fade(mix, 0.01, 0.8)

S.write_wav(os.path.join(D, 'mix.wav'), mix.astype(np.float32))
rms = 20 * np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(mix ** 2)) + 1e-9)
print(f'mix.wav: {TOTAL:.1f} s, rms {rms:.1f} dBFS' + (' (draft timing: no narration yet)' if draft else ''))
@@@@ END

"""Procedural underscore beds (numpy only). Each mood renders one seamless 8-bar loop with
vectorised additive instruments, then `bed(mood, seconds)` tiles it to any length.
Moods: curious (playful pluck, IFOLOGY-style default), wonder, tension, action, sad.
These sit ~17 dB under the narration and duck further while the voice speaks.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

import sfxlib as S

SR = S.SR


def mtof(m):
    return 440.0 * 2 ** ((np.asarray(m, dtype=float) - 69) / 12)


def note_pluck(f: float, dur: float, bright: float = 1.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Plucked string / marimba-ish tone: harmonics with faster decay up the series."""
    t = S.t_axis(dur)
    x = np.zeros_like(t)
    for h in range(1, 7):
        x += (0.6 ** (h - 1)) * bright ** (h - 1) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * h * t) * np.exp(-t * (3.5 + 2.2 * h))
    x *= np.clip(t / 0.003, 0, 1)
    return x


def note_bell(f: float, dur: float) -> np.ndarray:
    t = S.t_axis(dur)
    x = sum(a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * r * t) * np.exp(-t * d) for r, a, d in ((1, 1, 1.6), (2.76, 0.4, 2.8), (5.4, 0.2, 4.5), (8.9, 0.08, 7)))
    return x * np.clip(t / 0.002, 0, 1)


def note_piano(f: float, dur: float) -> np.ndarray:
    t = S.t_axis(dur)
    x = sum((0.55 ** (h - 1)) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * h * t * (1 + 0.0004 * h * h)) * np.exp(-t * (1.2 + 0.9 * h)) for h in range(1, 8))
    return x * np.clip(t / 0.004, 0, 1)


def pad(freqs, dur: float, cutoff: float = 1100, attack: float = 0.6) -> np.ndarray:
    t = S.t_axis(dur)
    x = np.zeros_like(t)
    for f in freqs:
        for det in (-0.004, 0.0, 0.0045):
            x += S.osc(f * (1 + det), dur, 'saw')
    x = S.lp(x / (3 * len(freqs)), cutoff, 2)
    env = np.clip(t / attack, 0, 1) * np.clip((dur - t) / 0.4, 0, 1)
    return x * env


def bass_note(f: float, dur: float, kind: str = 'sine') -> np.ndarray:
    t = S.t_axis(dur)
    if kind == 'saw':
        x = S.lp(S.osc(f, dur, 'saw'), 650, 2)
    else:
        x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) + 0.35 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * f * t)
    return x * np.clip(t / 0.005, 0, 1) * np.clip((dur - t) / 0.05, 0, 1) * np.exp(-t * 1.5)


def kick(level=1.0):
    d = 0.35
    t = S.t_axis(d)
    return (np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(S.glide(120, 45, d)) / SR) * np.exp(-t / 0.09)) * level


def snare(level=1.0):
    d = 0.25
    t = S.t_axis(d)
    return (S.bp(S.white(d), 1200, 7000) * np.exp(-t / 0.05) * 0.8 + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 190 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.04) * 0.5) * level


def hat(level=1.0, open_=False):
    d = 0.18 if open_ else 0.05
    t = S.t_axis(d)
    return S.hp(S.white(d), 7000) * np.exp(-t / (0.06 if open_ else 0.015)) * level


def shaker(level=1.0):
    d = 0.08
    t = S.t_axis(d)
    return S.bp(S.white(d), 4000, 12000) * np.sin(np.pi * t / d) ** 2 * level


class Track:
    def __init__(self, bars: int, bpm: float, beats_per_bar: int = 4):
        self.beat = 60.0 / bpm
        self.len = bars * beats_per_bar * self.beat
        self.buf = np.zeros((int(self.len * SR) + SR, 2))

    def add(self, beat_pos: float, x: np.ndarray, gain: float = 1.0, pan: float = 0.0):
        st = S.stereo(x * gain, pan)
        i = int(beat_pos * self.beat * SR)
        m = min(len(st), len(self.buf) - i)
        self.buf[i: i + m] += st[:m]

    def loop(self) -> np.ndarray:
        n = int(self.len * SR)
        out = self.buf[:n].copy()
        tail = self.buf[n:]
        out[: len(tail)] += tail  # wrap ringing tails to the start: seamless loop
        return out


def chords_for(mood):
    # (root midi, chord intervals) per bar for 8 bars
    if mood == 'curious':
        prog = [(53, (0, 4, 7)), (50, (0, 3, 7)), (46, (0, 4, 7)), (48, (0, 4, 7))]  # F Dm Bb C
    elif mood == 'wonder':
        prog = [(50, (0, 4, 7, 11)), (52, (0, 4, 7)), (47, (0, 3, 7)), (43, (0, 4, 7, 11))]  # Dmaj7 E Bm Gmaj7
    elif mood == 'tension':
        prog = [(45, (0, 3, 7)), (41, (0, 4, 7)), (50, (0, 3, 7)), (40, (0, 4, 7))]  # Am F Dm E
    elif mood == 'action':
        prog = [(50, (0, 3, 7)), (46, (0, 4, 7)), (48, (0, 4, 7)), (45, (0, 4, 7))]  # Dm Bb C A
    else:  # sad
        prog = [(48, (0, 3, 7)), (44, (0, 4, 7)), (51, (0, 4, 7)), (46, (0, 4, 7))]  # Cm Ab Eb Bb
    return prog * 2


def render_loop(mood: str) -> np.ndarray:
    S.seed(1000 + len(mood))
    bpm = {'curious': 104, 'wonder': 76, 'tension': 92, 'action': 128, 'sad': 68}[mood]
    tr = Track(8, bpm)
    prog = chords_for(mood)
    b = tr.beat
    for bar, (root, iv) in enumerate(prog):
        p0 = bar * 4
        notes = [root + i for i in iv]
        if mood == 'curious':
            tr.add(p0, pad(mtof([n + 12 for n in notes]), 4 * b, 900), 0.18)
            arp = [notes[0] + 12, notes[1] + 12, notes[2] + 12, notes[0] + 24, notes[2] + 12, notes[1] + 12, notes[0] + 12, notes[1] + 24]
            for k, m in enumerate(arp):
                tr.add(p0 + k * 0.5, note_pluck(float(mtof(m)), 0.6, 0.8), 0.32, pan=-0.25 + 0.5 * (k % 2))
            for q in range(4):
                tr.add(p0 + q, bass_note(float(mtof(root - 12)), b * 0.9), 0.5)
                tr.add(p0 + q + 0.5, shaker(), 0.12, 0.3)
                tr.add(p0 + q + 0.75, shaker(), 0.07, 0.3)
            tr.add(p0, kick(0.5), 1.0)
            tr.add(p0 + 2, kick(0.4), 1.0)
        elif mood == 'wonder':
            tr.add(p0, pad(mtof(notes + [notes[0] + 12]), 4 * b + 0.3, 1400, 1.2), 0.3)
            for k in range(4):
                m = notes[(k * 2) % len(notes)] + 24
                tr.add(p0 + k + (0.5 if k % 2 else 0), note_bell(float(mtof(m)), 2.0), 0.18, pan=-0.4 + 0.27 * k)
            tr.add(p0, bass_note(float(mtof(root - 12)), 4 * b), 0.3)
        elif mood == 'tension':
            tr.add(p0, pad(mtof([notes[0] + 12, notes[0] + 13, notes[2] + 12]), 4 * b, 700, 1.0), 0.16)
            for e in range(8):
                tr.add(p0 + e * 0.5, bass_note(float(mtof(root - 12)), b * 0.45, 'saw'), 0.45)
                tr.add(p0 + e * 0.5, hat(0.6), 0.1, 0.4)
            tr.add(p0, kick(0.7), 1.0)
            tr.add(p0 + 0.75, kick(0.4), 1.0)
        elif mood == 'action':
            tr.add(p0, pad(mtof([n + 12 for n in notes]), 4 * b, 1600, 0.05), 0.2)
            for e in range(8):
                tr.add(p0 + e * 0.5, bass_note(float(mtof(root - 12)), b * 0.48, 'saw'), 0.55)
                tr.add(p0 + e * 0.5 + 0.25, hat(0.8), 0.14, 0.3)
            for q in range(4):
                tr.add(p0 + q, kick(1.0), 0.9)
            tr.add(p0 + 1, snare(), 0.45)
            tr.add(p0 + 3, snare(), 0.45)
            if bar % 2 == 0:
                for n in notes:
                    tr.add(p0, note_pluck(float(mtof(n + 12)), 0.4, 1.2), 0.18)
        else:  # sad
            tr.add(p0, pad(mtof([n + 12 for n in notes]), 4 * b, 800, 1.5), 0.15)
            for k, m in enumerate([notes[0], notes[1] + 12, notes[2] + 12, notes[1] + 12]):
                tr.add(p0 + k, note_piano(float(mtof(m + 12)), 2.5), 0.3)
            tr.add(p0, note_piano(float(mtof(root - 12)), 4 * b), 0.35)
    x = tr.loop()
    x = S.reverb(x, decay=1.4, mix=0.18, damp=5000)
    return S.norm(x, 0.8)


_cache: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}


def bed(mood: str, seconds: float) -> np.ndarray:
    if mood == 'none':
        return np.zeros((int(seconds * SR), 2))
    if mood not in _cache:
        _cache[mood] = render_loop(mood)
    loop = _cache[mood]
    reps = int(np.ceil(seconds * SR / len(loop))) + 1
    return np.tile(loop, (reps, 1))[: int(seconds * SR)]

"""Sound design for the 4 s pill-sprint shot. Event times come from src/demo/pillSprint.json,
the same file the animation reads, so picture and sound can't drift apart.

    .venv/Scripts/python tools/sfx/pill_sprint.py
writes public/audio/pill_sprint_mix.wav (+ stems in out/audio/pill_sprint/).
"""
import json
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
import sfxlib as S  # noqa: E402

ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '..'))
TL = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'demo', 'pillSprint.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
E, SH, DUR = TL['events'], TL['shots'], TL['duration']
S.seed(11)

stems = {k: S.Mix(DUR) for k in ('amb', 'foley', 'power', 'impact', 'speed', 'ui')}

# --- ambience: calm street until the launch; dips during the close-up ------------------------
amb = S.ambience(SH['D'][0] + 0.2, level=0.13)
stems['amb'].add(0.0, amb, -2)
stems['amb'].duck(SH['B'][0], SH['B'][1], -6)
stems['amb'].duck(E['launch'], DUR, -40, ramp=0.03)

# --- foley: pill handling, mouth, gulp ------------------------------------------------------
f = stems['foley']
f.add(0.06, S.click(3400, 0.03, 0.35), -6)               # pill tapped between the fingers
f.add(E['pillLift'] - 0.02, S.cloth(0.3, 0.3), -8)        # sleeve rustle as the hand rises
f.add(E['pillIn'] - 0.015, S.mouth_pop(0.6), -3)          # pill in
f.add(E['gulp'] - 0.04, S.gulp(0.9), 0)                   # GULP
f.add(E['crouch'], S.cloth(0.25, 0.35), -6)               # drops into the crouch

# --- power-up: reverse swell into the surge, heartbeat, sub drop, rising energy --------------
p = stems['power']
p.add(E['surge'] - 0.45, S.reverse_swell(0.45, 0.55), -6)
p.add(E['surge'], S.heartbeat(1.0), -4)
p.add(E['surge'], S.sub_drop(0.9, 95, 30, 0.9), -8)
p.add(E['beat2'], S.heartbeat(0.9), -6)
rise_dur = E['launch'] - E['surge']
p.add(E['surge'] + 0.05, S.riser(rise_dur - 0.05, 260, 7000, 0.5, 110), -9)


def crack_density(t):
    T = E['surge'] + t
    if T > E['launch']:
        return 0
    return 18 + 30 * (T - E['surge']) / (E['launch'] - E['surge'])


p.add(E['surge'], S.crackle_bed(E['launch'] - E['surge'] + 0.05, crack_density, 0.5), -9)
p.add(SH['B'][0] - 0.03, S.whoosh(0.22, 3000, 700, 0.45), -10)      # cut into the close-up
p.add(E['smirk'] + 0.02, S.glint(0.4), -9)                           # confident smirk sparkle

# --- impact: launch boom, debris, leaves, distant sonic boom --------------------------------
i = stems['impact']
i.add(E['launch'] - 0.012, S.boom(1.0, 0.0), 2)
i.add(E['launch'], S.whoosh(0.55, 2600, 260, 0.9, 0.0, 0.6, q=1.3), -3)
i.add(E['launch'] + 0.02, S.debris(0.9, 0.5), -4)
i.add(E['launch'] + 0.05, S.rustle(0.95, 0.35), -6)
i.add(E['launch'] + 0.12, S.double_boom(0.7, 0.6), -7)             # far down the street

# --- speed: wind roar, footfalls, passing whooshes, exit ------------------------------------
sp = stems['speed']
d0 = SH['D'][0]
sp.add(d0 - 0.03, S.whoosh(0.18, 5000, 1200, 0.7), -6)             # smash cut in
wind = S.wind_roar(DUR - d0 + 0.05, 0.75)
sp.add(d0, wind, -5)
# footfalls on the dash cycle: 3.9 cycles/s = 7.8 contacts/s, alternating sides
k = 0
t = d0 + 0.02
while t < E['exit'] + 0.1:
    sp.add(t, S.footstep(0.6, -0.15 if k % 2 else 0.15), -9)
    k += 1
    t += 1 / 7.8
# world rushing past: short whooshes sweeping right → left
for j, tw in enumerate(np.arange(d0 + 0.1, DUR - 0.1, 0.23)):

"""Procedural sound-effects library (numpy/scipy, no samples, no downloads).

Every generator returns a float32 stereo array of shape (n, 2) at SR. Sounds are built from
filtered noise, swept oscillators and envelopes, then placed on a timeline with `Mix.add`.
All one-shots get short fades so nothing clicks at its edges.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from scipy import signal

SR = 48000
_rng = np.random.default_rng(7)


def seed(s: int):
    global _rng
    _rng = np.random.default_rng(s)


# --- basics ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def t_axis(dur: float) -> np.ndarray:
    return np.arange(int(dur * SR)) / SR


def white(dur: float) -> np.ndarray:
    return _rng.standard_normal(int(dur * SR)).astype(np.float64)


def pink(dur: float) -> np.ndarray:
    n = int(dur * SR)
    x = _rng.standard_normal(n)
    b, a = [0.049922035, -0.095993537, 0.050612699, -0.004408786], [1, -2.494956002, 2.017265875, -0.522189400]
    y = signal.lfilter(b, a, x)
    return y / (np.std(y) + 1e-9)


def brown(dur: float) -> np.ndarray:
    y = np.cumsum(_rng.standard_normal(int(dur * SR)))
    y = signal.sosfilt(signal.butter(1, 20, 'highpass', fs=SR, output='sos'), y)
    return y / (np.std(y) + 1e-9)


def lp(x, f, order=4):
    return signal.sosfilt(signal.butter(order, min(f, SR / 2 - 100), 'lowpass', fs=SR, output='sos'), x)


def hp(x, f, order=4):
    return signal.sosfilt(signal.butter(order, f, 'highpass', fs=SR, output='sos'), x)


def bp(x, lo, hi, order=3):
    return signal.sosfilt(signal.butter(order, [lo, min(hi, SR / 2 - 100)], 'bandpass', fs=SR, output='sos'), x)


def sweep_filter(x: np.ndarray, f0: float, f1: float, q: float = 2.0, kind: str = 'bp', curve: str = 'exp') -> np.ndarray:
    """Time-varying TPT state-variable filter (cutoff glides f0→f1 over the clip)."""
    n = len(x)
    k = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
    f = f0 * (f1 / f0) ** k if curve == 'exp' else f0 + (f1 - f0) * k
    g = np.tan(np.pi * np.clip(f, 10, SR / 2.2) / SR)
    kk = 1.0 / q
    a1 = 1.0 / (1.0 + g * (g + kk))
    a2 = g * a1
    a3 = g * a2
    ic1 = ic2 = 0.0
    out = np.empty(n)
    mode = 0 if kind == 'bp' else (1 if kind == 'lp' else 2)
    for i in range(n):
        v3 = x[i] - ic2
        v1 = a1[i] * ic1 + a2[i] * v3
        v2 = ic2 + a2[i] * ic1 + a3[i] * v3
        ic1 = 2 * v1 - ic1
        ic2 = 2 * v2 - ic2
        out[i] = v1 if mode == 0 else (v2 if mode == 1 else x[i] - kk * v1 - v2)
    return out


def env_exp(dur: float, tau: float, attack: float = 0.002) -> np.ndarray:
    t = t_axis(dur)
    a = np.clip(t / max(attack, 1e-4), 0, 1)
    return a * np.exp(-t / tau)


def env_adsr(dur: float, a: float, d: float, s: float, r: float) -> np.ndarray:
    t = t_axis(dur)
    e = np.where(t < a, t / max(a, 1e-4), np.where(t < a + d, 1 - (1 - s) * (t - a) / max(d, 1e-4), s))
    rel = np.clip((dur - t) / max(r, 1e-4), 0, 1)
    return e * rel


def env_swell(dur: float, power: float = 2.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Rises to the end (reverse-cymbal style)."""
    return np.linspace(0, 1, int(dur * SR)) ** power


def fade(x: np.ndarray, fin: float = 0.003, fout: float = 0.01) -> np.ndarray:
    x = x.copy()
    a, b = int(fin * SR), int(fout * SR)
    if a > 0:
        x[:a] *= np.linspace(0, 1, a)[:, None] if x.ndim == 2 else np.linspace(0, 1, a)
    if b > 0:
        x[-b:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, b)[:, None] if x.ndim == 2 else np.linspace(1, 0, b)
    return x


def osc(freq, dur: float, shape: str = 'sine', phase: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Oscillator with a constant or per-sample frequency array."""
    n = int(dur * SR)
    f = np.full(n, freq, dtype=np.float64) if np.isscalar(freq) else np.asarray(freq)[:n]
    ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR + phase
    if shape == 'sine':
        return np.sin(ph)
    if shape == 'saw':
        return 2 * ((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1) - 1
    if shape == 'square':
        return np.sign(np.sin(ph))
    if shape == 'tri':
        return 2 * np.abs(2 * ((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1) - 1) - 1
    raise ValueError(shape)


def glide(f0: float, f1: float, dur: float, curve: str = 'exp') -> np.ndarray:
    k = np.linspace(0, 1, int(dur * SR))
    return f0 * (f1 / f0) ** k if curve == 'exp' else f0 + (f1 - f0) * k


def stereo(x: np.ndarray, pan: float = 0.0, width: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """pan -1..1 (equal power); width adds a short Haas delay on one side for space."""
    l, r = np.cos((pan + 1) * np.pi / 4), np.sin((pan + 1) * np.pi / 4)
    out = np.stack([x * l, x * r], axis=1)
    if width > 0:
        d = int(width * 0.012 * SR)
        out[d:, 1] = 0.7 * out[d:, 1] + 0.3 * out[:-d, 1]
    return out


def autopan(x: np.ndarray, p0: float, p1: float) -> np.ndarray:
    p = np.linspace(p0, p1, len(x))
    return np.stack([x * np.cos((p + 1) * np.pi / 4), x * np.sin((p + 1) * np.pi / 4)], axis=1)


def saturate(x: np.ndarray, drive: float = 2.0) -> np.ndarray:
    return np.tanh(x * drive) / np.tanh(drive)


def norm(x: np.ndarray, peak: float = 1.0) -> np.ndarray:
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-9
    return x * (peak / m)


def reverb(x: np.ndarray, decay: float = 0.6, mix: float = 0.25, damp: float = 6000, pre: float = 0.012) -> np.ndarray:
    """Convolution with a synthetic stereo exponential-noise IR."""
    n = int(decay * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    irs = []
    for _ in range(2):
        ir = _rng.standard_normal(n) * np.exp(-t * 6.9 / decay)
        ir = lp(ir, damp, 2)
        ir[: int(pre * SR)] = 0
        irs.append(ir / np.sqrt(np.sum(ir ** 2) + 1e-9))
    if x.ndim == 1:
        x = stereo(x)
    wet = np.stack([signal.fftconvolve(x[:, i], irs[i])[: len(x)] for i in range(2)], axis=1)
    return x * (1 - mix) + wet * mix


# --- one-shots ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def click(freq: float = 3200, dur: float = 0.035, level: float = 0.6) -> np.ndarray:
    """Tiny plastic tick (pill, button)."""
    t = t_axis(dur)
    tone = np.sin(2 * np.pi * freq * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.006)
    nz = hp(white(dur), 2500) * np.exp(-t / 0.002) * 0.6
    return fade(stereo((tone + nz) * level), 0.0005, 0.005)


def cloth(dur: float = 0.28, level: float = 0.25) -> np.ndarray:
    """Fabric rustle for arm moves."""
    x = bp(white(dur), 900, 5500) * env_adsr(dur, dur * 0.35, dur * 0.3, 0.4, dur * 0.3)
    x *= 0.6 + 0.4 * np.abs(lp(white(dur), 30, 2)) / 0.3
    return fade(stereo(norm(x) * level, width=0.4), 0.005, 0.03)


def mouth_pop(level: float = 0.5) -> np.ndarray:
    dur = 0.09
    t = t_axis(dur)
    tone = osc(glide(1100, 520, dur), dur) * np.exp(-t / 0.018)
    nz = bp(white(dur), 600, 3000) * np.exp(-t / 0.008) * 0.4
    return fade(stereo((tone + nz) * level), 0.0005, 0.01)


def gulp(level: float = 0.8) -> np.ndarray:
    """Cartoon swallow: a wet throat 'glk' with a falling resonance."""
    dur = 0.3
    t = t_axis(dur)
    body = osc(glide(420, 150, dur), dur) * env_adsr(dur, 0.012, 0.09, 0.25, 0.15)
    body += 0.5 * osc(glide(840, 300, dur), dur) * env_exp(dur, 0.05)
    wet = sweep_filter(white(dur), 1600, 380, q=6) * env_exp(dur, 0.06, 0.003) * 0.9
    glk = bp(white(0.03), 300, 1500) * np.exp(-t_axis(0.03) / 0.008)
    x = body * 0.7 + wet
    x[: len(glk)] += glk * 0.8
    return fade(stereo(saturate(norm(x), 1.6) * level), 0.001, 0.04)


def heartbeat(level: float = 1.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Lub-dub: two sub thumps."""
    def thump(dur, f0, f1, tau):
        t = t_axis(dur)
        x = osc(glide(f0, f1, dur), dur) * np.exp(-t / tau)
        x += lp(white(dur), 300) * np.exp(-t / 0.012) * 0.3
        return x
    a = thump(0.35, 85, 42, 0.07)
    b = thump(0.35, 75, 38, 0.06) * 0.7
    out = np.zeros(int(0.6 * SR))
    out[: len(a)] += a
    o = int(0.17 * SR)
    out[o: o + len(b)] += b
    return fade(stereo(saturate(norm(out), 1.4) * level), 0.001, 0.05)


def sub_drop(dur: float = 0.9, f0: float = 95, f1: float = 32, level: float = 1.0) -> np.ndarray:
    t = t_axis(dur)
    x = osc(glide(f0, f1, dur), dur) * np.exp(-t / (dur * 0.45))
    x += 0.3 * osc(glide(f0 * 2, f1 * 2, dur), dur) * np.exp(-t / (dur * 0.2))
    return fade(stereo(saturate(x, 2.2) * level), 0.002, 0.08)


def riser(dur: float, f0: float = 300, f1: float = 6000, level: float = 0.5, tonal: float = 110) -> np.ndarray:
    """Energy build-up: filtered noise + detuned saw drone, both opening and swelling."""
    nz = sweep_filter(pink(dur), f0, f1, q=3, kind='bp')
    sw = sum(osc(tonal * d, dur, 'saw') for d in (1.0, 1.007, 0.993, 2.003)) / 4
    sw = sweep_filter(sw, f0 * 0.6, f1 * 0.5, q=1.5, kind='lp')
    trem = 1 + 0.35 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.linspace(5, 22, len(sw)) * t_axis(dur))
    x = (norm(nz) * 0.6 + norm(sw) * 0.5 * trem) * env_swell(dur, 1.6)
    return fade(stereo(x * level, width=0.8), 0.02, 0.03)


def reverse_swell(dur: float = 0.5, level: float = 0.6) -> np.ndarray:
    x = sweep_filter(white(dur), 400, 9000, q=1.2, kind='bp') * env_swell(dur, 3)
    return fade(stereo(norm(x) * level, width=1), 0.01, 0.004)


def zap(freq: float = 3000, dur: float = 0.05, level: float = 0.4) -> np.ndarray:
    t = t_axis(dur)
    f = freq * (1 + 0.6 * _rng.standard_normal(len(t)).cumsum() / np.sqrt(len(t)) * 0.2)
    x = osc(np.abs(f), dur, 'square') * np.exp(-t / (dur * 0.35))
    x = hp(x, 1200) + hp(white(dur), 4000) * np.exp(-t / 0.006) * 0.8
    return fade(stereo(x * level, pan=float(_rng.uniform(-0.6, 0.6))), 0.0005, 0.005)


def crackle_bed(dur: float, density, level: float = 0.35) -> np.ndarray:
    """Electric crackling; `density` = events/second, scalar or callable of time (s)."""
    out = np.zeros((int(dur * SR), 2))
    t = 0.0
    while t < dur:
        d = density(t) if callable(density) else density
        if d <= 0:
            t += 0.02
            continue
        t += float(_rng.exponential(1 / d))
        if t >= dur:
            break
        z = zap(float(_rng.uniform(1800, 6500)), float(_rng.uniform(0.012, 0.06)), level * float(_rng.uniform(0.4, 1.0)))
        i = int(t * SR)
        m = min(len(z), len(out) - i)
        out[i: i + m] += z[:m]
    hum = osc(120, dur, 'saw') * 0.5 + osc(240.6, dur, 'saw') * 0.3
    hum = lp(hum, 900) * 0.08 * level
    if callable(density):
        hum *= np.clip(np.array([density(x) for x in t_axis(dur)[::480]]).repeat(480)[: len(hum)] / 30, 0, 1)
    return out + stereo(hum)


def boom(level: float = 1.0, dist: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Launch / sonic boom: sub kick + mid punch + crack. `dist` 0..1 makes it far and dull."""
    dur = 1.4
    t = t_axis(dur)
    sub = osc(glide(70, 28, dur), dur) * np.exp(-t / 0.35)
    punch = lp(white(dur), 900) * np.exp(-t / 0.07)
    crack = hp(white(dur), 2500) * np.exp(-t / 0.012)
    x = sub * 1.0 + punch * 0.7 + crack * (0.6 * (1 - dist))
    if dist > 0:
        x = lp(x, 3000 * (1 - dist) + 400)
    x = saturate(norm(x), 2.4)
    return fade(reverb(stereo(x * level, width=0.5), decay=0.9 + dist, mix=0.18 + 0.3 * dist), 0.0005, 0.2)


def double_boom(level: float = 0.8, dist: float = 0.5) -> np.ndarray:
    a = boom(level, dist)
    out = np.zeros((len(a) + int(0.07 * SR), 2))
    out[: len(a)] += a
    out[int(0.07 * SR):] += a * 0.75
    return out


def whoosh(dur: float = 0.6, f0: float = 2400, f1: float = 300, level: float = 0.7, pan0: float = 0.0, pan1: float = 0.0, q: float = 1.6) -> np.ndarray:
    x = sweep_filter(pink(dur), f0, f1, q=q, kind='bp')
    x = norm(x) * np.sin(np.pi * np.clip(t_axis(dur) / dur, 0, 1)) ** 1.5
    return fade(autopan(x * level, pan0, pan1), 0.005, 0.02)


def wind_roar(dur: float, level: float = 0.6) -> np.ndarray:
    """Speed wind: buffeting band noise + low rumble."""
    t = t_axis(dur)
    flutter = 1 + 0.35 * lp(white(dur), 14, 2) / 0.05
    band = bp(pink(dur), 250, 3500) * np.clip(flutter, 0.3, 1.8)
    rum = lp(brown(dur), 120) * 0.8
    x = norm(band) * 0.8 + norm(rum) * 0.5
    return fade(stereo(x * level, width=1.0), 0.02, 0.05)


def footstep(level: float = 0.5, pan: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
    dur = 0.08
    t = t_axis(dur)
    x = osc(glide(140, 70, dur), dur) * np.exp(-t / 0.018) + lp(white(dur), 1800) * np.exp(-t / 0.01) * 0.6
    return fade(stereo(x * level, pan), 0.0005, 0.01)


def debris(dur: float = 0.8, level: float = 0.35) -> np.ndarray:
    """Gravel and dust spray: scattered ticks over a hiss."""
    out = np.zeros((int(dur * SR), 2))
    for _ in range(int(55 * dur)):
        t0 = float(_rng.uniform(0, dur * 0.9)) ** 1.3 / (dur * 0.9) ** 0.3
        c = click(float(_rng.uniform(1500, 5000)), 0.02, float(_rng.uniform(0.05, 0.25)))
        c = c * np.array([float(_rng.uniform(0.3, 1)), float(_rng.uniform(0.3, 1))])
        i = int(t0 * SR)
        m = min(len(c), len(out) - i)
        out[i: i + m] += c[:m]
    hiss = bp(white(dur), 1500, 8000) * env_exp(dur, dur * 0.35, 0.01) * 0.25
    return (out + stereo(hiss, width=1)) * level


def rustle(dur: float = 0.9, level: float = 0.3) -> np.ndarray:
    """Leaves blowing."""
    x = bp(white(dur), 2000, 9000)
    am = np.clip(lp(white(dur), 25, 2) * 8 + 0.5, 0, 1.4)
    x = x * am * env_adsr(dur, 0.08, 0.2, 0.7, dur * 0.4)
    return fade(stereo(norm(x) * level, width=1), 0.01, 0.06)


def bird(level: float = 0.15, pan: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Short songbird chirp phrase."""
    out = []
    for _ in range(int(_rng.integers(2, 5))):
        d = float(_rng.uniform(0.04, 0.09))
        f0, f1 = float(_rng.uniform(2800, 4200)), float(_rng.uniform(3200, 5600))
        t = t_axis(d)
        f = glide(f0, f1, d) * (1 + 0.04 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 60 * t))
        out.append(osc(f, d) * np.sin(np.pi * t / d) ** 2)
        out.append(np.zeros(int(float(_rng.uniform(0.02, 0.06)) * SR)))
    x = np.concatenate(out)
    return fade(stereo(x * level, pan), 0.002, 0.01)


def ambience(dur: float, level: float = 0.12) -> np.ndarray:
    """Calm suburban afternoon: soft air, faint distant traffic, occasional birds."""
    air = lp(pink(dur), 1200) * 0.6
    traffic = lp(brown(dur), 300) * 0.3
    x = stereo(norm(air + traffic) * level, width=1)
    t = 0.15
    while t < dur - 0.3:
        b = bird(level * float(_rng.uniform(0.6, 1.2)), float(_rng.uniform(-0.8, 0.8)))
        i = int(t * SR)
        m = min(len(b), len(x) - i)
        x[i: i + m] += b[:m]
        t += float(_rng.uniform(0.5, 1.1))
    return x


def fire_bed(dur: float, level: float = 0.3) -> np.ndarray:
    """A building fire heard from the street: low roar, breathy flame rush, and wood-crackle pops
    (short filtered noise bursts at random times, a few loud snaps among many small ones)."""
    t = t_axis(dur)
    roar = lp(brown(dur), 160) * (0.8 + 0.2 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.17 * t))
    rush = bp(pink(dur), 300, 1800) * (0.6 + 0.4 * np.abs(np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.31 * t + 1.3)))
    x = stereo(norm(roar) * 0.55 + norm(rush) * 0.25, width=1)
    k = 0.0
    while k < dur:
        k += float(_rng.exponential(1 / 14))
        if k >= dur:
            break
        big = _rng.random() < 0.12
        n = int(SR * float(_rng.uniform(0.002, 0.012 if not big else 0.03)))
        e = env_exp(n / SR, 0.004 if not big else 0.01)
        n = len(e)
        burst = bp(white(n / SR + 0.01), 600 if big else 1500, 7000)[:n] * e
        amp = float(_rng.uniform(0.15, 0.4)) * (2.2 if big else 1.0)
        i = int(k * SR)
        m = min(n, len(x) - i)
        x[i: i + m] += stereo(burst[:m] * amp, float(_rng.uniform(-0.6, 0.6)))
    return norm(x) * level


def siren(dur: float, level: float = 0.2, dist: float = 0.6) -> np.ndarray:
    """US-style wail siren, slow up/down sweep 650–1400 Hz (period ~3.6 s); `dist` 0..1 dulls it."""
    t = t_axis(dur)
    f = 650 + 750 * (0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * t / 3.6))
    ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    y = np.sin(ph) + 0.35 * np.sin(2 * ph) + 0.15 * np.sin(3 * ph)
    y = lp(y, 5000 - 3800 * dist) * level * (1 - 0.5 * dist)
    return stereo(y, -0.3, width=1)


def chime(level: float = 0.35) -> np.ndarray:
    """UI 'ding' for stat callouts: two bell partial sets."""
    dur = 0.9
    t = t_axis(dur)
    x = np.zeros_like(t)
    for f, a, tau in ((1318.5, 1.0, 0.35), (1975.5, 0.6, 0.28), (2637, 0.3, 0.18), (3951, 0.15, 0.1)):
        x += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) * np.exp(-t / tau)
    return fade(reverb(stereo(norm(x) * level), 1.2, 0.25), 0.001, 0.1)


def glint(level: float = 0.3) -> np.ndarray:
    """'Shing' sparkle for a confident smirk."""
    dur = 0.6
    t = t_axis(dur)
    x = sum(a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) * np.exp(-t / tau) for f, a, tau in ((2800, 1, 0.18), (4120, 0.7, 0.14), (6310, 0.5, 0.1), (8800, 0.3, 0.06)))
    x = x * np.clip(t / 0.004, 0, 1) + hp(white(dur), 6000) * np.exp(-t / 0.03) * 0.3
    return fade(reverb(stereo(norm(x) * level, 0.2), 0.8, 0.3), 0.001, 0.08)


def ticks(dur: float, rate0: float, rate1: float, level: float = 0.2) -> np.ndarray:
    """Counter ticks speeding up/slowing down."""
    out = np.zeros((int(dur * SR), 2))
    t = 0.0
    while t < dur:
        k = t / dur
        c = click(2600 + 900 * k, 0.025, level)
        i = int(t * SR)
        m = min(len(c), len(out) - i)
        out[i: i + m] += c[:m]
        t += 1 / (rate0 + (rate1 - rate0) * k)
    return out


# --- timeline -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Mix:
    def __init__(self, dur: float):
        self.buf = np.zeros((int(dur * SR), 2))

    def add(self, t: float, x: np.ndarray, gain_db: float = 0.0):
        if x.ndim == 1:
            x = stereo(x)
        i = int(round(t * SR))
        if i < 0:
            x, i = x[-i:], 0
        m = min(len(x), len(self.buf) - i)
        if m > 0:
            self.buf[i: i + m] += x[:m] * (10 ** (gain_db / 20))

    def duck(self, t0: float, t1: float, db: float, ramp: float = 0.05):
        """Gain envelope dip (e.g. ambience under a big moment)."""
        n = len(self.buf)
        tt = np.arange(n) / SR
        g = np.ones(n)
        inside = (tt >= t0) & (tt <= t1)
        g[inside] = 10 ** (db / 20)
        g = signal.convolve(g, np.ones(int(ramp * SR)) / int(ramp * SR), mode='same')
        self.buf *= g[:, None]

    def master(self, ceiling_db: float = -1.0, drive: float = 1.3) -> np.ndarray:
        x = self.buf - np.mean(self.buf, axis=0)
        x = hp(x.T, 25, 2).T
        x = norm(x, 1.0)
        x = np.tanh(x * drive) / np.tanh(drive)  # gentle glue / limiting
        x = norm(x, 10 ** (ceiling_db / 20))
        return fade(x, 0.002, 0.04).astype(np.float32)



def ringtone(dur: float = 1.6, level: float = 0.35) -> np.ndarray:
    """Cheerful phone ringtone: little 4-note marimba-ish motif, repeated."""
    notes = [1318.5, 1567.98, 1975.53, 1567.98]
    out = np.zeros(int(dur * SR))
    step = 0.13
    k = 0
    t0 = 0.0
    while t0 < dur - 0.05:
        f = notes[k % 4]
        n = osc(f, 0.12) * env_exp(0.12, 0.05) + 0.3 * osc(f * 2, 0.12) * env_exp(0.12, 0.03)
        i = int(t0 * SR)
        out[i:i + len(n)] += n[:max(0, len(out) - i)]
        k += 1
        t0 += step if k % 4 else step + 0.25
    return stereo(fade(out * level, 0.005, 0.05), 0.0, 0.2)


def school_bell(dur: float = 2.5, level: float = 0.45) -> np.ndarray:
    """Electric school bell: hammer striking a gong ~25×/s, metallic partials, slight room."""
    t = t_axis(dur)
    gong = sum(a * osc(f, dur) for f, a in ((1180, 1.0), (2830, 0.5), (4120, 0.3), (590, 0.25)))
    strike = 0.55 + 0.45 * (np.sin(2 * np.pi * 24 * t) > 0)
    x = saturate(gong * strike * 0.6, 1.6)
    x = x * env_adsr(dur, 0.01, 0.1, 0.9, 0.25)
    return reverb(stereo(fade(x * level, 0.005, 0.2), 0.0, 0.3), 0.7, 0.3)


def whistle(dur: float = 0.7, level: float = 0.5) -> np.ndarray:
    """Pea whistle: ~3.1 kHz tone with fast pea warble + breath noise."""
    t = t_axis(dur)
    f = 3100 + 60 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 38 * t)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    tone = np.sin(ph) * (0.75 + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 38 * t))
    breath = bp(white(dur), 2500, 5000) * 0.25
    x = (tone + breath) * env_adsr(dur, 0.015, 0.05, 0.9, 0.08)
    return reverb(stereo(fade(x * level, 0.005, 0.05), 0.0, 0.1), 0.5, 0.2)


def groan(dur: float = 1.4, level: float = 0.3, f0: float = 110.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Zombie moan: breathy low vowel gliding down, wobbling."""
    t = t_axis(dur)
    f = glide(f0 * 1.15, f0 * 0.8, dur) * (1 + 0.03 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 5.5 * t))
    ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    buzz = sum(np.sin(ph * h) / h for h in range(1, 9))
    voice = bp(buzz, 250, 1400) + bp(pink(dur), 300, 1200) * 0.4
    x = voice * env_adsr(dur, 0.18, 0.2, 0.8, 0.4)
    return reverb(stereo(fade(norm(x) * level, 0.02, 0.2), 0.0, 0.3), 0.6, 0.25)

def ui_open(level: float = 0.35) -> np.ndarray:
    """Game-menu open: a soft two-step rising blip with a glassy tail."""
    out = np.zeros(int(0.5 * SR))
    for k, f in enumerate((880.0, 1318.5)):
        d = 0.16
        t = t_axis(d)
        b = (np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) + 0.3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * f * t)) * np.exp(-t / 0.07) * np.clip(t / 0.003, 0, 1)
        i = int(k * 0.07 * SR)
        out[i:i + len(b)] += b
    return fade(reverb(stereo(norm(out) * level), 0.7, 0.25), 0.001, 0.05)


def ui_tick(level: float = 0.3) -> np.ndarray:
    """Slider notch: a short square-ish tick with a pitch blip."""
    d = 0.09
    t = t_axis(d)
    x = np.sign(np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1760 * t)) * np.exp(-t / 0.015) * 0.5 + np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2640 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.03)
    return fade(stereo(norm(x) * level), 0.001, 0.02)


def ui_alert(level: float = 0.35) -> np.ndarray:
    """Notification: two falling tones, a little ominous (the debt toast)."""
    out = np.zeros(int(0.7 * SR))
    for k, f in enumerate((987.8, 659.3)):
        d = 0.32
        t = t_axis(d)
        b = (np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1.5 * f * t)) * np.exp(-t / 0.14) * np.clip(t / 0.004, 0, 1)
        i = int(k * 0.16 * SR)
        out[i:i + len(b)] += b
    return fade(reverb(stereo(norm(out) * level), 0.9, 0.25), 0.001, 0.08)


def horn(dur: float = 0.8, level: float = 0.5) -> np.ndarray:
    """Car horn: two detuned buzzy tones (a major third), slight doppler drop."""
    t = t_axis(dur)
    f = np.where(t < dur * 0.6, 1.0, 1.0 - 0.04 * (t - dur * 0.6) / (dur * 0.4))
    x = np.zeros_like(t)
    for base in (415.0, 523.0):
        ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(base * f) / SR
        x += np.sign(np.sin(ph)) * 0.6 + np.sin(2 * ph) * 0.3
    x = lp(x, 3500) * env_adsr(dur, 0.01, 0.05, 0.9, 0.08)
    return fade(stereo(norm(saturate(x, 1.5)) * level), 0.003, 0.05)


def ice_crack(level: float = 0.6) -> np.ndarray:
    """Ice cracking: a sharp snap, a few ringing pings and a low creak."""
    d = 1.0
    t = t_axis(d)
    x = hp(white(d), 1800) * np.exp(-t / 0.012) * 1.2
    for k, (f, at) in enumerate(((3100, 0.0), (2300, 0.05), (4200, 0.11), (1700, 0.19))):
        tt = np.clip(t - at, 0, None)
        x += np.where(t >= at, np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * tt * (1 - 0.25 * tt)) * np.exp(-tt / 0.09), 0) * 0.45
    x += lp(brown(d), 180) * np.exp(-t / 0.35) * 0.8
    return fade(reverb(stereo(norm(x) * level, 0.0, 0.3), 1.0, 0.3), 0.001, 0.1)


def splash(level: float = 0.6) -> np.ndarray:
    """Body into water: low thump + a noisy splash burst + bubbling tail."""
    d = 1.4
    t = t_axis(d)
    x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 70 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.08) * 0.8
    x += bp(white(d), 400, 4000) * np.exp(-t / 0.18) * np.clip(t / 0.01, 0, 1)
    bub = np.zeros_like(t)
    rnd = np.random.default_rng(7)
    for _ in range(14):
        at = 0.25 + rnd.random() * 0.9
        f = 500 + rnd.random() * 900
        tt = np.clip(t - at, 0, None)
        bub += np.where(t >= at, np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * tt * (1 + 3 * tt)) * np.exp(-tt / 0.03), 0)
    x += bub * 0.18
    return fade(reverb(stereo(norm(x) * level, 0, 0.4), 0.8, 0.2), 0.002, 0.15)


def write_wav(path: str, x: np.ndarray):
    from scipy.io import wavfile
    wavfile.write(path, SR, (np.clip(x, -1, 1) * 32767).astype(np.int16))

// Cheap pre-check before review.mjs: one labelled still per chosen shot, tiled 4 across.
//   node tools/sheet.mjs <slug>                 → auto-picks key shots (opening, each new set, the last shots)
//   node tools/sheet.mjs <slug> c8,r6,12        → those shots (ids or indexes)
//   options: --at 0.7 (fraction of the shot), --max 16 (auto mode)
// Output: out/lab/<slug>_sheet.jpg (each tile 480 px wide, with the review banner showing the shot number).
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => (args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : d);
const pos = args.filter((a, i) => !a.startsWith('--') && !['--at', '--max'].includes(args[i - 1]));
const [slug, list] = pos;
if (!slug) {
  console.error('usage: node tools/sheet.mjs <slug> [id,id,...] [--at 0.7] [--max 16]');
  process.exit(1);
}
const at = +opt('--at', 0.7), max = +opt('--max', 16);
const D = path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'episodes', slug);
const ep = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(D, 'episode.json'), 'utf8'));
const tm = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(D, 'timing.json'), 'utf8'));
const fps = tm.fps || 30;
const ids = ep.shots.map(s => s.id);

let pick;
if (list) {
  pick = list.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(tok => {
    const i = /^\d+$/.test(tok) ? +tok : ids.indexOf(tok);
    if (i < 0 || i >= ids.length) { console.error(`unknown shot "${tok}"`); process.exit(1); }
    return i;
  });
} else {
  // opening, the first shot of every new set, and the last two 3D shots (hook); thinned evenly to --max
  const s3d = ep.shots.map((s, i) => i).filter(i => ep.shots[i].kind !== 'card');
  const key = new Set([0]);
  let prevSet = null;
  for (const i of s3d) { if (ep.shots[i].set !== prevSet) key.add(i); prevSet = ep.shots[i].set; }
  s3d.slice(-2).forEach(i => key.add(i));
  pick = [...key].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  if (pick.length > max) pick = Array.from({ length: max }, (_, k) => pick[Math.round(k * (pick.length - 1) / (max - 1))]);
  pick = [...new Set(pick)];
}

const name = i => `sheet_${slug}_${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}`;
const jobs = pick.map(i => {
  const s = tm.shots[i];
  const f0 = Math.round(s.start * fps), f1 = Math.round((s.start + s.dur) * fps) - 1;
  return { out: `sheet/${name(i)}`, id: 'Episode', props: { slug, review: true }, frame: Math.min(f1, f0 + Math.round(s.dur * at * fps)) };
});
const LAB = path.join(ROOT, 'out', 'lab');
fs.mkdirSync(path.join(LAB, 'sheet'), { recursive: true });
const jobsFile = path.join(LAB, 'sheet', `${slug}_jobs.json`);
fs.writeFileSync(jobsFile, JSON.stringify(jobs));
console.log(`sheet: ${pick.length} shots → ${pick.map(i => ids[i] ?? i).join(', ')}`);
const r = spawnSync('node', [path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'stills.cjs'), jobsFile], { encoding: 'utf8', cwd: ROOT });
const fails = (r.stdout || '').split('\n').filter(l => l.startsWith('FAIL'));
if (fails.length) console.log(fails.join('\n'));

const files = pick.map(i => path.join(LAB, 'sheet', name(i) + '.jpg')).filter(f => fs.existsSync(f));
const cols = Math.min(4, files.length), rows = Math.ceil(files.length / cols);
const all = [...files, ...Array(rows * cols - files.length).fill(files[files.length - 1])];
const out = path.join(LAB, `${slug}_sheet.jpg`);
spawnSync('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-y', ...all.flatMap(f => ['-i', f]), '-filter_complex',
  `${all.map((_, j) => `[${j}]scale=480:270[v${j}]`).join(';')};${all.map((_, j) => `[v${j}]`).join('')}xstack=inputs=${all.length}:layout=${all.map((_, j) => `${(j % cols) * 480}_${Math.floor(j / cols) * 270}`).join('|')}`,
  '-q:v', '3', out], { stdio: 'inherit' });
console.log(`→ ${path.relative(ROOT, out).replace(/\\/g, '/')}`);
@@@@ END

// Bundle once, render many stills (~1 s each instead of ~15 s per CLI call), several at a time.
// Usage: node tools/stills.cjs jobs.json [--parallel N]   → out/lab/<out>.jpg
// jobs.json: [{ "out": "city_1", "id": "SetLab", "props": {...}, "frame": 0 }]  (id defaults to SetLab)
// --parallel: stills rendered at once in one browser (default 4; 1 = the old one-by-one behaviour).
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const { createRequire } = require('module');
const req = createRequire(path.join(ROOT, 'package.json'));
const { bundle } = req('@remotion/bundler');
const { selectComposition, renderStill, openBrowser } = req('@remotion/renderer');

(async () => {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const parallel = Math.max(1, +(args.includes('--parallel') ? args[args.indexOf('--parallel') + 1] : 4) || 4);
  const jobs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(args[0], 'utf8'));
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const serveUrl = await bundle({ entryPoint: path.join(ROOT, 'src/index.ts'), publicDir: path.join(ROOT, 'public') });
  console.log('bundled in', ((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1), 's');
  const chromiumOptions = { gl: 'angle' };
  const browser = await openBrowser('chrome', { chromiumOptions });
  // one composition lookup per (id, props): Episode's metadata step fetches and resolves the whole episode
  const comps = new Map();
  const compFor = j => {
    const key = (j.id || 'SetLab') + JSON.stringify(j.props || {});
    if (!comps.has(key)) comps.set(key, selectComposition({ serveUrl, id: j.id || 'SetLab', inputProps: j.props, puppeteerInstance: browser, chromiumOptions }));
    return comps.get(key);
  };
  let next = 0, fails = 0;
  const worker = async () => {
    while (next < jobs.length) {
      const j = jobs[next++];
      const t1 = Date.now();
      try {
        const composition = await compFor(j);
        const out = path.join(ROOT, 'out/lab', j.out + '.jpg');
        await renderStill({ composition, serveUrl, output: out, inputProps: j.props, frame: j.frame || 0, imageFormat: 'jpeg', jpegQuality: 88, puppeteerInstance: browser, chromiumOptions, overwrite: true });
        console.log('ok', j.out, ((Date.now() - t1) / 1000).toFixed(1), 's');
      } catch (e) {
        fails++;
        console.log('FAIL', j.out, String(e && e.message).slice(0, 600));
      }
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(parallel, jobs.length) }, worker));
  await browser.close({ silent: true });
  console.log(`${jobs.length - fails}/${jobs.length} stills in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)} s (parallel ${parallel})`);
})();

// Build GPT Image 2.5 thumbnail prompts from thumbnails/prompt_template.json.
//   node tools/thumb-prompt.mjs <slug>                 prompts for the mode in thumbnails/config.json
//   node tools/thumb-prompt.mjs <slug> --mode chatgpt  override the mode (fish | chatgpt)
//   node tools/thumb-prompt.mjs <slug> --copy B        also put variant B's prompt on the clipboard
//   node tools/thumb-prompt.mjs <slug> --pick B        make out/B_*.png the episode thumbnail
// Reads thumbnails/<slug>/brief.json ({topic, context, variants:[{id, text:[{text,color}], scene}]}).
// fish:    writes prompt_<id>.txt and fish_jobs.json (Claude submits them through the Fish MCP).
// chatgpt: writes chatgpt_<id>.txt and CHATGPT.md (the user pastes them into ChatGPT with the refs).
// The references in thumbnails/refs/refs.json go with every prompt, in order.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const slug = args[0];
const flag = (name) => { const i = args.indexOf(`--${name}`); return i > 0 ? args[i + 1] : undefined; };
if (!slug || slug.startsWith('--')) {
  console.error('usage: node tools/thumb-prompt.mjs <slug> [--mode fish|chatgpt] [--copy <id>] [--pick <id>]');
  process.exit(1);
}

const dir = path.join(root, 'thumbnails', slug);
const briefPath = path.join(dir, 'brief.json');
const brief = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(briefPath, 'utf8'));
const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'thumbnails', 'config.json'), 'utf8'));
const template = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'thumbnails', 'prompt_template.json'), 'utf8');
const { refs } = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'thumbnails', 'refs', 'refs.json'), 'utf8'));

if (flag('pick')) { pick(flag('pick')); process.exit(0); }

const mode = flag('mode') ?? config.mode;
if (!['fish', 'chatgpt'].includes(mode)) { console.error(`unknown mode "${mode}" (fish | chatgpt)`); process.exit(1); }
if (brief.variants.length !== config.variants) {
  console.error(`brief has ${brief.variants.length} variants; config.json locks it at ${config.variants}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

const HEX = { white: '#FFFFFF', yellow: '#FFE12B' };
const WORDS = ['zero', 'one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'six'];
const n = WORDS[refs.length] ?? String(refs.length);

function buildPrompt(v) {
  // The template says "four" references; we send however many refs.json lists.
  const t = JSON.parse(template.replaceAll('four supplied', `${n} supplied`).replaceAll('four reference', `${n} reference`));
  const full = v.text.map((l) => l.text).join(' ');
  const lines = v.text.map((l, i) => ({ line: i + 1, text: l.text, color: HEX[l.color] ?? l.color, color_name: l.color }));

  t.input.video_topic = brief.topic;
  t.input.additional_context = brief.context;
  t.input.scene_direction = v.scene;
  t.input.reference_images = {
    rule: `Use the ${n} supplied images, in order, as primary visual references for character proportions, linework, rendering, lighting, composition, and typography. Every reference shows a BLUE hoodie: draw a heather-GRAY quarter-zip jacket with a gold zip pull instead.`,
    images: refs.map((r, i) => ({ image: i + 1, shows: r.about })),
  };

  // We choose the words; the model must not invent its own.
  const auto = t.automatic_thumbnail_text;
  t.automatic_thumbnail_text = {
    mode: 'PROVIDED',
    priority: auto.priority,
    instruction: `Use EXACTLY this thumbnail text and nothing else: "${full}". Same words, spelling, punctuation, line breaks and colours as listed. Do not add, drop or change any word, and add no other text anywhere in the image.`,
    provided_text: { full, lines },
    tone: auto.tone,
    text_examples: auto.text_examples,
  };

  t.automatic_scene_generation.mode = 'GUIDED';
  t.automatic_scene_generation.provided_scene = v.scene;
  // Channel world rules (the first test drew anime kids and a "PIZZA" sign).
  t.supporting_characters = {
    rule: 'Everyone else in the scene is the same kind of cartoon character as the mascot: perfectly round black head, minimal off-white eyes and mouth, no hair, ears, nose or visible skin, black hands. Tell them apart by hoodie or clothing colour, never gray (gray is only the mascot). Adults may wear uniforms or helmets over the same black head.',
    avoid: ['Realistic humans', 'Anime or cartoon humans with hair or skin', 'Any character with a face other than the mascot style'],
  };
  t.negative_prompt.push('Humans with hair or skin', 'Signs, labels, logos or any lettering other than the provided thumbnail text');

  const fd = t.final_directive;
  fd.instruction = fd.instruction.replace(
    'Automatically generate an extremely short, emotionally compelling thumbnail hook, ideally 1-3 words.',
    `Use exactly the provided thumbnail text "${full}" (${lines.map((l) => `${l.text} in ${l.color_name}`).join(', ')}).`,
  );
  fd.internal_execution = fd.internal_execution.map((s) =>
    s === 'Select the strongest minimal thumbnail text.' ? `Use the provided thumbnail text "${full}" exactly.`
      : s === 'Determine white/yellow emphasis.' ? 'Apply the provided white/yellow line colours.'
        : s);

  return { full, json: JSON.stringify(t) };
}

// ChatGPT answers a bare JSON paste with text, so it gets a one-line ask first.
const chatgptLead = () =>
  `Create one image (no text reply). I've attached ${n} reference images in this order: ${refs.map((r, i) => `${i + 1}) ${r.label}`).join(', ')}. Make a 16:9 landscape YouTube thumbnail that follows this JSON brief exactly:\n\n`;

const written = [];
for (const v of brief.variants) {
  const { full, json } = buildPrompt(v);
  const file = path.join(dir, mode === 'fish' ? `prompt_${v.id}.txt` : `chatgpt_${v.id}.txt`);
  fs.writeFileSync(file, mode === 'fish' ? json : chatgptLead() + json);
  written.push({ id: v.id, full, file });
  console.log(`${path.relative(root, file)}  ${fs.statSync(file).size} bytes  "${full}"`);
}

if (mode === 'fish') {
  const jobs = {
    note: 'Submit each job with Fish generate_image_edit after estimate_image_edit and the user\'s OK. prompt = the exact text of prompt_file.',
    model_id: config.fish.model_id,
    parameters: config.fish.parameters,
    inputs: refs.map((r) => ({ role: 'ref', object_key: r.object_key })),
    jobs: written.map((w) => ({ id: w.id, text: w.full, prompt_file: path.relative(root, w.file).replaceAll('\\', '/') })),
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'fish_jobs.json'), JSON.stringify(jobs, null, 2) + '\n');
  console.log(`${path.join('thumbnails', slug, 'fish_jobs.json')}  ${config.fish.model_id} ${Object.values(config.fish.parameters).join(' ')}`);
} else {
  const refDir = path.join(root, 'thumbnails', 'refs');
  const md = [
    `# ${brief.topic}: thumbnails in ChatGPT`,
    '',
    `Make each variant in a **new** ChatGPT chat, so the earlier ones don't bleed in.`,
    '',
    `1. Attach the ${n} reference images from \`${refDir}\`, in this order:`,
    ...refs.map((r, i) => `   ${i + 1}. \`${r.file}\` (${r.label})`),
    `2. Paste the prompt for the variant: open its file below, select all, copy, paste. Or run \`node tools/thumb-prompt.mjs ${slug} --mode chatgpt --copy <id>\` to put it on the clipboard.`,
    `3. Send. Download the image and save it as \`thumbnails/${slug}/out/<id>_chatgpt.png\`.`,
    `4. Repeat for every variant, then tell Claude which one to use.`,
    '',
    '| Variant | Text | Prompt file | Scene |',
    '|---|---|---|---|',
    ...brief.variants.map((v, i) => `| ${v.id} | ${written[i].full} | \`${path.basename(written[i].file)}\` | ${v.scene} |`),
    '',
  ].join('\n');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'CHATGPT.md'), md);
  console.log(path.join('thumbnails', slug, 'CHATGPT.md'));
}

const copyId = flag('copy');
if (copyId) {
  const w = written.find((x) => x.id === copyId);
  if (!w) { console.error(`no variant "${copyId}"`); process.exit(1); }
  const r = spawnSync('powershell', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', `Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 -LiteralPath '${w.file}' | Set-Clipboard`]);
  console.log(r.status === 0 ? `variant ${copyId} prompt copied to the clipboard` : `clipboard copy failed: ${r.stderr}`);
}

// The chosen thumbnail goes in final/thumbnails/, next to the other episodes' thumbnails.
function pick(id) {
  const out = path.join(dir, 'out');
  const pngs = fs.existsSync(out) ? fs.readdirSync(out).filter((f) => f.startsWith(`${id}_`) && f.endsWith('.png')) : [];
  if (!pngs.length) { console.error(`no thumbnails/${slug}/out/${id}_*.png`); process.exit(1); }
  const src = pngs.map((f) => path.join(out, f)).sort((a, b) => fs.statSync(b).mtimeMs - fs.statSync(a).mtimeMs)[0];
  const probe = spawnSync('ffprobe', ['-v', 'error', '-select_streams', 'v:0', '-show_entries', 'stream=width', '-of', 'csv=p=0', src], { encoding: 'utf8' });
  if (Number(probe.stdout) < 1920) console.warn(`warning: ${path.basename(src)} is ${probe.stdout.trim()} px wide, upscaling to 1920`);
  const dst = path.join(root, 'final', 'thumbnails', `${slug}_thumbnail.jpg`);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst), { recursive: true });
  const ff = spawnSync('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-y', '-i', src, '-vf', 'scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos', '-q:v', '2', dst]);
  if (ff.status !== 0) { console.error(String(ff.stderr)); process.exit(1); }
  brief.chosen = { id, file: path.relative(root, src).replaceAll('\\', '/'), at: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) };
  fs.writeFileSync(briefPath, JSON.stringify(brief, null, 2) + '\n');
  console.log(`${path.relative(root, dst)}  ${(fs.statSync(dst).size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB  from ${path.basename(src)}`);
}
@@@@ END
